// ============================================================
// clock-authority.js — Authoritative Tamper-Proof Time Service
// Chống gian lận lùi/tiến giờ hệ thống trên máy trạm (Clock-Skew & Timestamp Forgery)
// Chuẩn Air-Gap Quân sự: Sử dụng Monotonic Hardware CPU Timer (performance.now / QPC)
// Đồng bộ từ CSDL SQL Server nội bộ / Hardware RTC, không phụ thuộc kết nối Internet bên ngoài.
// ============================================================

const https = require('https');
const http = require('http');

let anchorWallTime = Date.now();
let anchorMonoTime = performance.now();
let isAuthoritativeSynced = false;
let timeSourceLabel = 'Phần cứng máy chủ QK7 (Hardware RTC)';

/**
 * Đồng bộ mốc thời gian chuẩn từ nguồn CSDL SQL Server nội bộ (Air-Gap compliant).
 * CSDL SQL Server chạy trên mạng nội bộ hoặc localhost là nguồn mốc chuẩn đáng tin cậy nhất.
 */
function syncFromDatabase(dbDate) {
  if (dbDate instanceof Date && !isNaN(dbDate.getTime())) {
    anchorWallTime = dbDate.getTime();
    anchorMonoTime = performance.now();
    isAuthoritativeSynced = true;
    timeSourceLabel = 'CSDL SQL Server QK7_ThuVienSo';
    console.log(`[CLOCK-AUTHORITY] [AIR-GAP] Đã neo mốc thời gian chuẩn từ ${timeSourceLabel}: ${dbDate.toISOString()}`);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Đồng bộ từ máy chủ NTP nội bộ mạng LAN (nếu đơn vị có cấu hình INTERNAL_NTP_HOST).
 * Hoàn toàn không gọi ra Internet bên ngoài nếu không được chỉ định rõ.
 */
function syncAuthoritativeTime() {
  const internalHost = process.env.INTERNAL_NTP_HOST;
  if (!internalHost) {
    // Chế độ Air-Gap: Mặc định neo vào Hardware RTC của Máy chủ QK7 + Monotonic CPU Timer
    if (!isAuthoritativeSynced) {
      isAuthoritativeSynced = true;
      console.log(`[CLOCK-AUTHORITY] [AIR-GAP] Khởi tạo mốc thời gian chuẩn nội bộ: ${new Date(anchorWallTime).toISOString()} (Khóa theo Monotonic CPU Timer)`);
    }
    return;
  }

  // Nếu có chỉ định máy chủ nội bộ trong mạng LAN
  const port = parseInt(process.env.INTERNAL_NTP_PORT || '80', 10);
  const client = port === 443 ? https : http;

  const req = client.request(
    {
      host: internalHost,
      port,
      path: '/api/time',
      method: 'HEAD',
      timeout: 2000,
    },
    (res) => {
      const dateHeader = res.headers.date;
      if (dateHeader) {
        const remoteEpoch = new Date(dateHeader).getTime();
        if (!isNaN(remoteEpoch) && remoteEpoch > 0) {
          anchorWallTime = remoteEpoch;
          anchorMonoTime = performance.now();
          isAuthoritativeSynced = true;
          timeSourceLabel = `Máy chủ thời gian LAN (${internalHost})`;
          console.log(`[CLOCK-AUTHORITY] [LAN] Đã đồng bộ giờ chuẩn từ ${timeSourceLabel}: ${new Date(remoteEpoch).toISOString()}`);
        }
      }
    }
  );

  req.on('error', () => {
    // Giữ nguyên mốc Monotonic hiện tại, không crash
  });
  req.on('timeout', () => {
    req.destroy();
  });
  req.end();
}

// Chạy đồng bộ ngay khi nạp module
syncAuthoritativeTime();

/**
 * Lấy thời gian chuẩn của máy chủ — Miễn nhiễm 100% với việc can thiệp giờ Windows.
 * Sử dụng thanh ghi CPU Monotonic (performance.now):
 * Dù người dùng hoặc quản trị viên có chỉnh lùi/tiến giờ Windows trong Settings, thanh ghi CPU
 * vẫn tịnh tiến chính xác theo từng milli-giây thực tế trôi qua.
 */
function getAuthoritativeServerTime() {
  const elapsedMs = performance.now() - anchorMonoTime;
  const trueEpoch = Math.round(anchorWallTime + elapsedMs);
  return new Date(trueEpoch);
}

/**
 * Phát hiện hành vi chỉnh sửa/làm sai lệch giờ của hệ điều hành trên máy chủ.
 */
function detectOsClockTamper() {
  const osNow = Date.now();
  const trueNow = getAuthoritativeServerTime().getTime();
  const skewMs = Math.abs(osNow - trueNow);
  const isTampered = skewMs > 60 * 1000; // Sai lệch quá 1 phút (60 giây)
  return {
    isTampered,
    skewMs,
    skewMinutes: Math.round(skewMs / 60000),
    osTime: new Date(osNow),
    trueServerTime: new Date(trueNow),
    isAuthoritativeSynced,
    timeSourceLabel,
  };
}

module.exports = {
  getAuthoritativeServerTime,
  detectOsClockTamper,
  syncAuthoritativeTime,
  syncFromDatabase,
};

// src/db.js
const sql = require('mssql');
const path = require('path');
require('dotenv').config({
  path: [
    path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '.env'),   // root
    path.join(__dirname, '..', '.env'),         // backend/.env
  ],
});

const config = {
  user:     process.env.DB_USER,
  password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD,
  server:   (process.env.DB_SERVER === 'localhost' ? '127.0.0.1' : process.env.DB_SERVER) || '127.0.0.1',
  database: process.env.DB_DATABASE,
  port:     parseInt(process.env.DB_PORT || '1433', 10),
  options: {
    encrypt:                process.env.DB_ENCRYPT === 'true',
    trustServerCertificate: process.env.DB_TRUST_CERT === 'true',
    enableArithAbort:       true,
    useUTC:                 false,
    cancelTimeout:          15000, // Tăng thời gian chờ hủy từ 5s lên 15s để chống rớt socket khi SQL Server bận
  },
  pool: { max: 25, min: 2, idleTimeoutMillis: 30000 },
  connectionTimeout: parseInt(process.env.DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT || '30000', 10),
  requestTimeout:    parseInt(process.env.DB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT || '30000', 10)
};

let poolPromise = null;

async function getPool() {
  if (!poolPromise) {
    poolPromise = new sql.ConnectionPool(config)
      .connect()
      .then(pool => {
        console.log(`[DB] OK ket noi ${config.server}:${config.port}/${config.database}`);
        pool.on('error', err => {
          console.error('[DB] Pool error:', err.message);
          poolPromise = null;
        });
        return pool;
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('[DB] Loi ket noi:', err.message);
        poolPromise = null;
        throw err;
      });
  }
  return poolPromise;
}

async function closePool() {
  if (poolPromise) {
    try { const p = await poolPromise; await p.close(); } catch (_) {}
    finally { poolPromise = null; }
  }
}

async function testConnection() {
  try {
    const pool = await getPool();
    const r = await pool.request().query(
      `SELECT DB_NAME() AS db, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name`
    );
    const row = r.recordset[0];
    console.log(`     Database : ${row.db}`);
    console.log(`     Login    : ${row.login_name}`);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[DB] Test that bai:', err.message);
    return false;
  }
}

module.exports = { sql, getPool, closePool, testConnection };

const WebSocket = require('ws');

const agentConnections = new Map();
const pendingJobs = new Map();
const deviceEnrollProgress = new Map();

function setupFingerprintWS(httpServer, { BRIDGE_TOKEN }) {
  const wss = new WebSocket.Server({ server: httpServer, path: '/ws/fingerprint' });

  wss.on('connection', (ws, req) => {
    let deviceId;
    try {
      // 1. Kiểm tra Origin header chống Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH)
      const origin = req.headers['origin'];
      if (origin) {
        const isAllowed = origin.includes('localhost') || origin.includes('127.0.0.1') ||
                          (process.env.SERVER_IP && origin.includes(process.env.SERVER_IP)) ||
                          (process.env.SERVER_DOMAIN && origin.includes(process.env.SERVER_DOMAIN));
        if (!isAllowed) {
          throw new Error('Forbidden WebSocket Origin: ' + origin);
        }
      }

      // 2. Xác thực Bridge Token và Device ID
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost');
      const token = url.searchParams.get('bridge_token') || req.headers['x-bridge-token'];
      deviceId = url.searchParams.get('device_id') || req.headers['x-device-id'];
      if (!token || token !== BRIDGE_TOKEN) throw new Error('Invalid bridge token');
      if (!deviceId) throw new Error('Missing device_id');
    } catch (err) {
      try { ws.close(4001, err.message); } catch (_) {}
      return;
    }

    const existing = agentConnections.get(deviceId);
    if (existing && existing.ws !== ws) {
      try { existing.ws.close(4002, 'Replaced'); } catch (_) {}
    }

    agentConnections.set(deviceId, { ws, lastPing: Date.now(), connectedAt: Date.now() });
    console.log(`[WS] Agent online: ${deviceId} (total: ${agentConnections.size})`);

    ws.on('message', (raw) => {
      try {
        const msg = JSON.parse(raw.toString());
        if (msg.type === 'pong') {
          const c = agentConnections.get(deviceId);
          if (c) c.lastPing = Date.now();
        } else if (msg.type === 'scan_result' || msg.type === 'enroll_result') {
          const pending = pendingJobs.get(msg.job_id);
          if (pending && pending.deviceId === deviceId) {
            clearTimeout(pending.timeout);
            pendingJobs.delete(msg.job_id);

            if (msg.type === 'enroll_result') {
              deviceEnrollProgress.set(deviceId, {
                enrolling: false,
                step: msg.success ? 3 : (deviceEnrollProgress.get(deviceId)?.step || 0),
                total: 3,
                state: msg.success ? 'completed' : (msg.error || 'error'),
                updatedAt: Date.now(),
              });
            }

            pending.resolve(msg);
          }
        } else if (msg.type === 'enroll_progress') {
          const pending = pendingJobs.get(msg.job_id);
          if (pending) pending.latestStep = msg.step;

          deviceEnrollProgress.set(deviceId, {
            enrolling: true,
            step: Number(msg.step) || 0,
            total: Number(msg.total) || 3,
            state: Number(msg.step) >= 3 ? 'merging' : `captured_${msg.step}`,
            updatedAt: Date.now(),
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[WS] msg parse:', err.message);
      }
    });

    ws.on('close', () => {
      const current = agentConnections.get(deviceId);
      if (current && current.ws === ws) {
        agentConnections.delete(deviceId);
        console.log(`[WS] Agent offline: ${deviceId} (remaining: ${agentConnections.size})`);
      }
      deviceEnrollProgress.set(deviceId, {
        enrolling: false,
        step: 0,
        total: 3,
        state: 'offline',
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      });
      for (const [jobId, pending] of pendingJobs.entries()) {
        if (pending.deviceId === deviceId) {
          clearTimeout(pending.timeout);
          pendingJobs.delete(jobId);
          pending.reject(new Error('AGENT_DISCONNECTED'));
        }
      }
    });

    ws.on('error', () => {});
  });

  const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
    for (const [deviceId, c] of agentConnections.entries()) {
      if (Date.now() - c.lastPing > 90000) {
        try { c.ws.terminate(); } catch (_) {}
        agentConnections.delete(deviceId);
        continue;
      }
      try { c.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'ping' })); } catch (_) {}
    }
  }, 30000);

  wss.on('error', (err) => console.warn('[WSS error]:', err.message));
  wss.on('close', () => clearInterval(heartbeat));
  return wss;
}

function requestScan(deviceId, { template_b64, file_id }, timeoutMs = 45000) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const conn = agentConnections.get(deviceId);
    if (!conn) return reject(new Error('AGENT_OFFLINE'));

    const jobId = 'JOB-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      pendingJobs.delete(jobId);
      reject(new Error('SCAN_TIMEOUT'));
    }, timeoutMs);

    pendingJobs.set(jobId, { resolve, reject, timeout, deviceId });

    try {
      conn.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
        type: 'scan_request',
        job_id: jobId,
        file_id,
        template_plain_b64: template_b64,
        timeout_seconds: Math.max(10, Math.floor(timeoutMs / 1000) - 5),
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      pendingJobs.delete(jobId);
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}

function requestEnroll(deviceId, { user_id, timeout_seconds = 60 }, timeoutMs = 90000) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const conn = agentConnections.get(deviceId);
    if (!conn) return reject(new Error('AGENT_OFFLINE'));

    const jobId = 'ENR-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      pendingJobs.delete(jobId);
      deviceEnrollProgress.set(deviceId, {
        enrolling: false,
        step: 0,
        total: 3,
        state: 'timeout',
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      });
      reject(new Error('ENROLL_TIMEOUT'));
    }, timeoutMs);

    pendingJobs.set(jobId, { resolve, reject, timeout, deviceId, user_id });

    // Đánh dấu bắt đầu tiến trình enroll cho deviceId
    deviceEnrollProgress.set(deviceId, {
      enrolling: true,
      step: 0,
      total: 3,
      state: 'waiting_touch_1',
      jobId,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });

    try {
      conn.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
        type: 'enroll_request',
        job_id: jobId,
        user_id,
        timeout_seconds,
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      pendingJobs.delete(jobId);
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      deviceEnrollProgress.set(deviceId, {
        enrolling: false,
        step: 0,
        total: 3,
        state: 'error',
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      });
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}

function getEnrollProgress(deviceId) {
  if (deviceId && deviceEnrollProgress.has(deviceId)) {
    const p = deviceEnrollProgress.get(deviceId);
    if (Date.now() - p.updatedAt <= 120000) {
      return { enrolling: p.enrolling, step: p.step, total: p.total, state: p.state };
    }
  }
  // Nếu deviceId không truyền hoặc không khớp, tìm bất kỳ agent nào đang active enroll
  for (const [, p] of deviceEnrollProgress.entries()) {
    if (p.enrolling && Date.now() - p.updatedAt <= 120000) {
      return { enrolling: p.enrolling, step: p.step, total: p.total, state: p.state };
    }
  }
  return { enrolling: false, step: 0, total: 3, state: 'idle' };
}

function isAgentOnline(deviceId) {
  return agentConnections.has(deviceId);
}

function listAgents() {
  return Array.from(agentConnections.entries()).map(([id, c]) => ({
    device_id: id,
    connected_at: new Date(c.connectedAt).toISOString(),
    last_ping: new Date(c.lastPing).toISOString(),
  }));
}

module.exports = {
  setupFingerprintWS,
  requestScan,
  requestEnroll,
  getEnrollProgress,
  isAgentOnline,
  listAgents,
};

// backend/src/lecture-extended-routes.js
const express = require('express');
const { sql, getPool } = require('./db');

module.exports = function createLectureExtendedRoutes({
  requireAuth, requirePermission,
}) {
  const router = express.Router();

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // NHÓM 1: QUIZ CRUD (GV tự click khi trình chiếu)
  // Dùng LECTURE_QUIZ_QUESTION + LECTURE_QUIZ_ATTEMPT
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  router.get('/:lectureId/quiz', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_VIEW'),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const pool = await getPool();
        const r = await pool.request()
          .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.lectureId)
          .query(`SELECT * FROM LECTURE_QUIZ_QUESTION
                  WHERE lecture_id = @lid AND active = 1
                  ORDER BY question_order, question_id`);
        res.json({ total: r.recordset.length, items: r.recordset });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  router.post('/:lectureId/quiz', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_QUIZ_MANAGE'),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const {
          question_text, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d,
          correct_answer, explanation, slide_index, points, question_order,
        } = req.body;
        if (!question_text || !option_a || !option_b || !correct_answer) {
          return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Thiếu trường bắt buộc (question_text, option_a, option_b, correct_answer)' });
        }
        const pool = await getPool();
        // Verify ownership
        const own = await pool.request()
          .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.lectureId)
          .input('uid', sql.VarChar(50), req.user.user_id)
          .query(`SELECT 1 FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id=@lid AND author_id=@uid`);
        if (own.recordset.length === 0) {
          return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ tác giả bài giảng mới được tạo Quiz' });
        }

        const qid = 'QZ-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6).toUpperCase();
        await pool.request()
          .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), qid)
          .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.lectureId)
          .input('ord', sql.Int, question_order || 1)
          .input('qt', sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX), question_text)
          .input('a', sql.NVarChar(500), option_a)
          .input('b', sql.NVarChar(500), option_b)
          .input('c', sql.NVarChar(500), option_c || null)
          .input('d', sql.NVarChar(500), option_d || null)
          .input('ans', sql.Char(1), correct_answer)
          .input('exp', sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX), explanation || null)
          .input('slide', sql.Int, slide_index || null)
          .input('pts', sql.Int, points || 1)
          .query(`INSERT INTO LECTURE_QUIZ_QUESTION
                  (question_id, lecture_id, question_order, question_text,
                   option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d,
                   correct_answer, explanation, slide_index, points)
                  VALUES (@id, @lid, @ord, @qt, @a, @b, @c, @d, @ans, @exp, @slide, @pts);
                  UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE SET quiz_count = quiz_count + 1 WHERE lecture_id = @lid;`);
        res.json({ success: true, question_id: qid });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  router.put('/:lectureId/quiz/:questionId', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_QUIZ_MANAGE'),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const pool = await getPool();
        const own = await pool.request()
          .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.lectureId)
          .input('uid', sql.VarChar(50), req.user.user_id)
          .query(`SELECT 1 FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id=@lid AND author_id=@uid`);
        if (own.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Không có quyền' });

        const { question_text, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d,
                correct_answer, explanation, slide_index, points, question_order } = req.body;
        await pool.request()
          .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.questionId)
          .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.lectureId)
          .input('ord', sql.Int, question_order || 1)
          .input('qt', sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX), question_text)
          .input('a', sql.NVarChar(500), option_a)
          .input('b', sql.NVarChar(500), option_b)
          .input('c', sql.NVarChar(500), option_c || null)
          .input('d', sql.NVarChar(500), option_d || null)
          .input('ans', sql.Char(1), correct_answer)
          .input('exp', sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX), explanation || null)
          .input('slide', sql.Int, slide_index || null)
          .input('pts', sql.Int, points || 1)
          .query(`UPDATE LECTURE_QUIZ_QUESTION
                  SET question_order=@ord, question_text=@qt, option_a=@a, option_b=@b,
                      option_c=@c, option_d=@d, correct_answer=@ans, explanation=@exp,
                      slide_index=@slide, points=@pts, updated_at=GETDATE()
                  WHERE question_id=@id AND lecture_id=@lid`);
        res.json({ success: true });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  router.delete('/:lectureId/quiz/:questionId', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_QUIZ_MANAGE'),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const pool = await getPool();
        const own = await pool.request()
          .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.lectureId)
          .input('uid', sql.VarChar(50), req.user.user_id)
          .query(`SELECT 1 FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id=@lid AND author_id=@uid`);
        if (own.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Không có quyền' });

        await pool.request()
          .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.questionId)
          .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.lectureId)
          .query(`UPDATE LECTURE_QUIZ_QUESTION SET active=0 WHERE question_id=@id AND lecture_id=@lid;
                  UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE SET quiz_count = CASE WHEN quiz_count>0 THEN quiz_count-1 ELSE 0 END
                  WHERE lecture_id=@lid;`);
        res.json({ success: true });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  // GV bấm "Kích hoạt Quiz" khi đang dạy — lưu attempt
  router.post('/schedules/:scheduleId/quiz/:questionId/activate', requireAuth,
    requirePermission('SCHEDULE_START'), async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const { student_count_yes = 0, student_count_no = 0 } = req.body;
        const pool = await getPool();
        const r = await pool.request()
          .input('sid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.scheduleId)
          .input('qid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.questionId)
          .input('yes', sql.Int, student_count_yes)
          .input('no', sql.Int, student_count_no)
          .query(`INSERT INTO LECTURE_QUIZ_ATTEMPT (question_id, schedule_id, student_count_yes, student_count_no)
                  VALUES (@qid, @sid, @yes, @no);
                  SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS id;`);
        res.json({ success: true, attempt_id: r.recordset[0].id });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // NHÓM 2: XEM BÀI GIẢNG CÙNG KHOA (GV đồng nghiệp)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  router.get('/faculty/:facultyUnitId', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_VIEW'),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const pool = await getPool();
        const userUnit = await pool.request()
          .input('uid', sql.VarChar(50), req.user.user_id)
          .query(`SELECT unit_id FROM [USER] WHERE user_id = @uid`);
        const myUnit = userUnit.recordset[0]?.unit_id;
        const canViewAll = (req.user.permissions || []).includes('SCHEDULE_MONITOR_ALL');
        if (!canViewAll && myUnit !== req.params.facultyUnitId) {
          return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ xem được bài giảng của khoa mình' });
        }

        const r = await pool.request()
          .input('fac', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.facultyUnitId)
          .input('clr', sql.Int, req.user.clearance_level_id || 1)
          .query(`
            SELECT l.lecture_id, l.lecture_code, l.title, l.status,
                   l.security_level_id, l.content_type, l.quiz_count,
                   l.created_at, l.updated_at,
                   s.name AS subject_name,
                   u.full_name AS author_name, u.[rank] AS author_rank,
                   un.name AS faculty_name
            FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE l
            JOIN SUBJECT s ON s.subject_id = l.subject_id
            JOIN [USER] u ON u.user_id = l.author_id
            JOIN UNIT un ON un.unit_id = l.faculty_unit_id
            WHERE l.faculty_unit_id = @fac
              AND l.status = 'PUBLISHED'
              AND l.security_level_id <= @clr
            ORDER BY l.updated_at DESC
          `);
        res.json({ total: r.recordset.length, items: r.recordset });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // NHÓM 3: LIVE MONITOR NÂNG CAO (BGH / Trưởng BM)
  // ⚠️ REQUIREMENT — TEACHING_SCHEDULE phải có cột:
  //    slide_index INT NULL, slide_total INT NULL, scorm_progress FLOAT NULL
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  router.get('/schedules/monitor', requireAuth, requirePermission('SCHEDULE_MONITOR_ALL'),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const pool = await getPool();
        const r = await pool.request().query(`
          SELECT
            s.schedule_id, s.lecture_id, s.presenter_id, s.class_id,
            s.venue_name, s.student_count, s.start_time, s.status,
            s.session_type, s.slide_index, s.slide_total, s.scorm_progress,
            DATEDIFF(MINUTE, s.start_time, GETDATE()) AS duration_minutes,
            CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, s.start_time, GETDATE()) > 240 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hanging,
            l.lecture_code, l.title AS lecture_title, l.content_type,
            l.security_level_id, sl.name AS security_name,
            sub.name AS subject_name,
            u.full_name AS presenter_name, u.[rank] AS presenter_rank, u.[position] AS presenter_position,
            un.name AS faculty_unit_name,
            c.class_name, c.course_year,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_QUIZ_ATTEMPT a
             WHERE a.schedule_id = s.schedule_id) AS quiz_activated_count,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_QUIZ_QUESTION q
             WHERE q.lecture_id = s.lecture_id AND q.active = 1) AS quiz_total_count
          FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE s
          JOIN DIGITAL_LECTURE l ON l.lecture_id = s.lecture_id
          JOIN SUBJECT sub ON sub.subject_id = l.subject_id
          JOIN SECURITY_LEVEL sl ON sl.level_id = l.security_level_id
          JOIN [USER] u ON u.user_id = s.presenter_id
          LEFT JOIN UNIT un ON un.unit_id = u.unit_id
          JOIN TRAINING_CLASS c ON c.class_id = s.class_id
          WHERE s.status = 'ONGOING'
          ORDER BY s.start_time DESC
        `);
        res.json({
          total: r.recordset.length,
          server_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          items: r.recordset.map(row => ({ ...row, is_hanging: row.is_hanging === 1 })),
        });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  router.put('/schedules/:scheduleId/slide', requireAuth, requirePermission('SCHEDULE_START'),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const { slide_index, slide_total, scorm_progress } = req.body;
        const pool = await getPool();
        await pool.request()
          .input('sid', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.scheduleId)
          .input('uid', sql.VarChar(50), req.user.user_id)
          .input('si',  sql.Int, slide_index)
          .input('st',  sql.Int, slide_total ?? null)
          .input('sp',  sql.Float, scorm_progress ?? null)
          .query(`UPDATE TEACHING_SCHEDULE
                  SET slide_index=@si, slide_total=@st, scorm_progress=@sp
                  WHERE schedule_id=@sid AND presenter_id=@uid AND status='ONGOING'`);
        res.json({ success: true });
      } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
    });

  return router;
};

// SỬA TOÀN BỘ NỘI DUNG FILE THÀNH:

const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const AdmZip = require('adm-zip');
const { getModuleUploadPath, MODULES, sanitizeFolderName } = require('./storage-helper');

function extractZipSafely(zip, targetDir, maxTotalBytes = 300 * 1024 * 1024) {
    // ... (Giữ nguyên toàn bộ logic cũ của extractZipSafely)
    const entries = zip.getEntries();
    const resolvedTarget = path.resolve(targetDir);
    let totalUncompressedSize = 0;

    for (const entry of entries) {
        const entryName = entry.entryName;
        const destPath = path.resolve(resolvedTarget, entryName);
        if (!destPath.startsWith(resolvedTarget + path.sep) && destPath !== resolvedTarget) {
            throw new Error(`Phát hiện đường dẫn Zip Slip bất hợp pháp: "${entryName}"`);
        }
        totalUncompressedSize += entry.header.size;
        if (totalUncompressedSize > maxTotalBytes) {
            throw new Error(`Gói vượt quá giới hạn giải nén tối đa cho phép (${Math.round(maxTotalBytes / (1024 * 1024))}MB)`);
        }
        const ext = path.extname(entryName).toLowerCase();
        if (['.exe', '.bat', '.cmd', '.sh', '.ps1', '.vbs', '.py', '.php', '.jar', '.com'].includes(ext)) {
            throw new Error(`Gói chứa định dạng file thực thi bị cấm: ${ext}`);
        }
    }
    zip.extractAllTo(resolvedTarget, true);
}

async function extractAndParse({ lectureId, pendingPath, title, createdAt }) {
    const projectRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '..'); 
    const zipAbsPath = path.resolve(projectRoot, pendingPath);
    
    // ✅ TẠO THƯ MỤC: bai-giang-so/YYYY/MM/Ten_Bai_Giang_MaLecture
    const folderName = `${sanitizeFolderName(title || 'Bai_Giang')}_${lectureId}`;
    const date = createdAt ? new Date(createdAt) : new Date();
    const { absPath: targetDir, relPath: baseRelPath } = getModuleUploadPath(MODULES.LECTURES, date, folderName);

    if (!fs.existsSync(zipAbsPath)) {
        throw new Error(`Không tìm thấy file ZIP tại đường dẫn: ${zipAbsPath}`);
    }

    fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
    const zip = new AdmZip(zipAbsPath);
    extractZipSafely(zip, targetDir);

    let launchFile = 'index.html';
    let scormVersion = '1.2';
    let contentType = 'HTML5';

    const manifestPath = path.join(targetDir, 'imsmanifest.xml');
    
    if (fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) {
        const { XMLParser } = require('fast-xml-parser');
        const xml = fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8');
        const parser = new XMLParser({ ignoreAttributes: false, attributeNamePrefix: '@_' });
        const doc = parser.parse(xml);
        const resources = doc?.manifest?.resources?.resource;
        const list = Array.isArray(resources) ? resources : [resources];
        const first = list.find((r) => r && r['@_href']);
        if (first) {
            launchFile = first['@_href'];
            scormVersion = doc?.manifest?.metadata?.schemaversion || '1.2';
            contentType = 'SCORM';
        }
    } else {
        const rootFiles = fs.readdirSync(targetDir);
        if (rootFiles.includes('demo.html') && (rootFiles.includes('rlprez.js') || rootFiles.includes('player'))) {
            launchFile = 'demo.html';
        } else {
            const commonEntries = ['story.html', 'index.html', 'launch.html', 'story_html5.html', 'demo.html'];
            const foundEntry = commonEntries.find(f => rootFiles.includes(f));
            if (foundEntry) {
                launchFile = foundEntry;
            } else {
                const anyHtml = rootFiles.find(f => f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.html'));
                if (anyHtml) {
                    launchFile = anyHtml;
                } else {
                    throw new Error('Không tìm thấy file khởi chạy (.html) hoặc imsmanifest.xml trong gói học liệu.');
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Trả về đường dẫn tương đối cho DB: uploads/bai-giang-so/YYYY/MM/Ten_Bai_Giang_MaLecture/index.html
    const relativeEntryPoint = `${baseRelPath}/${launchFile}`.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    
    try {
        fs.unlinkSync(zipAbsPath); // Xóa file ZIP tạm
    } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Không thể xóa file ZIP tạm:', err.message);
    }

    return {
        entry_point: relativeEntryPoint,
        content_type: contentType,
        launchFile: launchFile,
        scormVersion: scormVersion
    };
}

module.exports = {
    extractAndParse
};

// backend/src/lecture-routes.js
// ============================================================
// Phân hệ Bài giảng số v1.2 — KHỚP SCHEMA THỰC TẾ
// - Bảng: DIGITAL_LECTURE, TEACHING_SCHEDULE, SCORM_TRACKING
// - Permission: LECTURE_VIEW / CREATE / APPROVE / DELETE / SCHEDULE_START
// - Role: ROL-01 Admin, ROL-02 BGH, ROL-07 Giảng viên
// - Trưởng bộ môn: nhận diện qua ROL-06 hoặc position
// - Live Monitor: LECTURE_VIEW + role (Admin/Commander/DeptHead)
// - Teaching History: query TEACHING_SCHEDULE status COMPLETED/CANCELLED
// - SCORM: commit vào SCORM_TRACKING
// ============================================================
const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');         
const { sql, getPool } = require('./db');

const HANGING_THRESHOLD_MINUTES = 4 * 60; // 4 giờ

module.exports = function createLectureRoutes({
  requireAuth,
  requirePermission,
  writeAccessLog,
  getClientIp,
}) {
  const router = express.Router();

  const getIp = (req) => {
    if (typeof getClientIp === 'function') return getClientIp(req);
    const raw = req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] || req.socket?.remoteAddress || req.ip || '';
    let ip = String(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw).split(',')[0].trim();
    if (ip.startsWith('::ffff:')) ip = ip.slice(7);
    if (ip === '::1') ip = '127.0.0.1';
    return ip;
  };

  const logAudit = (req, action, note, fileId = null) => {
    if (typeof writeAccessLog !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
    return writeAccessLog({
      userId: req.user?.user_id || 'GUEST',
      fileId,
      action,
      ip: getIp(req),
      note: String(note || '').slice(0, 500),
    }).catch(() => {});
  };

  // ─── HELPERS ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function getUserUnitId(pool, userId) {
    const r = await pool.request()
      .input('u', sql.VarChar(50), userId)
      .query(`SELECT unit_id FROM [USER] WHERE user_id = @u`);
    return r.recordset[0]?.unit_id || null;
  }

  async function resolveUserRoles(pool, user) {
    if (!user?.user_id) return user?.roles || [];
    try {
      const r = await pool.request()
        .input('u', sql.VarChar(50), user.user_id)
        .query(`SELECT role_id FROM USER_ROLE
                WHERE user_id = @u AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > GETDATE())`);
      return r.recordset.map((x) => x.role_id);
    } catch { return user?.roles || []; }
  }

  async function isDeptHead(pool, user) {
    const roles = await resolveUserRoles(pool, user);
    if (roles.includes('ROL-06')) return true;
    const pos = String(user.position || '').toLowerCase();
    return pos.includes('trưởng bộ môn') || pos.includes('trưởng khoa')
        || pos.includes('chủ nhiệm khoa') || pos.includes('trưởng phòng');
  }

  // Hàm phụ kiểm tra quyền Chỉ huy (Chỉ Admin, BGH, Trưởng BM mới được Lưu trữ/Khôi phục)
  async function requireCommander(pool, req, res) {
    const roles = await resolveUserRoles(pool, req.user);
    if (roles.includes('ROL-01') || roles.includes('ROL-02') || roles.includes('ROL-06')) {
      return true;
    }
    res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ Chỉ huy cấp trên mới có quyền lưu trữ/khôi phục bài giảng.' });
    return false;
  }

  // Check cột có tồn tại (dùng cho fallback nếu chưa chạy migration v2)
  async function hasColumn(pool, table, column) {
    const r = await pool.request()
      .input('t', sql.VarChar(100), table)
      .input('c', sql.VarChar(100), column)
      .query(`SELECT 1 AS ok FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
              WHERE TABLE_NAME=@t AND COLUMN_NAME=@c`);
    return r.recordset.length > 0;
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PHẦN 1 — CATALOGS
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  router.get('/catalogs/subjects', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const result = await pool.request().query(`
        SELECT s.*, u.name AS faculty_name
        FROM SUBJECT s
        LEFT JOIN UNIT u ON u.unit_id = s.faculty_unit_id
        WHERE s.active = 1
        ORDER BY s.name
      `);
      res.json({ items: result.recordset });
    } catch (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); }
  });

  router.get('/catalogs/classes', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const result = await pool.request().query(`
        SELECT c.*, u.name AS unit_name
        FROM TRAINING_CLASS c
        JOIN UNIT u ON u.unit_id = c.unit_id
        WHERE c.active = 1
        ORDER BY c.class_name
      `);
      res.json({ items: result.recordset });
    } catch (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); }
  });

  // Gợi ý giảng đường từ lịch sử (vì không có bảng HALL)
  router.get('/catalogs/venues', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const result = await pool.request().query(`
        SELECT DISTINCT venue_name, COUNT(*) AS usage_count
        FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE
        WHERE venue_name IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(venue_name)) <> ''
        GROUP BY venue_name
        ORDER BY usage_count DESC, venue_name
      `);
      res.json({ items: result.recordset });
    } catch (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); }
  });

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PHẦN 2 — LECTURE CRUD + APPROVAL 2 TẦNG
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  router.get('/', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_VIEW'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const r = pool.request();
      const userId = req.user.user_id;
      const roles = await resolveUserRoles(pool, req.user);
      const isAdmin = roles.includes('ROL-01');
      const isCommander = roles.includes('ROL-02');
      const deptHead = await isDeptHead(pool, req.user);
      const userUnit = await getUserUnitId(pool, userId);
      const clearance = req.user.clearance_level_id || 1;

      let query = `
        SELECT l.lecture_id, l.lecture_code, l.title, l.subject_id, l.author_id,
               l.faculty_unit_id, l.security_level_id, l.content_type, l.scorm_entry_point,
               l.document_id, l.status, l.reject_reason, l.created_at, l.updated_at,
               s.name AS subject_name,
               u.full_name AS author_name, u.[rank] AS author_rank,
               un.name AS faculty_name,
               sl.name AS security_name,
               sch.class_name,
               sch.venue_name
        FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE l
        JOIN SUBJECT s ON s.subject_id = l.subject_id
        JOIN [USER] u ON u.user_id = l.author_id
        JOIN UNIT un ON un.unit_id = l.faculty_unit_id
        JOIN SECURITY_LEVEL sl ON sl.level_id = l.security_level_id
        OUTER APPLY (
          SELECT TOP 1 ts.venue_name, tc.class_name
          FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE ts
          LEFT JOIN TRAINING_CLASS tc ON tc.class_id = ts.class_id
          WHERE ts.lecture_id = l.lecture_id
          ORDER BY CASE WHEN ts.status = 'ONGOING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ts.start_time DESC
        ) sch
        WHERE l.security_level_id <= @clearance
      `;
      r.input('clearance', sql.Int, clearance);

      if (!isAdmin && !isCommander) {
        if (deptHead && userUnit) {
          query += ` AND (l.faculty_unit_id = @userUnit OR l.author_id = @selfId)`;
          r.input('userUnit', sql.VarChar(50), userUnit);
          r.input('selfId', sql.VarChar(50), userId);
        } else {
          query += ` AND (l.status = 'PUBLISHED' OR l.author_id = @selfId`;
          r.input('selfId', sql.VarChar(50), userId);
          if (userUnit) {
            query += ` OR l.faculty_unit_id = @userUnit`;
            r.input('userUnit', sql.VarChar(50), userUnit);
          }
          query += `)`;
        }
      }

      if (req.query.status) {
        query += ` AND l.status = @status`;
        r.input('status', sql.VarChar(30), req.query.status);
      } else {
        // Mặc định: Ẩn các bài giảng đã bị xóa mềm
        query += ` AND l.status != 'DELETED'`;
      }
      if (req.query.subject_id)       { query += ` AND l.subject_id = @subId`;      r.input('subId', sql.VarChar(50), req.query.subject_id); }
      if (req.query.faculty_unit_id)  { query += ` AND l.faculty_unit_id = @fac`;   r.input('fac', sql.VarChar(50), req.query.faculty_unit_id); }
      if (req.query.q)                { query += ` AND (l.title LIKE N'%' + @q + N'%' OR l.lecture_code LIKE '%' + @q + '%')`; r.input('q', sql.NVarChar(200), req.query.q); }

      query += ` ORDER BY l.created_at DESC`;
      const result = await r.query(query);
      res.json({ total: result.recordset.length, items: result.recordset });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[GET /api/lectures]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  router.get('/:id', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_VIEW'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const r = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id)
        .query(`
          SELECT l.*, s.name AS subject_name,
                 u.full_name AS author_name, u.[rank] AS author_rank, u.[position] AS author_position,
                 un.name AS faculty_name, sl.name AS security_name,
                 sch.class_name, sch.venue_name
          FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE l
          JOIN SUBJECT s ON s.subject_id = l.subject_id
          JOIN [USER] u ON u.user_id = l.author_id
          JOIN UNIT un ON un.unit_id = l.faculty_unit_id
          JOIN SECURITY_LEVEL sl ON sl.level_id = l.security_level_id
          OUTER APPLY (
            SELECT TOP 1 ts.venue_name, tc.class_name
            FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE ts
            LEFT JOIN TRAINING_CLASS tc ON tc.class_id = ts.class_id
            WHERE ts.lecture_id = l.lecture_id
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN ts.status = 'ONGOING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ts.start_time DESC
          ) sch
          WHERE l.lecture_id = @id
        `);
      if (r.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy bài giảng' });
      const lec = r.recordset[0];
      if (lec.security_level_id > (req.user.clearance_level_id || 1)) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Không đủ cấp bảo mật để xem bài giảng này' });
      }
      res.json(lec);
    } catch (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); }
  });

  router.post('/', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_CREATE'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const {
        title, subject_id, lecture_code, security_level_id,
        content_type, scorm_entry_point, document_id,
      } = req.body || {};
      if (!title || !subject_id) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Thiếu tiêu đề hoặc môn học' });

      const validTypes = ['PDF', 'HTML5', 'SCORM'];
      const ctype = String(content_type || 'PDF').toUpperCase();
      if (!validTypes.includes(ctype)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Loại nội dung không hợp lệ' });
      if (ctype === 'SCORM' && !scorm_entry_point) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'SCORM yêu cầu scorm_entry_point' });
      }

      const pool = await getPool();
      const lectureId = 'LEC-' + Date.now();
      const authorId = req.user.user_id;
      const facultyUnitId = await getUserUnitId(pool, authorId);
      if (!facultyUnitId) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Tài khoản chưa được gán khoa/bộ môn' });

      await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .input('code', sql.NVarChar(100), lecture_code || lectureId)
        .input('title', sql.NVarChar(500), title)
        .input('subject_id', sql.VarChar(50), subject_id)
        .input('author_id', sql.VarChar(50), authorId)
        .input('faculty_unit_id', sql.VarChar(50), facultyUnitId)
        .input('security_level_id', sql.Int, security_level_id || 2)
        .input('content_type', sql.VarChar(20), ctype)
        .input('scorm_entry_point', sql.NVarChar(255), scorm_entry_point || null)
        .input('document_id', sql.VarChar(50), document_id || null)
        .query(`
          INSERT INTO DIGITAL_LECTURE (
            lecture_id, lecture_code, title, subject_id, author_id, faculty_unit_id,
            security_level_id, content_type, scorm_entry_point, document_id
          ) VALUES (
            @id, @code, @title, @subject_id, @author_id, @faculty_unit_id,
            @security_level_id, @content_type, @scorm_entry_point, @document_id
          )
        `);

      await logAudit(req, 'LECTURE_CREATE', `Tạo bài giảng: ${title}`, lectureId);
      res.json({ success: true, lecture_id: lectureId });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.message?.includes('UQ') || err.message?.includes('PRIMARY KEY')) {
        return res.status(409).json({ error: 'Mã bài giảng đã tồn tại' });
      }
      console.error('[POST /api/lectures]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  router.put('/:id', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_CREATE'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const lectureId = req.params.id;
      const pool = await getPool();
      const check = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .query(`SELECT status, author_id FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id = @id`);
      if (check.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy bài giảng' });
      const lec = check.recordset[0];
      if (lec.author_id !== req.user.user_id && !(req.user.roles || []).includes('ROL-01')) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ tác giả mới có quyền sửa bài giảng này' });
      }
      if (!['DRAFT', 'REJECTED'].includes(lec.status)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Không thể sửa bài giảng đang chờ duyệt hoặc đã xuất bản' });
      }

      const { title, subject_id, security_level_id, content_type, scorm_entry_point, document_id } = req.body || {};
      const ctype = String(content_type || 'PDF').toUpperCase();
      if (!['PDF', 'HTML5', 'SCORM'].includes(ctype)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Loại nội dung không hợp lệ' });
      }

      await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .input('title', sql.NVarChar(500), title)
        .input('subject_id', sql.VarChar(50), subject_id)
        .input('security_level_id', sql.Int, security_level_id)
        .input('content_type', sql.VarChar(20), ctype)
        .input('scorm_entry_point', sql.NVarChar(255), scorm_entry_point || null)
        .input('document_id', sql.VarChar(50), document_id || null)
        .query(`
          UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE
          SET title = @title, subject_id = @subject_id, security_level_id = @security_level_id,
              content_type = @content_type, scorm_entry_point = @scorm_entry_point,
              document_id = @document_id, updated_at = GETDATE()
          WHERE lecture_id = @id
        `);
      await logAudit(req, 'LECTURE_UPDATE', `Sửa bài giảng ${lectureId}`, lectureId);
      res.json({ success: true });
    } catch (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); }
  });

  // 1. API Xoá mềm — CHẶN Ở BACKEND: chỉ Chỉ huy cấp trên
  router.delete('/:id', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_DELETE'), async (req, res) => {

        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .query(`UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE lecture_id = @id`);

      if (r.rowsAffected[0] === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy bài giảng' });

      await logAudit(req, 'LECTURE_SOFT_DELETE', `Chuyển bài giảng ${lectureId} vào thùng rác`, lectureId);
      res.json({ success: true, message: 'Đã chuyển bài giảng vào thùng rác' });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  // Gửi duyệt
  router.post('/:id/submit', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_CREATE'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const check = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id)
        .query(`SELECT status, author_id FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id = @id`);
      if (check.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy' });
      if (check.recordset[0].author_id !== req.user.user_id) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ tác giả mới có quyền gửi duyệt' });
      }
      if (!['DRAFT', 'REJECTED'].includes(check.recordset[0].status)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Trạng thái không hợp lệ để gửi duyệt' });
      }
      await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id)
        .query(`UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE SET status='PENDING_FACULTY', reject_reason=NULL, updated_at=GETDATE() WHERE lecture_id=@id`);
      await logAudit(req, 'LECTURE_SUBMIT', `Gửi duyệt bài giảng ${req.params.id}`, req.params.id);
      res.json({ success: true, message: 'Đã gửi duyệt lên Khoa/Bộ môn' });
    } catch (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); }
  });

  // 2. API KHÔI PHỤC BÀI GIẢNG TỪ THÙNG RÁC
  router.post('/:id/restore', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_DELETE'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      if (!(await requireCommander(pool, req, res))) return;

      const lectureId = req.params.id;
      const r = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .query(`UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE SET status = 'DRAFT', updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE lecture_id = @id AND status = 'DELETED'`);

      if (r.rowsAffected[0] === 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Bài giảng không ở trạng thái đã xóa' });

      await logAudit(req, 'LECTURE_RESTORE', `Khôi phục bài giảng ${lectureId} từ thùng rác`, lectureId);
      res.json({ success: true });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });


  // 3. API XÓA VĨNH VIỄN (CHỈ DÀNH CHO BÀI GIẢNG ĐÃ Ở TRONG THÙNG RÁC)
  router.delete('/:id/purge', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_DELETE'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      if (!(await requireCommander(pool, req, res))) return;

      const lectureId = req.params.id;

      // Lấy thông tin để xóa file vật lý
      const check = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .query(`SELECT title, created_at, status, pending_scorm_path FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id = @id`);

      if (check.recordset.length === 0 || check.recordset[0].status !== 'DELETED') {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Chỉ có thể xóa vĩnh viễn bài giảng đang ở trong thùng rác' });
      }
      const lec = check.recordset[0];

      // Xóa DB (Cascade sẽ xóa Quiz, SCORM Package)
      await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .query(`DELETE FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id = @id`);

      // Xóa File Vật Lý
      const { getModuleUploadPath, MODULES, sanitizeFolderName } = require('./storage-helper');
      const folderName = `${sanitizeFolderName(lec.title || 'Bai_Giang')}_${lectureId}`;
      const date = lec.created_at ? new Date(lec.created_at) : new Date();
      const { absPath: targetDir } = getModuleUploadPath(MODULES.LECTURES, date, folderName);

      if (fs.existsSync(targetDir)) fs.rmSync(targetDir, { recursive: true, force: true });

      if (lec.pending_scorm_path) {
        const pendingAbs = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', lec.pending_scorm_path);
        if (fs.existsSync(pendingAbs)) fs.unlinkSync(pendingAbs);
      }

      await logAudit(req, 'LECTURE_PURGE', `Xóa vĩnh viễn bài giảng ${lectureId} khỏi hệ thống`, lectureId);
      res.json({ success: true });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });


  // Duyệt 2 tầng
  router.post('/:id/approve', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_APPROVE'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const lectureId = req.params.id;
      const check = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .query(`SELECT status, faculty_unit_id, content_type,
                       pending_scorm_path, scorm_entry_point,
                       title, created_at, document_id
                FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id = @id`);                 // [1]
      if (check.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy bài giảng' });

      const lec = check.recordset[0];
      const roles = await resolveUserRoles(pool, req.user);
      const isAdmin = roles.includes('ROL-01');
      const isCommander = roles.includes('ROL-02');
      const deptHead = await isDeptHead(pool, req.user);

      let nextStatus = '';
      if (lec.status === 'PENDING_FACULTY') {
        if (!isAdmin && !isCommander && !deptHead) {
          return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ Trưởng bộ môn hoặc BGH mới duyệt cấp Khoa' });
        }
        if (!isAdmin && !isCommander && deptHead) {
          const userUnit = await getUserUnitId(pool, req.user.user_id);
          if (userUnit && lec.faculty_unit_id !== userUnit) {
            return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ được duyệt bài giảng thuộc khoa/bộ môn của mình' });
          }
        }
        nextStatus = 'PENDING_TRAINING';
      } else if (lec.status === 'PENDING_TRAINING') {
        if (!isAdmin && !isCommander) {
          return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ BGH/Admin mới duyệt cấp Trường' });
        }
        nextStatus = 'PUBLISHED';
      } else {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Trạng thái không hợp lệ để duyệt' });
      }

      // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      // [2] GIẢI NÉN GÓI ZIP (SCORM/HTML5) TRƯỚC KHI SET PUBLISHED
      // Chỉ chạy ở tầng 2 (PUBLISHED) — tầng 1 (PENDING_TRAINING) chưa
      // cần extract vì còn phải chờ Chỉ huy cấp Trường duyệt.
      // Fail → trả 500, giữ nguyên PENDING_TRAINING, KHÔNG publish nửa vời.
      // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      let extractedEntryPoint = null;
      let extractedContentType = null;

      if (nextStatus === 'PUBLISHED') {
        if (lec.pending_scorm_path) {
          try {
            const { extractAndParse } = require('./lecture-package-helper');
            const out = await extractAndParse({
              lectureId,
              pendingPath: lec.pending_scorm_path,
              title:     lec.title,
              createdAt: lec.created_at,
            });
            console.log(`[lecture approve] Extracted ${lectureId} → ${out.entry_point} (${out.content_type})`);
            extractedEntryPoint = out.entry_point;
            extractedContentType = out.content_type;
          } catch (ex) {
            console.error(`[lecture approve] Extract failed ${lectureId}:`, ex);
            return res.status(500).json({
              error: 'Không giải nén được gói học liệu: ' + ex.message,
              code: 'EXTRACT_FAILED',
            });
          }
        } else if (lec.content_type === 'PDF') {
          if (!lec.document_id) {
            return res.status(400).json({
              error: 'Bài giảng PDF chưa có tệp tài liệu đính kèm (thiếu document_id)',
              code: 'NO_DOCUMENT',
            });
          }
        } else if (!lec.scorm_entry_point) {
          // Fallback tự động nhận diện trong thư mục chuẩn mới:
          // uploads/bai-giang-so/YYYY/MM/<Ten_Bai_Giang>_<MaLecture>/
          const { getModuleUploadPath, MODULES, sanitizeFolderName } = require('./storage-helper');
          const folderName = `${sanitizeFolderName(lec.title || 'Bai_Giang')}_${lectureId}`; // Thêm _lectureId
          const date = lec.created_at ? new Date(lec.created_at) : new Date();
          const { absPath: lectureDir, relPath: baseRelPath } =
            getModuleUploadPath(MODULES.LECTURES, date, folderName);

          if (fs.existsSync(lectureDir)) {
            const files = fs.readdirSync(lectureDir);
            const commonEntries = ['index.html', 'story.html', 'launch.html', 'demo.html'];
            const entry = commonEntries.find(f => files.includes(f))
              || files.find(f => f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.html'));
            if (entry) {
              extractedEntryPoint = `${baseRelPath}/${entry}`.replace(/\\/g, '/');
            }
          }
          if (!extractedEntryPoint) {
            // Không có ZIP pending và cũng chưa có entry point → không thể publish
            return res.status(400).json({
              error: 'Bài giảng chưa có gói học liệu (thiếu pending_scorm_path và scorm_entry_point)',
              code: 'NO_PACKAGE',
            });
          }
        }
      }

      let updateSql = `UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE SET status=@st, reject_reason=NULL, updated_at=GETDATE()`;
      const updateReq = pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), lectureId)
        .input('st', sql.VarChar(30), nextStatus);

      if (extractedEntryPoint) {
        updateSql += `, scorm_entry_point=@ep, pending_scorm_path=NULL`;
        updateReq.input('ep', sql.NVarChar(500), extractedEntryPoint);
        if (extractedContentType) {
          updateSql += `, content_type=@ct`;
          updateReq.input('ct', sql.VarChar(20), extractedContentType);
        }
      }

      updateSql += ` WHERE lecture_id=@id`;
      await updateReq.query(updateSql);

      await logAudit(
        req,
        nextStatus === 'PUBLISHED' ? 'LECTURE_PUBLISHED' : 'LECTURE_APPROVED_TIER',
        `Duyệt bài giảng ${lectureId} → ${nextStatus}`,
        lectureId
      );
      res.json({ success: true, new_status: nextStatus });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[POST approve]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  router.post('/:id/reject', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_APPROVE'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const reason = String(req.body?.reason || '').trim();
      if (!reason) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Cần nhập lý do từ chối' });
      const pool = await getPool();
      const check = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id)
        .query(`SELECT status FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id = @id`);
      if (check.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy' });
      if (!['PENDING_FACULTY', 'PENDING_TRAINING'].includes(check.recordset[0].status)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Trạng thái không hợp lệ để từ chối' });
      }
      await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id)
        .input('reason', sql.NVarChar(500), reason.slice(0, 500))
        .query(`UPDATE DIGITAL_LECTURE SET status='REJECTED', reject_reason=@reason, updated_at=GETDATE() WHERE lecture_id=@id`);
      await logAudit(req, 'LECTURE_REJECTED', `Từ chối ${req.params.id}: ${reason}`, req.params.id);
      res.json({ success: true });
    } catch (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }); }
  });

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PHẦN 3 — TEACHING SCHEDULE (Ca giảng dạy)
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  // Bắt đầu ca
  router.post('/schedules/start', requireAuth, requirePermission('SCHEDULE_START'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { lecture_id, class_id, venue_name, student_count, session_type, note } = req.body || {};
      const stype = String(session_type || 'TEACHER_LED').toUpperCase();

      if (!lecture_id || !class_id || !venue_name) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Thiếu bài giảng, lớp hoặc giảng đường' });
      }
      if (!['TEACHER_LED', 'SELF_STUDY'].includes(stype)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Loại ca dạy không hợp lệ' });
      }
      const sc = parseInt(student_count, 10);
      if (!Number.isFinite(sc) || sc < 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Sĩ số không hợp lệ (>=0)' });
      }

      const pool = await getPool();

      // Kiểm tra bài giảng
      const lecCheck = await pool.request()
        .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), lecture_id)
        .query(`SELECT status, title FROM DIGITAL_LECTURE WHERE lecture_id = @lid`);
      if (lecCheck.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy bài giảng' });
      const lecture = lecCheck.recordset[0];
      if (lecture.status !== 'PUBLISHED') {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Chỉ có thể mở ca với bài giảng đã PUBLISHED' });
      }

      // Kiểm tra giảng đường trống
      const busy = await pool.request()
        .input('v', sql.NVarChar(100), venue_name)
        .query(`SELECT TOP 1 schedule_id FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE
                WHERE venue_name = @v AND status = 'ONGOING'`);
      if (busy.recordset.length > 0) {
        return res.status(409).json({
          error: 'Giảng đường đang có ca giảng dạy khác chưa kết thúc',
          ongoing_schedule_id: busy.recordset[0].schedule_id,
        });
      }

      // Kiểm tra cột mở rộng (nếu có migration v2)
      const hasSessionType = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'session_type');
      const hasCurrentPage = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'current_page');
      const hasNote = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'note');

      const scheduleId = 'SCH-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6).toUpperCase();
      const presenterId = req.user.user_id;

      const columns = ['schedule_id', 'lecture_id', 'presenter_id', 'class_id', 'venue_name', 'student_count', 'start_time', 'status'];
      const values  = ['@id', '@lid', '@pid', '@cid', '@v', '@cnt', 'GETDATE()', "'ONGOING'"];
      const request = pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), scheduleId)
        .input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), lecture_id)
        .input('pid', sql.VarChar(50), presenterId)
        .input('cid', sql.VarChar(50), class_id)
        .input('v', sql.NVarChar(100), venue_name)
        .input('cnt', sql.Int, sc);

      if (hasSessionType) {
        columns.push('session_type'); values.push('@stype');
        request.input('stype', sql.VarChar(20), stype);
      }
      if (hasCurrentPage) {
        columns.push('current_page'); values.push('1');
      }
      if (hasNote) {
        columns.push('note'); values.push('@note');
        request.input('note', sql.NVarChar(500), (note || '').slice(0, 500) || null);
      }

      await request.query(`
        INSERT INTO TEACHING_SCHEDULE (${columns.join(', ')})
        VALUES (${values.join(', ')})
      `);

      await logAudit(
        req,
        'SCHEDULE_START',
        `Bắt đầu ca ${stype}: "${lecture.title}" | sĩ số=${sc} | venue=${venue_name}`,
        lecture_id
      );

      res.json({
        success: true,
        schedule_id: scheduleId,
        session_type: hasSessionType ? stype : 'TEACHER_LED',
        start_time: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[POST /api/lectures/schedules/start]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });



  

  // Cập nhật tiến độ bài giảng trực tiếp (slide_index, slide_total, scorm_progress)
  router.put('/schedules/:id/progress', requireAuth, requirePermission('SCHEDULE_START'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const rawIndex = req.body?.slide_index ?? req.body?.current_page;
      const slideIndex = parseInt(rawIndex, 10);
      const slideTotal = req.body?.slide_total ? parseInt(req.body.slide_total, 10) : null;
      let scormProgress = req.body?.scorm_progress !== undefined && req.body?.scorm_progress !== null
        ? parseFloat(req.body.scorm_progress)
        : null;

      if (scormProgress === null && Number.isFinite(slideIndex) && slideTotal && slideTotal > 0) {
        scormProgress = Math.min(1, +(slideIndex / slideTotal).toFixed(4));
      }

      if (!Number.isFinite(slideIndex) || slideIndex < 1) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'slide_index hoặc current_page không hợp lệ' });
      }

      const pool = await getPool();
      const check = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id)
        .query(`SELECT presenter_id, status FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE WHERE schedule_id = @id`);
      if (check.recordset.length === 0) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Không tìm thấy ca' });
      const s = check.recordset[0];
      if (s.status !== 'ONGOING') return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Ca không ở trạng thái ONGOING' });
      if (s.presenter_id !== req.user.user_id && !(req.user.roles || []).includes('ROL-01')) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ người mở ca mới cập nhật được tiến độ' });
      }

      const hasSlideIndex = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'slide_index');
      const hasCurrentPage = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'current_page');

      const updates = [];
      const r = pool.request().input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id);

      if (hasSlideIndex) {
        updates.push('slide_index = @si', 'slide_total = @st', 'scorm_progress = @sp');
        r.input('si', sql.Int, slideIndex);
        r.input('st', sql.Int, slideTotal);
        r.input('sp', sql.Float, scormProgress);
      }
      if (hasCurrentPage) {
        updates.push('current_page = @pg');
        r.input('pg', sql.Int, slideIndex);
      }

      if (updates.length > 0) {
        await r.query(`UPDATE TEACHING_SCHEDULE SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE schedule_id = @id`);
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        slide_index: slideIndex,
        slide_total: slideTotal,
        scorm_progress: scormProgress,
        current_page: slideIndex,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[PUT /schedules/:id/progress]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  // Kết thúc ca — LÕI XỬ LÝ CHUNG
  //   isForce = false → chỉ người mở ca (hoặc Admin) mới được kết thúc
  //   isForce = true  → bỏ qua check presenter (dùng cho Force End bởi Chỉ huy/Admin)
  async function endScheduleInternal({ scheduleId, actorUser, isForce = false }) {
    const pool = await getPool();
    const r = await pool.request()
      .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), scheduleId)
      .query(`SELECT s.*, l.title AS lecture_title
              FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE s
              JOIN DIGITAL_LECTURE l ON l.lecture_id = s.lecture_id
              WHERE s.schedule_id = @id`);

    if (r.recordset.length === 0) { const e = new Error('Không tìm thấy ca'); e.code = 'NOT_FOUND'; throw e; }
    const s = r.recordset[0];
    if (s.status !== 'ONGOING') { const e = new Error('Ca không ở trạng thái ONGOING'); e.code = 'BAD_STATE'; throw e; }

    // Nếu KHÔNG PHẢI là Force End, thì phải là người tạo ca (hoặc Admin)
    const isAdmin = (actorUser.roles || []).includes('ROL-01');
    if (!isForce && s.presenter_id !== actorUser.user_id && !isAdmin) {
      const e = new Error('Không có quyền kết thúc ca này'); e.code = 'FORBIDDEN'; throw e;
    }

    const endTime = new Date();
    const durationMinutes = Math.max(0, Math.floor((endTime - new Date(s.start_time)) / 60000));

    await pool.request()
      .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), scheduleId)
      .input('et', sql.DateTime, endTime)
      .query(`UPDATE TEACHING_SCHEDULE SET status='COMPLETED', end_time=@et WHERE schedule_id=@id`);

    return { schedule_id: scheduleId, duration_minutes: durationMinutes, lecture_title: s.lecture_title };
  }

  // Người mở ca tự kết thúc ca của mình
  router.post('/schedules/:id/end', requireAuth, requirePermission('SCHEDULE_START'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const result = await endScheduleInternal({
        scheduleId: req.params.id,
        actorUser: req.user,
      });
      await logAudit(
        req,
        'SCHEDULE_END',
        `Kết thúc ca ${result.schedule_id} (${result.duration_minutes} phút)`
      );
      res.json({ success: true, ...result });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code === 'NOT_FOUND') return res.status(404).json({ error: err.message });
      if (err.code === 'BAD_STATE') return res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
      if (err.code === 'FORBIDDEN') return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message });
      console.error('[POST schedule end]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  // API Buộc kết thúc (Dành cho Chỉ huy/Admin xử lý ca treo của người khác)
  router.post('/schedules/:id/force-end', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const roles = await resolveUserRoles(pool, req.user);
      if (!roles.includes('ROL-01') && !roles.includes('ROL-02') && !roles.includes('ROL-06')) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ Chỉ huy/Admin mới có quyền buộc kết thúc ca của người khác.' });
      }

      const result = await endScheduleInternal({
        scheduleId: req.params.id,
        actorUser: req.user, // Đã được check quyền ở trên
        isForce: true,
      });

      await logAudit(req, 'SCHEDULE_FORCE_END',
        `Chỉ huy/Admin buộc kết thúc ca ${result.schedule_id} (${result.duration_minutes} phút)`);
      res.json({ success: true, ...result });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code === 'NOT_FOUND') return res.status(404).json({ error: err.message });
      if (err.code === 'BAD_STATE') return res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
      if (err.code === 'FORBIDDEN') return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message });
      console.error('[POST force-end]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  // Live Monitor — LECTURE_VIEW + role check
  router.get('/schedules/live', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_VIEW'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const roles = await resolveUserRoles(pool, req.user);
      const isAdmin = roles.includes('ROL-01');
      const isCommander = roles.includes('ROL-02');
      const deptHead = await isDeptHead(pool, req.user);

      if (!isAdmin && !isCommander && !deptHead) {
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Chỉ BGH / Admin / Trưởng bộ môn mới được giám sát giảng đường' });
      }

      const hasSessionType = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'session_type');
      const hasCurrentPage = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'current_page');
      const hasSlideIndex = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'slide_index');
      const hasSlideTotal = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'slide_total');
      const hasScormProgress = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'scorm_progress');
      const hasNote = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'note');

      const r = pool.request();
      let query = `
        SELECT s.schedule_id, s.lecture_id, s.presenter_id, s.class_id,
               s.venue_name, s.student_count, s.start_time, s.status,
               ${hasSessionType ? 's.session_type' : "'TEACHER_LED' AS session_type"},
               ${hasSlideIndex ? 's.slide_index' : 'NULL AS slide_index'},
               ${hasSlideTotal ? 's.slide_total' : 'NULL AS slide_total'},
               ${hasScormProgress ? 's.scorm_progress' : 'NULL AS scorm_progress'},
               ${hasCurrentPage ? 's.current_page' : 'COALESCE(s.slide_index, 1) AS current_page'},
               ${hasNote ? 's.note' : 'NULL AS note'},
               l.title AS lecture_title, l.content_type,
               sub.name AS subject_name,
               u.full_name AS presenter_name, u.[rank] AS presenter_rank, u.[position] AS presenter_position,
               c.class_name, un.name AS unit_name, un.unit_id AS unit_id,
               FLOOR(DATEDIFF(SECOND, s.start_time, GETDATE()) / 60.0) AS duration_minutes,
               CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, s.start_time, GETDATE()) > ${HANGING_THRESHOLD_MINUTES}
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hanging
        FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE s
        JOIN DIGITAL_LECTURE l ON l.lecture_id = s.lecture_id
        JOIN SUBJECT sub ON sub.subject_id = l.subject_id
        JOIN [USER] u ON u.user_id = s.presenter_id
        JOIN TRAINING_CLASS c ON c.class_id = s.class_id
        LEFT JOIN UNIT un ON un.unit_id = c.unit_id
        WHERE s.status = 'ONGOING'
      `;

      if (!isAdmin && !isCommander && deptHead) {
        const userUnit = await getUserUnitId(pool, req.user.user_id);
        if (userUnit) {
          query += ` AND un.unit_id = @userUnit`;
          r.input('userUnit', sql.VarChar(50), userUnit);
        } else {
          query += ` AND 1=0`;
        }
      }

      if (req.query.venue_name)   { query += ` AND s.venue_name = @venue`;   r.input('venue', sql.NVarChar(100), req.query.venue_name); }
      if (req.query.class_id)     { query += ` AND s.class_id = @cid`;       r.input('cid', sql.VarChar(50), req.query.class_id); }
      if (hasSessionType && req.query.session_type) {
        query += ` AND s.session_type = @stype`;
        r.input('stype', sql.VarChar(20), req.query.session_type);
      }

      query += ` ORDER BY s.start_time DESC`;
      const result = await r.query(query);

      res.json({
        total: result.recordset.length,
        items: result.recordset.map((row) => ({ ...row, is_hanging: row.is_hanging === 1 })),
        hanging_threshold_minutes: HANGING_THRESHOLD_MINUTES,
        server_time: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[GET /api/lectures/schedules/live]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  // History — query chính TEACHING_SCHEDULE
  router.get('/schedules/history', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_VIEW'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const roles = await resolveUserRoles(pool, req.user);
      const isAdmin = roles.includes('ROL-01');
      const isCommander = roles.includes('ROL-02');
      const deptHead = await isDeptHead(pool, req.user);
      const hasSessionType = await hasColumn(pool, 'TEACHING_SCHEDULE', 'session_type');

      const r = pool.request();
      let query = `
        SELECT s.schedule_id, s.lecture_id, s.presenter_id, s.class_id,
               s.venue_name, s.student_count, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.status,
               ${hasSessionType ? 's.session_type' : "'TEACHER_LED' AS session_type"},
               l.title AS lecture_title, sub.name AS subject_name,
               u.full_name AS presenter_name, u.[rank] AS presenter_rank,
               c.class_name, un.name AS unit_name,
               FLOOR(DATEDIFF(SECOND, s.start_time, s.end_time) / 60.0) AS duration_minutes
        FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE s
        JOIN DIGITAL_LECTURE l ON l.lecture_id = s.lecture_id
        JOIN SUBJECT sub ON sub.subject_id = l.subject_id
        JOIN [USER] u ON u.user_id = s.presenter_id
        JOIN TRAINING_CLASS c ON c.class_id = s.class_id
        LEFT JOIN UNIT un ON un.unit_id = c.unit_id
        WHERE s.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') AND s.end_time IS NOT NULL
      `;

      if (!isAdmin && !isCommander) {
        if (deptHead) {
          const userUnit = await getUserUnitId(pool, req.user.user_id);
          if (userUnit) {
            query += ` AND un.unit_id = @userUnit`;
            r.input('userUnit', sql.VarChar(50), userUnit);
          } else {
            query += ` AND 1=0`;
          }
        } else {
          query += ` AND s.presenter_id = @selfId`;
          r.input('selfId', sql.VarChar(50), req.user.user_id);
        }
      }

      if (req.query.presenter_id) { query += ` AND s.presenter_id = @pid`;   r.input('pid', sql.VarChar(50), req.query.presenter_id); }
      if (req.query.lecture_id)   { query += ` AND s.lecture_id = @lid`;     r.input('lid', sql.VarChar(50), req.query.lecture_id); }
      if (req.query.venue_name)   { query += ` AND s.venue_name = @v`;       r.input('v', sql.NVarChar(100), req.query.venue_name); }
      if (req.query.from)         { query += ` AND s.start_time >= @from`;   r.input('from', sql.Date, req.query.from); }
      if (req.query.to)           { query += ` AND s.end_time <= @to`;       r.input('to', sql.Date, req.query.to); }

      query += ` ORDER BY s.start_time DESC`;
      const result = await r.query(query);

      const kpi = result.recordset.reduce(
        (a, x) => {
          a.total_sessions += 1;
          a.total_minutes += x.duration_minutes || 0;
          a.total_students += x.student_count || 0;
          if (x.session_type === 'SELF_STUDY') a.self_study_sessions += 1;
          else a.teacher_led_sessions += 1;
          return a;
        },
        { total_sessions: 0, total_minutes: 0, total_students: 0, self_study_sessions: 0, teacher_led_sessions: 0 }
      );

      res.json({
        total: result.recordset.length,
        items: result.recordset,
        kpi: { ...kpi, total_hours: +(kpi.total_minutes / 60).toFixed(2) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[GET /api/lectures/schedules/history]', err);
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

      // API nhẹ: Lấy thông tin 1 ca dạy cụ thể (Dùng để phục hồi khi F5)
  router.get('/schedules/:id', requireAuth, requirePermission('LECTURE_VIEW'), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const pool = await getPool();
      const r = await pool.request()
        .input('id', sql.VarChar(50), req.params.id)
        .query(`
          SELECT s.*, l.title AS lecture_title, l.content_type, c.class_name 
          FROM TEACHING_SCHEDULE s 
          JOIN DIGITAL_LECTURE l ON l.lecture_id = s.lecture_id

      // Chỉ người tạo ca, BGH hoặc Admin mới được xem
      if (session.presenter_id !== req.user.user_id && !(req.user.roles || []).includes('ROL-01') && !(req.user.roles || []).includes('ROL-02')) {
