              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Đang lưu trữ...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isEdit ? 'Xác nhận & Cập nhật' : 'Xác nhận & Lưu trữ'}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Modal Quét Vân Tay Xác Thực Cho Cấp 3+ Trong Chế Độ Sửa ── */}
      <FingerprintScanModal
        key="fingerprint-scan-modal-upload"
        open={showScanModal}
        fileId={document?.file_id || ''}
        onSuccess={(token) => {
          setShowScanModal(false);
          const validToken = token || '';
          setFingerprintToken(validToken || null);
          if (validToken && document?.file_id && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            try {
              sessionStorage.setItem(`qk7_fp_token_${document.file_id}`, validToken);
            } catch (e) {}
          }
          if (document) {
            loadOriginalDocumentPdf(document.file_id, validToken || null);
          }
        }}
        onCancel={() => {
          setShowScanModal(false);
        }}
      />
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

/* <!-- Lucian UX/UI Prompt #032 · MIT License (c) 2026 Seokwoooo · https://lucianlabs.dev/uxui-prompt/#032 --> */
import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { UploadCloud, Check, X, HardDrive, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatFileSize } from '../../utils/formatFileSize';

export interface DropzoneProps {
  selectedFile: File | null;
  onFileSelect: (file: File | null) => void;
  accept?: string;
  maxSizeBytes?: number;
}

export const Dropzone: React.FC<DropzoneProps> = ({
  selectedFile,
  onFileSelect,
  accept = '.pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx',
  maxSizeBytes = 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB
}) => {
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
  const [uploadStatus, setUploadStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error'>('idle');

  // Quản lý thanh tiến trình mượt mà khi tệp được chọn
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedFile) {
      setUploadProgress(0);
      setUploadStatus('idle');
      return;
    }

    setUploadProgress(15);
    setUploadStatus('uploading');

    let current = 15;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      current += 20 + Math.random() * 15;
      if (current >= 100) {
        current = 100;
        setUploadProgress(100);
        setUploadStatus('done');
        clearInterval(interval);
      } else {
        setUploadProgress(current);
      }
    }, 60);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [selectedFile]);

  const handleRetry = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!selectedFile) return;
    setUploadProgress(10);
    setUploadStatus('uploading');
    let current = 10;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      current += 25;
      if (current >= 100) {
        current = 100;
        setUploadProgress(100);
        setUploadStatus('done');
        clearInterval(interval);
      } else {
        setUploadProgress(current);
      }
    }, 60);
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(false);
    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) {
      const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
      if (file.size > maxSizeBytes) {
        alert('File vượt quá giới hạn 50MB!');
        setUploadStatus('error');
        return;
      }
      onFileSelect(file);
    }
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      const file = e.target.files[0];
      if (file.size > maxSizeBytes) {
        alert('File vượt quá giới hạn 50MB!');
        setUploadStatus('error');
        return;
      }
      onFileSelect(file);
    }
  };

  const handleZoneClick = () => {
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      fileInputRef.current.click();
    }
  };

  // Xác định định dạng tệp và màu badge chuyên nghiệp
  const getFileBadgeInfo = (filename?: string) => {
    if (!filename) {
      return {
        ext: 'FILE',
        bg: 'bg-slate-500/15 border-slate-500/30 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300',
      };
    }
    const ext = filename.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';
    if (ext === 'pdf') {
      return {
        ext: 'PDF',
        bg: 'bg-rose-500/15 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',
      };
    }
    if (ext === 'doc' || ext === 'docx') {
      return {
        ext: 'DOCX',
        bg: 'bg-blue-500/15 border-blue-500/30 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400',
      };
    }
    if (ext === 'xls' || ext === 'xlsx') {
      return {
        ext: 'XLSX',
        bg: 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
      };
    }
    return {
      ext: ext.toUpperCase() || 'FILE',
      bg: 'bg-slate-500/15 border-slate-500/30 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300',
    };
  };

  const badgeInfo = getFileBadgeInfo(selectedFile?.name);

  return (
    <div className="u032-wrapper space-y-3">
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept={accept}
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        className="hidden"
      />

      {/* Khung Drop Zone .u032 với hiệu ứng Marching Border & Floating Orb */}
      <div
        onDragOver={handleDragOver}
        onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
        onClick={handleZoneClick}
        className={`u032-zone flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center transition-all ${
          selectedFile ? 'p-4 sm:p-5' : 'p-6 sm:p-7'
        } ${isDragging ? 'is-dragging' : ''}`}
      >
        {/* Lớp SVG viền đứt khúc chạy động stroke-dasharray="8 7" */}
        <svg className="u032-dash" aria-hidden="true">
          <rect
            x="1"
            y="1"
            width="calc(100% - 2px)"
            height="calc(100% - 2px)"
            rx="17"
            ry="17"
          />
        </svg>

        {/* Biểu tượng Orb mây bay nổi bật */}
        <div className="u032-orb-container mb-2">
          <div className="u032-glow" aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className="u032-orb">
            <UploadCloud className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 stroke-[2.2]" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Nhãn chỉ dẫn theo chuẩn Trường Quân Sự Quân Khu 7 */}
        <div className="relative z-2 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
          <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
            {selectedFile ? 'Nhấn để thay đổi tệp' : 'Nhấn để chọn tệp'}
          </span>{' '}
          {selectedFile ? 'hoặc kéo thả tệp mới vào đây' : 'hoặc kéo thả vào đây'}
        </div>
        <p className="relative z-2 text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-1">
          Hỗ trợ PDF, DOCX, XLSX (Dung lượng tối đa 50MB)
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Danh sách hiển thị tiến trình tải tệp .u032-list */}
      {selectedFile && (
        <div className="u032-list">
          <div className="u032-item">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 min-w-0">
                {/* Format Badge */}
                <div
                  className={`w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] tracking-wide shrink-0 shadow-xs ${badgeInfo.bg}`}
                >
                  {badgeInfo.ext}
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-[320px]">
                      {selectedFile.name}
                    </p>
                    {uploadStatus === 'done' && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 shrink-0">
                        <Check className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[3]" /> Sẵn sàng
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {uploadStatus === 'uploading' && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono font-medium shrink-0">
                        {Math.round(uploadProgress)}%
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {uploadStatus === 'error' && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 shrink-0">
                        Lỗi đường truyền
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                    <HardDrive className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{formatFileSize(selectedFile.size)}</span>
                    <span>•</span>
                    <span className="font-mono uppercase">{badgeInfo.ext}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action buttons */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                {uploadStatus === 'error' && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleRetry}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/30 transition cursor-pointer"
                    title="Thử lại"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Thử lại</span>
                  </button>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    onFileSelect(null);
                    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
                  }}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                  title="Gỡ bỏ tệp"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Thanh tiến trình Progress Bar */}
            <div className="u032-progress-track">
              <div
                className={`u032-progress-bar ${uploadStatus === 'error' ? 'is-error' : ''}`}
                style={{ width: `${uploadProgress}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as pdfjsLib from 'pdfjs-dist';
import pdfWorker from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url';
import 'pdfjs-dist/web/pdf_viewer.css';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = pdfWorker;

const EMPTY_STROKES: HighlighterStroke[] = [];

export interface HighlighterStroke {
  color: string;
  width: number;
  points: { x: number; y: number }[];
}

export interface PdfPagesViewerProps {
  blobUrl: string;
  fileId: string;
  securityLevel?: number;
  isHighlighterActive: boolean;
  highlighterColor: string;
  onStrokeCountChange?: (count: number) => void;
  highlighterRef?: React.MutableRefObject<{ undo: () => void; clear: () => void; getStrokeCount: () => number } | null>;
}

export const PdfPagesViewer: React.FC<PdfPagesViewerProps> = React.memo(({
  blobUrl,
  fileId,
  securityLevel = 1,
  isHighlighterActive,
  highlighterColor,
  onStrokeCountChange,
  highlighterRef,
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [numPages, setNumPages] = useState<number>(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [pageDimensions, setPageDimensions] = useState<{ width: number; height: number }[]>([]);
  
  // Lưu trữ nét vẽ theo từng trang: Map<pageNumber, HighlighterStroke[]>
  const [pageStrokes, setPageStrokes] = useState<Record<number, HighlighterStroke[]>>({});

  const storageKey = `qk7_pdf_highlighter_${fileId}`;
  const isHighSecurity = securityLevel >= 3;

  // Load nét vẽ từ localStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        setPageStrokes(parsed);
        const total = (Object.values(parsed) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, list: any) => sum + (list?.length || 0), 0);
        onStrokeCountChange?.(total);
      } else {
        setPageStrokes({});
        onStrokeCountChange?.(0);
      }
    } catch {
      setPageStrokes({});
      onStrokeCountChange?.(0);
    }
  }, [fileId, storageKey, onStrokeCountChange]);

  // Expose Undo và Clear cho thanh công cụ
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!highlighterRef) return;
    highlighterRef.current = {
      undo: () => {
        setPageStrokes((prev) => {
          const pageNums = Object.keys(prev).map(Number).sort((a, b) => b - a);
          for (const p of pageNums) {
            const list = prev[p];
            if (list && list.length > 0) {
              const newList = [...list];
              newList.pop();
              const nextState = { ...prev, [p]: newList };
              try {
                localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(nextState));
              } catch (_) {}
              const total = (Object.values(nextState) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, l: any) => sum + (l?.length || 0), 0);
              onStrokeCountChange?.(total);
              return nextState;
            }
          }
          return prev;
        });
      },
      clear: () => {
        setPageStrokes({});
        try {
          localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
        } catch (_) {}
        onStrokeCountChange?.(0);
      },
      getStrokeCount: () => {
        return (Object.values(pageStrokes) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, list: any) => sum + (list?.length || 0), 0);
      },
    };
  }, [highlighterRef, pageStrokes, storageKey, onStrokeCountChange]);

  // Phím tắt Ctrl + Z để Hoàn tác
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (e.key === 'z' || e.key === 'Z') && !e.shiftKey) {
        if (highlighterRef?.current) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          highlighterRef.current.undo();
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true);
  }, [highlighterRef]);

  // Tải PDF bằng pdfjsLib
  const pdfDocRef = useRef<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);

    (async () => {
      try {
        const loadingTask = pdfjsLib.getDocument({
          url: blobUrl,
          cMapUrl: '/cmaps/',
          cMapPacked: true,
          standardFontDataUrl: '/standard_fonts/',
        });
        const doc = await loadingTask.promise;
        if (isCancelled) return;

        pdfDocRef.current = doc;
        setNumPages(doc.numPages);

        // Lấy kích thước trang
        const dims: { width: number; height: number }[] = [];
        for (let i = 1; i <= doc.numPages; i++) {
          const page = await doc.getPage(i);
          const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1.0 });
          dims.push({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
        }
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setPageDimensions(dims);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[PdfPagesViewer] Error loading document with pdfjs:', err);
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, [blobUrl]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`w-full h-full overflow-y-auto bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 flex flex-col items-center py-6 px-2 sm:px-4 relative transition-colors ${
        isHighSecurity ? 'select-none' : 'select-text'
      }`}
      style={{
        scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
      }}
    >
      <style>{`
        .textLayer {
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          overflow: hidden;
          opacity: 1;
          line-height: 1;
          -webkit-text-size-adjust: none;
          text-size-adjust: none;
          forced-color-adjust: none;
          transform-origin: 0 0;
          z-index: 10;
        }
        .textLayer :is(span, br) {
          color: transparent;
          position: absolute;
          white-space: pre;
          cursor: text;
          transform-origin: 0% 0%;
        }
        .textLayer ::selection {
          background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45) !important;
          color: transparent !important;
        }
        .textLayer ::-moz-selection {
          background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45) !important;
          color: transparent !important;
        }
      `}</style>

      {loading && (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-slate-300 space-y-3 my-auto">
          <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-emerald-500" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium">Đang khởi tạo hiển thị trang văn bản chất lượng cao...</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {!loading && numPages > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center space-y-6 w-full max-w-4xl">
          {Array.from({ length: numPages }, (_, index) => {
            const pageNum = index + 1;
            const originalDim = pageDimensions[index] || { width: 595, height: 842 };
            return (
              <SinglePdfPage
                key={`pdf-page-${pageNum}`}
                pdfDoc={pdfDocRef.current}
                pageNum={pageNum}
                securityLevel={securityLevel}
                originalWidth={originalDim.width}
                originalHeight={originalDim.height}
                isHighlighterActive={isHighlighterActive}
                highlighterColor={highlighterColor}
                strokes={pageStrokes[pageNum] || EMPTY_STROKES}
                onSaveStroke={(newStroke) => {
                  setPageStrokes((prev) => {
                    const currentList = prev[pageNum] || EMPTY_STROKES;
                    const nextList = [...currentList, newStroke];
                    const nextState = { ...prev, [pageNum]: nextList };
                    try {
                      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(nextState));
                    } catch (_) {}
                    const total = (Object.values(nextState) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, l: any) => sum + (l?.length || 0), 0);
                    onStrokeCountChange?.(total);
                    return nextState;
                  });
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

interface SinglePdfPageProps {
  pdfDoc: any;
  pageNum: number;
  securityLevel: number;
  originalWidth: number;
  originalHeight: number;
  isHighlighterActive: boolean;
  highlighterColor: string;
  strokes: HighlighterStroke[];
  onSaveStroke: (stroke: HighlighterStroke) => void;
}

const SinglePdfPage: React.FC<SinglePdfPageProps> = React.memo(({
  pdfDoc,
  pageNum,
  securityLevel,
  originalWidth,
  originalHeight,
  isHighlighterActive,
  highlighterColor,
  strokes,
  onSaveStroke,
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pdfCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const textLayerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const highlightCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const [displayWidth, setDisplayWidth] = useState<number>(originalWidth);
  const [displayHeight, setDisplayHeight] = useState<number>(originalHeight);

  const isLowSecurity = securityLevel <= 2; // Cấp 1 Công khai & Cấp 2 Nội bộ

  // Vẽ lại toàn bộ strokes của trang này lên highlightCanvas
  const redrawStrokes = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.restore();

    strokes.forEach((stroke) => {
      if (!stroke.points || stroke.points.length === 0) return;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42;
      ctx.strokeStyle = stroke.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = stroke.width;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

      ctx.beginPath();
      const p0 = stroke.points[0];
      ctx.moveTo(p0.x, p0.y);

      if (stroke.points.length === 1) {
        ctx.lineTo(p0.x + 0.1, p0.y + 0.1);
      } else {
        for (let i = 1; i < stroke.points.length; i++) {
          const p = stroke.points[i];
          ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    });
  }, [strokes]);

  // Render trang PDF và TextLayer bằng pdf.js
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDoc) return;
    let renderTask: any = null;

    (async () => {
      try {
        const page = await pdfDoc.getPage(pageNum);
        const parentWidth = containerRef.current?.parentElement?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const targetWidth = Math.min(880, Math.max(360, parentWidth - 48));
        const scale = targetWidth / originalWidth;
        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });

        const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

        setDisplayWidth(viewport.width);
        setDisplayHeight(viewport.height);

        // 1. Render Canvas PDF
        const pdfCanvas = pdfCanvasRef.current;
        if (pdfCanvas) {
          pdfCanvas.width = viewport.width * dpr;
          pdfCanvas.height = viewport.height * dpr;
          pdfCanvas.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
          pdfCanvas.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;

          const ctx = pdfCanvas.getContext('2d');
          if (ctx) {
            ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
            renderTask = page.render({
              canvasContext: ctx,
              viewport: viewport,
            });
            await renderTask.promise;
          }
        }

        // 2. Render TextLayer (Cho phép bôi đen, sao chép Ctrl+C, chuột phải ở Cấp 1 & 2)
        const textContainer = textLayerRef.current;
        if (textContainer && isLowSecurity) {
          textContainer.innerHTML = '';
          textContainer.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
          textContainer.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;
          textContainer.style.setProperty('--scale-factor', `${viewport.scale}`);

          const textContent = await page.getTextContent();
          const textLayer = new (pdfjsLib as any).TextLayer({
            textContentSource: textContent,
            container: textContainer,
            viewport: viewport,
          });
          await textLayer.render();
        }

        // 3. Chuẩn bị Canvas Highlight
        const hlCanvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
        if (hlCanvas) {
          hlCanvas.width = viewport.width * dpr;
          hlCanvas.height = viewport.height * dpr;
          hlCanvas.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
          hlCanvas.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;

          const hlCtx = hlCanvas.getContext('2d');
          if (hlCtx) {
            hlCtx.scale(dpr, dpr);
          }
          redrawStrokes();
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (e.name !== 'RenderingCancelledException') {
          console.warn(`[Page ${pageNum}] Render error:`, e);
        }
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      if (renderTask) {
        try {
          renderTask.cancel();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    };
  }, [pdfDoc, pageNum, originalWidth, originalHeight, isLowSecurity]);

  // Vẽ lại khi strokes thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    redrawStrokes();
  }, [redrawStrokes]);

  // Thao tác vẽ bút dạ quang trên trang này
  const isDrawingRef = useRef(false);
  const currentPointsRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number }[]>([]);

  const getPos = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: e.clientX - rect.left,
      y: e.clientY - rect.top,
    };
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isHighlighterActive) return;
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    isDrawingRef.current = true;
    const pos = getPos(e);
    currentPointsRef.current = [pos];

    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42;
    ctx.strokeStyle = highlighterColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 20;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pos.x, pos.y);
    ctx.lineTo(pos.x + 0.1, pos.y + 0.1);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isHighlighterActive || !isDrawingRef.current) return;
    const pos = getPos(e);
    const pts = currentPointsRef.current;
    const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    if (Math.hypot(pos.x - last.x, pos.y - last.y) < 2) return;

    pts.push(pos);

    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42;
    ctx.strokeStyle = highlighterColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 20;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(last.x, last.y);
    ctx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isHighlighterActive || !isDrawingRef.current) return;
    isDrawingRef.current = false;
    try {
      e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (currentPointsRef.current.length > 0) {
      const newStroke: HighlighterStroke = {
        color: highlighterColor,
        width: 20,
        points: [...currentPointsRef.current],
      };
      currentPointsRef.current = [];
      onSaveStroke(newStroke);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative bg-white shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-slate-900/10 dark:ring-white/10 rounded-sm transition-transform duration-150 overflow-hidden ${
        isLowSecurity ? 'select-text' : 'select-none'
      }`}
      style={{
        width: displayWidth,
        height: displayHeight,
      }}
    >
      {/* 📄 Lớp 1: Canvas PDF hiển thị nét chữ & Watermark */}
      <canvas ref={pdfCanvasRef} className="block w-full h-full pointer-events-none select-none" />

      {/* 🔤 Lớp 2: TextLayer DOM (Cho phép bôi đen, sao chép Ctrl+C và dán Ctrl+V ở Cấp 1 & 2) */}
      {isLowSecurity && (
        <div
          ref={textLayerRef}
          className={`textLayer ${
            isHighlighterActive ? 'pointer-events-none select-none' : 'pointer-events-auto select-text'
          }`}
          style={{
            zIndex: 10,
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* 🖊️ Lớp 3: Canvas Bút dạ quang (ĂN CỨNG THEO TÀI LIỆU GIỐNG WATERMARK) */}
      <canvas
        ref={highlightCanvasRef}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
        onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
        onPointerCancel={handlePointerUp}
        className={`absolute inset-0 w-full h-full ${
          isHighlighterActive
            ? 'cursor-crosshair opacity-100 pointer-events-auto z-20'
            : 'pointer-events-none opacity-90 z-5'
        }`}
        style={{
          touchAction: isHighlighterActive ? 'none' : 'auto',
        }}
      />

      {/* Số trang góc dưới */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-2 right-3 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-slate-400 bg-slate-50/80 border border-slate-200 pointer-events-none z-20">
        Trang {pageNum}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { documentService } from '../../services/documentService';
import { toast } from '../common/Toast';
import { ApprovalDiffModal, DiffProposalData } from './ApprovalDiffModal';

export interface PendingProposalItem extends DiffProposalData {
  file_id: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export interface PendingProposalsModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  proposals: PendingProposalItem[];
  canApprove: boolean; // Chỉ huy hoặc Admin
  onClose: () => void;
  onRefresh: () => void;
}

export const PendingProposalsModal: React.FC<PendingProposalsModalProps> = ({
  open,
  proposals,
  canApprove,
  onClose,
  onRefresh,
}) => {
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!open) return null;

  // Trường hợp không có đề xuất nào đang chờ duyệt
  if (proposals.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-6 text-center space-y-4 shadow-2xl relative">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-1.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-7 h-7" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              Không Có Đề Xuất Chờ Duyệt
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Hiện tại không có yêu cầu chỉnh sửa hay chuẩn hóa văn bản nào đang chờ phê duyệt. Toàn bộ hồ sơ đã được đồng bộ.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Đóng thông báo
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const activeIndex = Math.min(selectedIndex, proposals.length - 1);
  const currentProposal = proposals[activeIndex] || proposals[0];

  const handleApprove = async (proposalId: string, note?: string) => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const res = await documentService.approveProposal(
        proposalId,
        note || 'Chỉ huy / Quản trị viên đã phê duyệt & chuẩn hóa'
      );
      toast.success(res.message || 'Đã phê duyệt đề xuất thành công', {
        title: 'PHÊ DUYỆT THÀNH CÔNG',
        badge: 'APPROVED',
      });
      onRefresh();
      if (proposals.length <= 1) {
        onClose();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error('Lỗi phê duyệt: ' + (err.message || 'Không thể thực thi'), {
        title: 'THẤT BẠI',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (proposalId: string, reason: string) => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const res = await documentService.rejectProposal(proposalId, reason);
      toast.success(res.message || 'Đã từ chối đề xuất thành công', {
        title: 'ĐÃ TỪ CHỐI',
        badge: 'REJECTED',
      });
      onRefresh();
      if (proposals.length <= 1) {
        onClose();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error('Lỗi từ chối: ' + (err.message || 'Không thể thực thi'), {
        title: 'THẤT BẠI',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <ApprovalDiffModal
      open={open}
      proposal={currentProposal}
      proposals={proposals}
      currentIndex={activeIndex}
      onNavigate={(newIdx) => setSelectedIndex(newIdx)}
      onClose={onClose}
      onApprove={handleApprove}
      onReject={handleReject}
      isProcessing={isProcessing}
    />
  );
};

export default PendingProposalsModal;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  X, Save, Loader2, FileText, BookOpen, Shield,
  Layers, Sparkles, Check, Info, AlertCircle, Hash
} from 'lucide-react';
import { lectureService } from '../../services/lectureService';
import { toast } from '../common/Toast';
import { Subject, ContentType, Lecture } from '../../types/lecture';
import { LecturePackageDropzone } from './LecturePackageDropzone';

// ─── Cấu hình Cấp bảo mật bài giảng ───
const SECURITY_LEVELS: Array<{ value: number; label: string; desc: string; badge: string }> = [
  {
    value: 1,
    label: 'Cấp 1 — Công khai',
    desc: 'Học viên và cán bộ toàn trường đều xem được',

// ─── Cấu hình 3 Định dạng bài giảng số hóa ───
const CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS: Array<{

];

interface Props {

  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: () => void;

export const CreateLectureModal: React.FC<Props> = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onCreated,
  subjects,
  editLecture,
}) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [lectureCode, setLectureCode] = useState('');
  const [subjectId, setSubjectId] = useState('');
  const [contentType, setContentType] = useState<ContentType>('PDF');
  const [securityLevel, setSecurityLevel] = useState(2);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  // State cho file upload gói .zip
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

  // Build dropdown level động
  const effectiveSecurityLevels = useMemo(() => {
    const base = SECURITY_LEVELS.map((x) => ({ ...x }));
    const currentLevel = editLecture?.security_level_id;
    if (
      typeof currentLevel === 'number' &&
      currentLevel > 3 &&
      !base.some((x) => x.value === currentLevel)
    ) {
      const extraLabel =
        currentLevel === 4
          ? 'Cấp 4 — Tối mật (giữ nguyên)'
          : 'Cấp 5 — Tuyệt mật (giữ nguyên)';
      base.push({
        value: currentLevel,
        label: extraLabel,
        desc: 'Hồ sơ mật đặc biệt',
        badge: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30',
      });
    }
    return base;
  }, [editLecture]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    if (editLecture) {
      setTitle(editLecture.title || '');
      setLectureCode(editLecture.lecture_code || '');
      setSubjectId(editLecture.subject_id || '');
      setContentType(editLecture.content_type || 'PDF');
      setSecurityLevel(editLecture.security_level_id || 2);
    } else {
      setTitle('');
      setLectureCode('');
      setSubjectId('');
      setContentType('PDF');
      setSecurityLevel(2);
    }
    setFile(null);
    setError('');
  }, [open, editLecture]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const reset = () => {
    setTitle('');
    setLectureCode('');
    setSubjectId('');
    setContentType('PDF');
    setSecurityLevel(2);
    setError('');
    setFile(null);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (submitting) return;
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    if (!title.trim()) return setError('Vui lòng nhập tiêu đề bài giảng');
    if (!subjectId) return setError('Vui lòng chọn môn học');

    if (!editLecture && securityLevel > 3) {
      return setError('Cấp bảo mật tối đa cho bài giảng mới là Cấp 3 — Mật');
    }

    // Nếu tạo mới và là HTML5/SCORM, bắt buộc phải có file
    if (!editLecture && contentType !== 'PDF' && !file) {
      return setError('Vui lòng chọn tệp .zip chứa gói bài giảng');
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        title: title.trim(),
        subject_id: subjectId,
        lecture_code: lectureCode.trim() || undefined,
        security_level_id: securityLevel,
        content_type: contentType,
        scorm_entry_point: undefined, // BE tự lấy từ imsmanifest.xml khi giải nén
      };

      let targetLectureId = editLecture?.lecture_id;

      // BƯỚC 1: Tạo hoặc cập nhật bài giảng
      if (editLecture) {
        await lectureService.update(editLecture.lecture_id, payload);
        toast.success('Đã cập nhật bài giảng thành công');
      } else {
        const res = await lectureService.create(payload);
        targetLectureId = res.lecture_id;
        toast.success('Đã tạo bài giảng mới thành công');
      }

      // BƯỚC 2: Upload file bài giảng (PDF / HTML5 / SCORM) nếu có
      if (file && targetLectureId) {
        toast.info(
          contentType === 'PDF'
            ? 'Đang nạp tệp giáo án PDF lên máy chủ...'
            : 'Đang nạp gói bài giảng lên máy chủ...',
          { duration: 4000 }
        );
        await lectureService.uploadPackage(
          targetLectureId,
          file,
          contentType
        );
        toast.success(
          contentType === 'PDF'
            ? 'Đã lưu tệp giáo án PDF cho bài giảng thành công'
            : 'Đã giải nén và lưu gói bài giảng thành công'
        );
      }

      reset();
      onCreated();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Thao tác không thành công');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[92vh]">
        {/* Header Modal phong cách Chỉ huy Quân sự */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-900/90">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {editLecture ? 'Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ bài giảng' : 'Soạn bài giảng số mới'}
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                  {editLecture ? 'Cập nhật' : 'Khởi tạo'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Trường Quân Sự Quân Khu 7 — Khung chuẩn hóa giáo án & bài giảng điện tử
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleClose}
            disabled={submitting}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition disabled:opacity-40 min-h-[38px] min-w-[38px] flex items-center justify-center"
            title="Đóng (Esc)"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-5 text-xs overflow-y-auto flex-1">
          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30 rounded-xl text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-2xs">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
              <span className="font-medium">{error}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── BƯỚC 1: Chọn định dạng bài giảng (Card Selector) ── */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 mb-2">
              1. Định dạng bài giảng số hóa <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
              {CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                const Icon = opt.icon;
                const isSelected = contentType === opt.value;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={opt.value}
                    onClick={() => setContentType(opt.value)}
                    className={`relative p-3.5 rounded-xl border-2 cursor-pointer transition-all flex flex-col justify-between ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 shadow-xs'
                        : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-white/20 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/40'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <div
                          className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                        {isSelected && (
                          <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                            <Check className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[3]" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs mb-0.5">
                        {opt.title}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-snug">
                        {opt.desc}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.04]">
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                        {opt.badge}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── BƯỚC 2: Thông tin định danh ── */}
          <div className="space-y-3.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
            <label className="block font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
              2. Thông tin định danh bài giảng
            </label>

            <div>
              <span className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Tiêu đề bài giảng <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={title}
                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="VD: Bài 1 — Chiến thuật tiến công Đại đội Bộ binh"
                autoFocus
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-600 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs font-medium"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <span className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Hash className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                  Mã bài giảng
                </span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={lectureCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setLectureCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="VD: BG-CTBB-01"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <span className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <BookOpen className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                  Môn học <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </span>
                <select
                  value={subjectId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSubjectId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 cursor-pointer text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs"
                >
                  <option value="">Chọn môn học</option>
                  {subjects.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.subject_id} value={s.subject_id}>
                      {s.name} {s.faculty_name ? `(${s.faculty_name})` : ''}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── BƯỚC 3: Cấp độ bảo mật ── */}
          <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
            <label className="block font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
              3. Cấp độ bảo mật & Kiểm soát truy cập
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {effectiveSecurityLevels.map((lv) => {
                const isSelected = securityLevel === lv.value;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={lv.value}
                    onClick={() => setSecurityLevel(lv.value)}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-start gap-2.5 ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20'
                        : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-white/20'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Shield
                      className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${
                        lv.value === 1
                          ? 'text-emerald-600'
                          : lv.value === 2
                          ? 'text-blue-600'
                          : 'text-amber-600'
                      }`}
                    />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white block text-xs">
                        {lv.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block leading-tight mt-0.5">
                        {lv.desc}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── BƯỚC 4: Tải lên gói tệp bài giảng số hóa ── */}
          <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="block font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                4. Tệp dữ liệu bài giảng số hóa
              </label>
              {contentType === 'PDF' && editLecture?.document_id && !file && (
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20">
                  Đã có tệp PDF đính kèm
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <LecturePackageDropzone
              selectedFile={file}
              onFileSelect={setFile}
              contentType={contentType}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Bottom Action Bar */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              disabled={submitting}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold transition disabled:opacity-40 min-h-[44px]"
            >
              Hủy
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#166534] via-[#15803d] to-[#16a34a] hover:from-[#15803d] hover:to-[#22c55e] border border-emerald-400/30 text-white rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-40 shadow-sm transition active:scale-[0.98] min-h-[44px]"
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Đang xử lý hồ sơ...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{editLecture ? 'Lưu thay đổi' : 'Tạo bài giảng'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CreateLectureModal;

import React from 'react';
import {
  FileText, Layers, FileCode, Send, Check, X,
  Play, Trash2, Hash, User, AlertTriangle, Edit, RotateCcw, Eye,
  HelpCircle, Shield, CheckCircle2, Clock
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Lecture, ContentType, LectureStatus } from '../../types/lecture';

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<LectureStatus, { label: string; badgeCls: string; step: number }> = {
  DRAFT:            { label: 'Bản nháp',          badgeCls: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700', step: 1 },
  PENDING_FACULTY:  { label: 'Chờ Khoa duyệt',    badgeCls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/15 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30', step: 2 },
  PENDING_TRAINING: { label: 'Chờ BGH duyệt',     badgeCls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/40', step: 3 },
  PUBLISHED:        { label: 'Đã xuất bản',       badgeCls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30', step: 4 },
  REJECTED:         { label: 'Cần chỉnh sửa',     badgeCls: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30', step: 1 },
  ARCHIVED:         { label: 'Lưu trữ',           badgeCls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/15 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30', step: 0 },
  DELETED:          { label: 'Đã xóa (Thùng rác)', badgeCls: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30', step: 0 },
};

const CONTENT_CONFIG: Record<ContentType, { icon: typeof FileText; label: string; badgeCls: string; iconCls: string }> = {
  PDF: {
    icon: FileText,
    label: 'Tài liệu PDF',
    badgeCls: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30',
    iconCls: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',
  },
  SCORM: {
    icon: Layers,
    label: 'Gói SCORM',
    badgeCls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/15 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30',
    iconCls: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400',
  },
  HTML5: {
    icon: FileCode,
    label: 'Gói HTML5',
    badgeCls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30',
    iconCls: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
  },
};

const SECURITY_LEVEL_LABELS: Record<number, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  1: { label: 'Cấp 1 — Công khai', cls: 'text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/25' },
  2: { label: 'Cấp 2 — Nội bộ',    cls: 'text-sky-700 bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-500/10 dark:text-sky-400 border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-500/25' },
  3: { label: 'Cấp 3 — Mật',      cls: 'text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/25' },
  4: { label: 'Cấp 4 — Tối mật',  cls: 'text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/25' },
  5: { label: 'Cấp 5 — Tuyệt mật', cls: 'text-rose-900 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/40 font-bold' },
};

export interface LectureCardProps {
  lecture: Lecture;
  viewMode: 'grid' | 'table';
  currentUserId?: string;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  canApprove: boolean;
  canArchive: boolean;
  canStartSchedule: boolean;
  canEdit: boolean;
  onSubmit: () => void;
  onApprove: () => void;
  onReject: () => void;
  onSoftDelete: () => void;   // 🆕 — chuyển vào thùng rác
  onRestore: () => void;      // giữ nguyên — khôi phục từ thùng rác
  onPurge: () => void;        // 🆕 — xoá vĩnh viễn
  onEdit: () => void;
  onView: () => void;
  onStartSession: () => void;
}

export const LectureCard: React.FC<LectureCardProps> = ({
  lecture, viewMode, currentUserId, isAdmin, canApprove, canArchive, canStartSchedule, canEdit,
  onSubmit, onApprove, onReject, onSoftDelete, onRestore, onPurge, onEdit, onView, onStartSession,
}) => {
  const statusCfg = STATUS_STYLES[lecture.status] || STATUS_STYLES.DRAFT;
  const secCfg = SECURITY_LEVEL_LABELS[lecture.security_level_id] || SECURITY_LEVEL_LABELS[2];

  const isAuthor = isAdmin || (currentUserId && currentUserId === lecture.author_id);
  const isDraftOrRejected = lecture.status === 'DRAFT' || lecture.status === 'REJECTED';
  const isPendingFaculty  = lecture.status === 'PENDING_FACULTY';
  const isPendingTraining = lecture.status === 'PENDING_TRAINING';
  const isPublished       = lecture.status === 'PUBLISHED';
  const isArchived        = lecture.status === 'ARCHIVED';   // legacy — giữ để tương thích
  const isDeleted         = lecture.status === 'DELETED';    // 🆕 — trong thùng rác

  type Action = { label: string; icon: typeof FileText; onClick: () => void; cls: string };
  const actions: Action[] = [];

  // 1. Mở ca dạy khi đã PUBLISHED (Ưu tiên số 1 theo yêu cầu chỉ huy)
  if (isPublished && isAuthor && canStartSchedule) {
    actions.push({
      label: 'Mở ca dạy',
      icon: Play,
      onClick: onStartSession,
      cls: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#166534] to-[#15803d] hover:from-[#15803d] hover:to-[#16a34a] text-white font-bold border border-emerald-500/40 shadow-xs'
    });
  }

  // 2. Chỉnh sửa & Gửi duyệt khi là DRAFT / REJECTED
  if (isAuthor && isDraftOrRejected && canEdit) {
    actions.push({
      label: 'Chỉnh sửa',
      icon: Edit,
      onClick: onEdit,
      cls: 'bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30'
    });
    actions.push({
      label: 'Gửi duyệt',
      icon: Send,
      onClick: onSubmit,
      cls: 'bg-[#166534] hover:bg-[#14532d] text-white border border-emerald-600 shadow-xs'
    });
  }

  // 3. Quyền phê duyệt 2 tầng (Chỉ huy Khoa / Đào tạo / BGH)
  if (canApprove) {
    if (isPendingFaculty) {
      actions.push(
        { label: 'Duyệt Khoa', icon: Check, onClick: onApprove, cls: 'bg-[#166534] hover:bg-[#14532d] text-white font-bold border border-emerald-600' },
        { label: 'Từ chối',    icon: X,     onClick: onReject,  cls: 'bg-rose-100 hover:bg-rose-200 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30' },
      );
    }
    if (isPendingTraining) {
      actions.push(
        { label: 'Duyệt BGH', icon: Check, onClick: onApprove, cls: 'bg-[#166534] hover:bg-[#14532d] text-white font-bold border border-emerald-600' },
        { label: 'Từ chối',   icon: X,     onClick: onReject,  cls: 'bg-rose-100 hover:bg-rose-200 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30' },
      );
    }
  }

  // 4. Xem chi tiết
  actions.push({
    label: 'Xem chi tiết',
    icon: Eye,
    onClick: onView,
    cls: 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
  });

  // 5. Quyền Xoá mềm / Khôi phục / Xoá vĩnh viễn
  if (canArchive) {
    if (isDeleted) {
      // Đang trong thùng rác → Khôi phục + Xoá vĩnh viễn
      actions.push(
        {
          label: 'Khôi phục',
          icon: RotateCcw,
          onClick: onRestore,
          cls: 'bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30'
        },
        {
          label: 'Xóa vĩnh viễn',
          icon: AlertTriangle,
          onClick: onPurge,
          cls: 'bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white border border-rose-700 shadow-md font-bold'
        },
      );
    } else {
      // Đang hoạt động bình thường → Xoá mềm (màu đỏ theo yêu cầu)
      actions.push({
        label: 'Xóa',
        icon: Trash2,
        onClick: onSoftDelete,
        cls: 'bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-300 dark:bg-red-500/15 dark:hover:bg-red-500/25 dark:text-red-300 dark:border-red-500/30'
      });
    }
  }

  // ── TABLE VIEW ──
  if (viewMode === 'table') {
    return (
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] p-3 sm:p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:border-emerald-500/40 hover:shadow-xs transition-all">
        <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-300/40 dark:border-emerald-700/40 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold mt-0.5 sm:mt-0">
            <Hash className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
            {/* Header dòng 1: Tiêu đề + Cấp bảo mật + Trạng thái (Đã xuất bản / Lưu trữ nằm kế cấp bảo mật) */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span
                className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate cursor-pointer hover:text-emerald-700 dark:hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors"
                onClick={onView}
                title={lecture.title}
              >
                {lecture.title}
              </span>
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${secCfg.cls}`}>
                {secCfg.label.split('—')[0].trim()}
              </span>
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${statusCfg.badgeCls}`}>
                {statusCfg.label}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Dòng trên: Mã bài giảng & Môn học (in đậm giá trị) */}
            <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span className="font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px]">
                #{lecture.lecture_code}
              </span>
              <span>Môn: <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-bold">{lecture.subject_name || '—'}</strong></span>
            </div>

            {/* Dòng dưới: Khoa / Bộ môn & GV (in đậm giá trị) */}
            <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span>Khoa: <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-bold">{lecture.faculty_name || '—'}</strong></span>
              <span>GV: <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-bold">{lecture.author_rank ? `${lecture.author_rank} ` : ''}{lecture.author_name || '—'}</strong></span>
              {typeof lecture.quiz_count === 'number' && lecture.quiz_count > 0 && (
                <span className="text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold">• {lecture.quiz_count} câu hỏi Quiz</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Nút thao tác ở bên phải */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 flex-wrap">
          {actions.map((a, i) => {
            const I = a.icon;
            return (
              <button
                key={i}
                type="button"
                onClick={a.onClick}
                className={`text-[11px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${a.cls}`}
              >
                <I className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{a.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── GRID VIEW (TACTICAL COMMAND CARD) ──
  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 hover:border-emerald-500/40 hover:shadow-md transition-all h-full relative group">
      
      {/* 1. Header Card: Mã bài giảng nổi bật + Cấp độ & Trạng thái (Bỏ badge Gói) */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        {/* Mã danh sách bài giảng nổi bật */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-300/70 dark:border-emerald-700/60 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 shadow-2xs tracking-wide">
          <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{lecture.lecture_code}</span>
        </div>

        {/* Cụm Cấp độ bảo mật & Trạng thái xuất bản */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border shadow-2xs ${secCfg.cls}`}>
            {secCfg.label.split('—')[0].trim()}
          </span>
          <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${statusCfg.badgeCls}`}>
            {statusCfg.label}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Tên danh sách bài giảng (Hero Title) */}
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <h3
          className="font-bold text-[15px] text-slate-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-emerald-700 dark:group-hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          onClick={onView}
          title={lecture.title}
        >
          {lecture.title}
        </h3>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Mini Stepper: Quy trình duyệt 2 tầng quân sự */}
      {!isArchived && !isDeleted && (
        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.04]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-semibold mb-1.5">
            <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Tiến trình duyệt 2 tầng:</span>
            <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
              {lecture.status === 'PUBLISHED' ? 'Hoàn tất xuất bản' : `Bước ${statusCfg.step}/4`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1 items-center">
            {/* Step 1: Nháp */}
            <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${statusCfg.step >= 1 ? 'bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800'}`} title="Bước 1: Soạn thảo bài giảng" />
            {/* Step 2: Duyệt Khoa */}
            <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${statusCfg.step >= 2 ? 'bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800'}`} title="Bước 2: Khoa/Bộ môn duyệt" />
            {/* Step 3: Duyệt BGH */}
            <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${statusCfg.step >= 3 ? 'bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800'}`} title="Bước 3: Phòng Đào tạo & BGH duyệt" />
            {/* Step 4: Xuất bản */}
            <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${statusCfg.step >= 4 ? 'bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800'}`} title="Bước 4: Sẵn sàng giảng dạy" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-1 font-medium">
            <span>Soạn thảo</span>
            <span>Khoa duyệt</span>
            <span>BGH duyệt</span>
            <span>Xuất bản</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Thông báo từ chối có lý do */}
      {lecture.status === 'REJECTED' && lecture.reject_reason && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/30 leading-relaxed">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div>
            <strong className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-400">Yêu cầu hiệu chỉnh:</strong>
            <span className="line-clamp-2">{lecture.reject_reason}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Metadata chi tiết */}
      <div className="space-y-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.04] pt-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 truncate">
          <span className="text-slate-400 shrink-0">Môn học:</span>
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate" title={lecture.subject_name}>
            {lecture.subject_name || '—'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 truncate">
          <span className="text-slate-400 shrink-0">Khoa / Bộ môn:</span>
          <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 truncate" title={lecture.faculty_name}>
            {lecture.faculty_name || '—'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 truncate">
          <span className="text-slate-400 shrink-0">Giảng viên:</span>
          <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 truncate" title={lecture.author_name}>
            {lecture.author_rank ? `${lecture.author_rank} ` : ''}{lecture.author_name || '—'}
          </span>
        </div>
        {typeof lecture.quiz_count === 'number' && lecture.quiz_count > 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 pt-1 border-t border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
              <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Bộ câu hỏi Quiz:
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold">{lecture.quiz_count} câu</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Action buttons dứt khoát */}
      {actions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.04] mt-auto">
          {actions.map((a, i) => {
            const I = a.icon;
            return (
              <button
                key={i}
                type="button"
                onClick={a.onClick}
                className={`text-[11px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${a.cls}`}
              >
                <I className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                <span>{a.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

File: frontend/src/components/lectures/LectureDetailModal.tsx
