import React from 'react';
import { X, BookOpen, User, Building2, Shield, Calendar, HelpCircle, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { Lecture, LectureStatus } from '../../types/lecture';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  lecture: Lecture | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const STATUS_CONFIG: Record<LectureStatus, { label: string; color: string; bg: string; border: string }> = {
  DRAFT: { label: 'Bản nháp', color: 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400', bg: 'bg-slate-500/10', border: 'border-slate-500/30' },
  PENDING_FACULTY: { label: 'Chờ Khoa duyệt', color: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', bg: 'bg-amber-500/10', border: 'border-amber-500/30' },
  PENDING_TRAINING: { label: 'Chờ BGH duyệt', color: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', bg: 'bg-amber-500/10', border: 'border-amber-500/30' },
  PUBLISHED: { label: 'Đã xuất bản', color: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', bg: 'bg-emerald-500/10', border: 'border-emerald-500/30' },
  REJECTED: { label: 'Bị từ chối', color: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400', bg: 'bg-rose-500/10', border: 'border-rose-500/30' },
  ARCHIVED: { label: 'Đã lưu trữ', color: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300', bg: 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/15', border: 'border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30' },
  DELETED: { label: 'Đã xóa (Thùng rác)', color: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400', bg: 'bg-rose-500/10', border: 'border-rose-500/30' },
};

const FORMAT_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; badge: string }> = {
  PDF: { label: 'Văn bản PDF', badge: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-500/20' },
  SCORM: { label: 'Gói chuẩn SCORM', badge: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20' },
  HTML5: { label: 'Tương tác HTML5', badge: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20' },
};

export const LectureDetailModal: React.FC<Props> = ({ open, lecture, onClose }) => {
  if (!open || !lecture) return null;

  const statusCfg = STATUS_CONFIG[lecture.status] || STATUS_CONFIG.DRAFT;
  const formatCfg = FORMAT_CONFIG[lecture.content_type] || FORMAT_CONFIG.PDF;

  // Mini stepper states
  const stages = [
    { key: 'DRAFT', label: 'Soạn thảo' },
    { key: 'FACULTY', label: 'Khoa/Bộ môn' },
    { key: 'TRAINING', label: 'Ban Giám hiệu' },
    { key: 'PUBLISHED', label: 'Xuất bản' },
  ];

  const getStageState = (index: number) => {
    if (lecture.status === 'PUBLISHED') return 'completed';
    if (lecture.status === 'DELETED') return 'rejected'; // 🆕 bài đã bị xoá → toàn bộ quy trình dừng
    if (lecture.status === 'REJECTED') {
      return index === 0 ? 'completed' : 'rejected';
    }
    if (lecture.status === 'PENDING_TRAINING') {
      if (index <= 1) return 'completed';
      if (index === 2) return 'current';
      return 'pending';
    }
    if (lecture.status === 'PENDING_FACULTY') {
      if (index === 0) return 'completed';
      if (index === 1) return 'current';
      return 'pending';
    }
    if (lecture.status === 'DRAFT') {
      if (index === 0) return 'current';
      return 'pending';
    }
    return 'pending';
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-900/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">Hồ sơ bài giảng</h3>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/20 tabular-nums font-semibold shrink-0">
                  {lecture.lecture_code || 'CHƯA CÓ MÃ'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                Mã định danh hệ thống: <span className="font-mono">{lecture.lecture_id}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button 
            onClick={onClose} 
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition min-h-[38px] min-w-[38px] flex items-center justify-center"
            aria-label="Đóng"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Content */}
        <div className="p-5 space-y-4 text-xs overflow-y-auto">
          {/* Title & Badge */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-snug">
                {lecture.title}
              </h2>
              <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold border shrink-0 ${statusCfg.bg} ${statusCfg.color} ${statusCfg.border}`}>
                {statusCfg.label}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Reject reason warning if rejected */}
            {lecture.status === 'REJECTED' && lecture.reject_reason && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 mb-3">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-rose-600" />
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="font-bold block text-[11px]">Lý do từ chối:</span>
                  <p className="text-xs whitespace-pre-line mt-0.5">{lecture.reject_reason}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Mini Stepper Flow */}
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
            <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2.5">
              Tiến trình thẩm định & phê duyệt
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 relative">
              {stages.map((st, idx) => {
                const state = getStageState(idx);
                return (
                  <div key={st.key} className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
                    <div className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-bold transition-colors mb-1 ${
                      state === 'completed'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                        : state === 'current'
                        ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white animate-pulse'
                        : state === 'rejected'
                        ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white'
                        : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}>
                      {state === 'completed' ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      ) : state === 'current' ? (
                        <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      ) : state === 'rejected' ? (
                        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      ) : (
                        idx + 1
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <span className={`text-[10px] font-medium leading-tight ${
                      state === 'current' ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'
                    }`}>
                      {st.label}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Telemetry Matrix Grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1">Môn học</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">{lecture.subject_name || 'Chưa gán môn'}</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1">Khoa / Bộ môn</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">{lecture.faculty_name || 'Chưa gán khoa'}</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1">Giảng viên / Tác giả</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">
                  {lecture.author_rank ? `${lecture.author_rank} ` : ''}
                  {lecture.author_name || 'Khuyết danh'}
                </span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1">Cấp độ bảo mật</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{lecture.security_name || `Cấp ${lecture.security_level_id}`}</span>
              </span>
            </div>

                {formatCfg.label}

              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1">Câu hỏi Quiz tương tác</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-mono tabular-nums font-bold">{lecture.quiz_count ?? 0}</span> câu hỏi
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Timeline & Metadata */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
              Khởi tạo: <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{lecture.created_at ? new Date(lecture.created_at).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') : '—'}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
              Cập nhật: {lecture.updated_at ? new Date(lecture.updated_at).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') : '—'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 px-5 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-end bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg font-semibold transition active:scale-[0.98] min-h-[38px]"
          >
            Đóng
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/* QK7 DataHub · Tactical Lecture Package Dropzone (SCORM / HTML5 ZIP) */
import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { UploadCloud, Check, X, HardDrive, RefreshCw, Layers, Sparkles, AlertCircle, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatFileSize } from '../../utils/formatFileSize';
import { ContentType } from '../../types/lecture';

export interface LecturePackageDropzoneProps {
  selectedFile: File | null;
  onFileSelect: (file: File | null) => void;
  contentType: ContentType;
  maxSizeBytes?: number;
}

export const LecturePackageDropzone: React.FC<LecturePackageDropzoneProps> = ({
  selectedFile,
  onFileSelect,
  contentType,
  maxSizeBytes = 200 * 1024 * 1024, // 200MB cho gói SCORM/HTML5
}) => {
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
  const [uploadStatus, setUploadStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Hiệu ứng tiến trình nạp tệp mượt mà khi tệp được chọn
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedFile) {
      setUploadProgress(0);
      setUploadStatus('idle');
      setErrorMsg(null);
      return;
    }

    setUploadProgress(15);
    setUploadStatus('uploading');
    setErrorMsg(null);

    let current = 15;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      current += 20 + Math.random() * 20;
      if (current >= 100) {
        current = 100;
        setUploadProgress(100);
        setUploadStatus('done');
        clearInterval(interval);
      } else {
        setUploadProgress(current);
      }
    }, 50);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [selectedFile]);

  const handleRetry = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!selectedFile) return;
    setUploadProgress(10);
    setUploadStatus('uploading');
    let current = 10;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      current += 25;
      if (current >= 100) {
        current = 100;
        setUploadProgress(100);
        setUploadStatus('done');
        clearInterval(interval);
      } else {
        setUploadProgress(current);
      }
    }, 50);
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(false);
    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) {
      validateAndSelect(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    }
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      validateAndSelect(e.target.files[0]);
    }
  };

  const validateAndSelect = (file: File) => {
    if (contentType === 'PDF') {
      if (!file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf') && file.type !== 'application/pdf') {
        setErrorMsg('Định dạng tệp không hợp lệ! Vui lòng chọn tệp tài liệu .pdf');
        setUploadStatus('error');
        return;
      }
    } else {
      if (!file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.zip')) {
        setErrorMsg('Định dạng tệp không hợp lệ! Vui lòng chọn tệp .zip nén');
        setUploadStatus('error');
        return;
      }
    }
    if (file.size > maxSizeBytes) {
      setErrorMsg(`Tệp vượt quá giới hạn ${(maxSizeBytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(0)}MB!`);
      setUploadStatus('error');
      return;
    }
    setErrorMsg(null);
    onFileSelect(file);
  };

  const handleZoneClick = () => {
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      fileInputRef.current.click();
    }
  };

  const getFormatBadge = () => {
    if (contentType === 'PDF') {
      return {
        label: 'PDF',
        icon: <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />,
        badge: 'bg-rose-500/15 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400',
        hint: 'Giáo án điện tử, tài liệu bài giảng số hóa định dạng PDF (tối đa 100MB)',
      };
    }
    if (contentType === 'SCORM') {
      return {
        label: 'SCORM',
        icon: <Layers className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />,
        badge: 'bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
        hint: 'Tương thích gói SCORM 1.2 / 2004 (ActivePresenter / Storyline)',
      };
    }
    return {
      label: 'HTML5',
      icon: <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />,
      badge: 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
      hint: 'Chứa tệp index.html và các tài nguyên đa phương tiện',
    };
  };

  const fmt = getFormatBadge();

  return (
    <div className="u032-wrapper space-y-3">
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept={contentType === 'PDF' ? '.pdf,application/pdf' : '.zip,application/zip,application/x-zip-compressed'}
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        className="hidden"
      />

      {/* Khung Drop Zone .u032 với hiệu ứng Marching Border & Floating Orb */}
      <div
        onDragOver={handleDragOver}
        onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
        onClick={handleZoneClick}
        className={`u032-zone flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
          selectedFile ? 'p-4 sm:p-5' : 'p-6 sm:p-8'
        } ${isDragging ? 'is-dragging' : ''}`}
      >
        {/* Lớp SVG viền đứt khúc chạy động stroke-dasharray="8 7" */}
        <svg className="u032-dash" aria-hidden="true">
          <rect
            x="1"
            y="1"
            width="calc(100% - 2px)"
            height="calc(100% - 2px)"
            rx="17"
            ry="17"
          />
        </svg>

        {/* Biểu tượng Orb mây bay nổi bật */}
        <div className="u032-orb-container mb-2">
          <div className="u032-glow" aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className="u032-orb">
            <UploadCloud className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 stroke-[2.2] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Nhãn chỉ dẫn theo chuẩn Trường Quân Sự Quân Khu 7 */}
        <div className="relative z-2 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
          <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
            {selectedFile
              ? 'Nhấn để thay đổi tệp'
              : contentType === 'PDF'
              ? 'Nhấn để chọn tệp tài liệu bài giảng (.pdf)'
              : 'Nhấn để chọn tệp gói bài giảng (.zip)'}
          </span>{' '}
          {selectedFile
            ? `hoặc kéo thả tệp ${contentType === 'PDF' ? '.pdf' : '.zip'} mới vào đây`
            : `hoặc kéo thả tệp ${contentType === 'PDF' ? '.pdf' : '.zip'} vào đây`}
        </div>
        <p className="relative z-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 font-medium">
          {fmt.hint} (Dung lượng tối đa 200MB)
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Lỗi định dạng nếu có */}
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:border-rose-500/30 rounded-xl text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{errorMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Danh sách hiển thị tiến trình tải tệp .u032-list */}
      {selectedFile && (
        <div className="u032-list">
          <div className="u032-item">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 min-w-0">
                {/* Format Icon Box */}
                <div
                  className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-2xs ${fmt.badge}`}
                >
                  {fmt.icon}
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-[320px]">
                      {selectedFile.name}
                    </p>
                    {uploadStatus === 'done' && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 shrink-0">
                        <Check className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[3]" /> Gói hợp lệ
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {uploadStatus === 'uploading' && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono font-medium shrink-0">
                        {Math.round(uploadProgress)}%
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {uploadStatus === 'error' && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 shrink-0">
                        Lỗi tệp
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5 font-mono tabular-nums">
                    <HardDrive className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{formatFileSize(selectedFile.size)}</span>
                    <span>•</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase">
                      {contentType}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action buttons */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                {uploadStatus === 'error' && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleRetry}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/30 transition cursor-pointer"
                    title="Thử lại"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Thử lại</span>
                  </button>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    onFileSelect(null);
                    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
                  }}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer min-h-[38px] min-w-[38px] flex items-center justify-center"
                  title="Gỡ bỏ tệp"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Thanh tiến trình Progress Bar */}
            <div className="u032-progress-track mt-2">
              <div
                className={`u032-progress-bar ${uploadStatus === 'error' ? 'is-error' : ''}`}
                style={{ width: `${uploadProgress}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default LecturePackageDropzone;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Radio, RefreshCw, AlertTriangle, Clock, Users, Building2, User,
  Square, ShieldAlert, Monitor, Sparkles, BookOpen, Layers, HelpCircle, CheckCircle2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { lectureService } from '../../services/lectureService';
import { toast } from '../common/Toast';
import { TeachingSchedule } from '../../types/lecture';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '../common/ConfirmDialog';
import { TacticalEmptyState } from '../common/TacticalEmptyState';

interface Props {
  currentUserId?: string;
  canForceEnd: boolean;
}

export const LiveMonitorPanel: React.FC<Props> = ({ currentUserId, canForceEnd }) => {
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<TeachingSchedule[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [lastUpdate, setLastUpdate] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [endingId, setEndingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Confirm dialog state
  const [confirmTarget, setConfirmTarget] = useState<{
    session: TeachingSchedule;
    isForce: boolean;
  } | null>(null);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await lectureService.getLiveSchedules();
      setSessions(res.items || []);
      setLastUpdate(new Date());
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Load live sessions failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 5000); // 5s thay vì 15s để đồng bộ tiến độ slide và thời gian tức thời
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);

  const handleConfirmEnd = async () => {
    if (!confirmTarget) return;
    const { session: s, isForce } = confirmTarget;
    setEndingId(s.schedule_id);
    try {
      if (isForce) {
        await lectureService.forceEndSchedule(s.schedule_id);
      } else {
        await lectureService.endSchedule(s.schedule_id);
      }
      toast.success('Đã kết thúc ca giảng dạy thành công!');
      load();
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err?.message || 'Không thể kết thúc ca dạy');
    } finally {
      setEndingId(null);
      setConfirmTarget(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header bar của Radar Giám sát */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <Radio className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping opacity-75" />
            <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Hệ Thống Giám Sát Giảng Đường Trực Tiếp</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30">
                Live Radar
              </span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              Đang có <strong className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">{sessions.length}</strong> giảng đường đang vận hành
              {lastUpdate && ` — cập nhật lần cuối lúc ${lastUpdate.toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN')}`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={load}
          disabled={loading}
          className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          <span>Làm mới radar</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Trạng thái không có ca giảng dạy */}
      {sessions.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] shadow-xs">
          <TacticalEmptyState
            title="Tất cả các giảng đường hiện đang trống"
            description="Hiện không có ca giảng dạy nào đang diễn ra trong phân hệ. Ca học sẽ tự động xuất hiện trên Radar khi giảng viên bấm 'Mở ca dạy' từ danh sách bài giảng đã xuất bản."
            icon={<Monitor className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />}
            onRefresh={load}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {sessions.map((s) => {
            const isOwner = s.presenter_id === currentUserId;
            const canEndOwn = isOwner;
            const canForce = !isOwner && canForceEnd;

            return (
              <div
                key={s.schedule_id}
                className={`bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] rounded-2xl border p-5 flex flex-col gap-3.5 transition-all shadow-xs relative ${
                  s.is_hanging
                    ? 'border-amber-500/60 bg-amber-50/20 dark:bg-amber-950/10 shadow-amber-500/10'
                    : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] hover:border-emerald-500/40'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Giảng đường & Trạng thái */}
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.04] pb-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                      <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="font-extrabold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                        {s.venue_name.toLowerCase().startsWith('giảng đường') ? s.venue_name : `Giảng đường: ${s.venue_name}`}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                        Lớp: <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">{s.class_name || 'Học viên'}</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {s.is_hanging ? (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/40 shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
                      <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      CẢNH BÁO TREO CA
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30 shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping" />
                      ĐANG GIẢNG BÀI
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Tiêu đề bài giảng */}
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-1" title={s.lecture_title}>
                    {s.lecture_title}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                    Môn: {s.subject_name || 'Quân sự'}
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* 3 Ô thông tin chi tiết độc lập */}
                <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                  {/* Ô 1: Giảng viên & Chức danh / Chức vụ */}
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-emerald-300/40">
                      <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium leading-none uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Cán bộ giảng dạy
                      </span>
                      <span className={`font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate block mt-0.5 text-xs ${isOwner ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400' : ''}`}>
                        {s.presenter_rank ? `${s.presenter_rank} ` : ''}{s.presenter_name}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 2 Ô hàng dưới: Sĩ số học viên & Thời lượng ca giảng */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    {/* Ô 2: Sĩ số học viên */}
                    <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-blue-300/40">
                        <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium leading-none uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Sĩ số
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block mt-0.5 text-xs">
                          {s.student_count} học viên
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Ô 3: Thời lượng chuẩn đồng bộ với phòng chiếu */}
                    {(() => {
                      const elapsedMinutes = s.start_time
                        ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(s.start_time).getTime()) / 60000))
                        : (s.duration_minutes || 0);

                      return (
                        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-amber-300/40">
                            <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </div>
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-medium leading-none uppercase tracking-wider">
                              Thời lượng
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono truncate block mt-0.5 text-xs">
                              {elapsedMinutes} phút
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </div>

                  {/* Quiz kích hoạt (nếu có) */}
                  {typeof s.quiz_activated_count === 'number' && s.quiz_activated_count > 0 && (
                    <div className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-300/40 dark:border-amber-700/40 flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-semibold text-xs">
                      <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{s.quiz_activated_count} Quiz đã kích hoạt cho học viên</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* 🆕 TIẾN ĐỘ CA DẠY — UX/UI ĐẲNG CẤP, RÕ RÀNG % VÀ ĐOẠN ĐANG DẠY */}
                {(() => {
                  const slidePercent = s.slide_total && s.slide_total > 0
                    ? Math.round(((s.slide_index || 0) / s.slide_total) * 100)
                    : 0;
                  const rawPercent = s.scorm_progress !== undefined && s.scorm_progress !== null
                    ? Math.round(s.scorm_progress * 100)
                    : slidePercent;
                  const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, rawPercent));
                  const isDone = percent >= 100;
                  const isRunning = percent > 0 && percent < 100;
                  const elapsedMinutes = s.start_time
                    ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(s.start_time).getTime()) / 60000))
                    : (s.duration_minutes || 0);

                  return (
                    <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2.5 shadow-2xs">
                      {/* Tiêu đề tiến độ + Vị trí / Đoạn bài giảng đang dạy */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold gap-2">
                        <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                          <Monitor className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                          Tiến độ bài giảng
                        </span>

                        {/* Đoạn bài giảng / Slide đang dạy */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                          {s.slide_total ? (
                            <span className="font-mono text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 text-[11px] font-bold tabular-nums bg-emerald-100/80 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-300/60 dark:border-emerald-600/40 shadow-2xs">
                              Đang dạy: Slide {s.slide_index || Math.max(1, Math.ceil((percent / 100) * s.slide_total))}/{s.slide_total}
                            </span>
                          ) : isDone ? (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700">
                              Trọn bài
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
                              {s.current_page ? `Trang ${s.current_page}` : 'Khởi động ca'}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Thanh Track Tiến độ gradient sống động có glow */}
                      <div className="w-full h-3 bg-slate-200/90 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden p-0.5 relative border border-slate-300/60 dark:border-slate-700/60 shadow-inner">
                        <div
                          style={{ width: `${Math.max(percent, isRunning ? 2 : 0)}%` }}
                          className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700 ease-out relative ${
                            isDone
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 via-emerald-500 to-green-400 shadow-xs'
                              : isRunning
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-500 via-indigo-500 to-emerald-500 shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700'
                          }`}
                        />
                      </div>

                      {/* Dòng trạng thái theo đề xuất Chỉ huy: Tiến độ ca dạy: 54% | 100% Hoàn thành */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        {isDone ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 stroke-[2.5]" />
                            <span>Tiến độ ca dạy: <strong className="font-extrabold font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-xs sm:text-sm">100% Hoàn thành</strong></span>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">
                            <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Tiến độ ca dạy:</span>
                            <strong className="font-extrabold font-mono text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 text-xs sm:text-sm">
                              {percent}%
                            </strong>
                            {isRunning && (
                              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500 animate-pulse ml-0.5" />
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {s.is_hanging ? (
                            <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 animate-pulse font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px]">
                              ⚠️ CẢNH BÁO QUÁ GIỜ
                            </span>
                          ) : isDone ? (
                            <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold text-[11px] bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700/50">
                              ✓ Sẵn sàng kết thúc ca
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
                              Đã dạy {elapsedMinutes} phút
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })()}

                {/* Nút điều khiển ca dạy */}
                {(canEndOwn || canForce) && (
                  <div className="mt-auto pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.04] flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    {canEndOwn && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setConfirmTarget({ session: s, isForce: false })}
                        disabled={endingId === s.schedule_id}
                        className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/50 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800/50 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                      >
                        {endingId === s.schedule_id ? (
                          <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                        ) : (
                          <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                        )}
                        <span>Kết thúc ca dạy</span>
                      </button>
                    )}

                    {canForce && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setConfirmTarget({ session: s, isForce: true })}
                        disabled={endingId === s.schedule_id}
                        className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#b91c1c] to-[#dc2626] hover:from-[#dc2626] hover:to-[#ef4444] text-white border border-rose-700 shadow-xs rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                        title="Quyền Chỉ huy/Admin: Buộc kết thúc ca dạy bị treo"
                      >
                        {endingId === s.schedule_id ? (
                          <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                        ) : (
                          <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        )}
                        <span>Buộc kết thúc ca treo</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ConfirmDialog thay thế hoàn toàn window.confirm */}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!confirmTarget}
        title={confirmTarget?.isForce ? 'Xác nhận Buộc Kết Thúc Ca Giảng Dạy' : 'Xác nhận Kết Thúc Ca Giảng Dạy'}
        description={
          confirmTarget?.isForce
            ? `Đồng chí đang thực hiện quyền Chỉ huy/Admin để BUỘC KẾT THÚC ca giảng dạy "${confirmTarget.session.lecture_title}" của giảng viên ${confirmTarget.session.presenter_name}. Hành động này sẽ giải phóng giảng đường "${confirmTarget.session.venue_name}" ngay lập tức.`
            : `Đồng chí có chắc chắn muốn KẾT THÚC ca giảng dạy "${confirmTarget?.session.lecture_title}" tại ${confirmTarget?.session.venue_name}? Dữ liệu thời lượng và tiến độ sẽ được lưu vào Lịch sử giảng dạy.`
        }
        confirmText={confirmTarget?.isForce ? 'Buộc kết thúc ngay' : 'Kết thúc ca học'}
        cancelText="Quay lại"
        isDestructive={true}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmEnd}
        onCancel={() => setConfirmTarget(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

File: frontend/src/components/lectures/LiveSessionRoom.tsx

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Square, Clock, Users, BookOpen, Loader2, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck, RotateCcw,
  GraduationCap, Building2, User, CheckCircle2, X
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Lecture, TeachingSchedule } from '../../types/lecture';
import { http } from '../../services/http';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  session: TeachingSchedule;
  lecture: Lecture;
  onEnd: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

interface ModeItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  file: string;
}

const MAX_MINUTES = 300; // 5 tiếng

// Tính số phút đã trôi qua kể từ session.start_time
const computeElapsed = (startIso: string): number => {
  const start = new Date(startIso).getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(start)) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - start) / 60_000));
};

// Build URL trình chiếu kèm tệp lựa chọn
const buildLaunchUrl = (lecture: Lecture, selectedFile?: string): string => {
  if (lecture.content_type === 'PDF') {
    return lecture.document_id ? `/api/files/${lecture.document_id}/view` : '';
  }
  const token = sessionStorage.getItem('qk7_token');
  const queryParts: string[] = [];
  if (token) queryParts.push(`token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`);
  if (selectedFile) queryParts.push(`file=${encodeURIComponent(selectedFile)}`);
  const queryStr = queryParts.length > 0 ? `?${queryParts.join('&')}` : '';

  if (lecture.content_type === 'SCORM') {
    return `/api/lectures/${lecture.lecture_id}/scorm/launch${queryStr}`;
  }
  return `/api/lectures/${lecture.lecture_id}/html5/launch${queryStr}`;
};

export const LiveSessionRoom: React.FC<Props> = ({ open, session, lecture, onEnd }) => {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState<number>(() => computeElapsed(session.start_time));
  const [ending, setEnding] = useState(false);
  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [iframeLoaded, setIframeLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [modes, setModes] = useState<ModeItem[]>([]);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<string>('');
  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState<number>(0);

  const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);
  const lastSentProgress = useRef<{ index: number; total: number } | null>(null);
  const modesRef = useRef<ModeItem[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    modesRef.current = modes;
  }, [modes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIframeLoaded(false);
    setSelectedFile('');
    setModes([]);
    lastSentProgress.current = null;
  }, [lecture?.lecture_id]);

  // Lưu trạng thái ca dạy vào localStorage theo presenter_id để phục hồi khi F5 biệt lập theo từng tài khoản
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && session?.schedule_id && lecture?.lecture_id && session?.presenter_id) {
      const userKey = `qk7_active_session_${session.presenter_id}`;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(userKey, JSON.stringify({
          schedule_id: session.schedule_id,
          lecture_id: lecture.lecture_id,
          presenter_id: session.presenter_id,
        }));
        // Dọn dẹp key toàn cục cũ không có namespace để tránh rò rỉ phiên
        localStorage.removeItem('qk7_active_session');
      } catch {}
    }
  }, [open, session?.schedule_id, lecture?.lecture_id, session?.presenter_id]);

  // Nạp danh sách các chế độ trình chiếu khả dụng trong gói bài giảng (ActivePresenter/SCORM/HTML5)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !lecture?.lecture_id || lecture.content_type === 'PDF') return;

    let mounted = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await http<{ modes: ModeItem[]; current_entry: string }>(
          `/api/lectures/${lecture.lecture_id}/modes`,
          { silent: true }
        );
        if (mounted && res?.modes && res.modes.length > 0) {
          // Chuẩn hóa thứ tự điều hướng: Menu tổng hợp (Home) -> Minh họa -> Hướng dẫn -> Luyện tập -> Kiểm tra
          const MODE_ORDER: Record<string, number> = {
            index: 1,
            demo: 2,
            tutorial: 3,
            practice: 4,
            test: 5,
          };
          const sorted = [...res.modes].sort((a, b) => {
            const orderA = MODE_ORDER[a.id] || 99;
            const orderB = MODE_ORDER[b.id] || 99;
            return orderA - orderB;
          });
          const normalizedModes = sorted.map(m => {
            if (m.id === 'demo' && m.title.includes('(')) {
              return { ...m, title: 'Minh họa' };
            }
            return m;
          });
          setModes(normalizedModes);

          // Tự động vào Menu tổng hợp (index.html) như trang Home mặc định theo yêu cầu
          const homeMode = normalizedModes.find(m => m.id === 'index' || m.file === 'index.html');
          if (homeMode) {
            setSelectedFile(homeMode.file);
          } else if (res.current_entry) {
            setSelectedFile(res.current_entry);
          } else {
            setSelectedFile(normalizedModes[0]?.file || '');
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {
        // Fallback mặc định
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, [open, lecture?.lecture_id, lecture?.content_type]);

  // Đồng bộ thời gian ca dạy mỗi 10 giây
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setElapsed(computeElapsed(session.start_time));
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setElapsed(computeElapsed(session.start_time));
    }, 10_000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [open, session.start_time]);

  const launchUrl = useMemo(() => buildLaunchUrl(lecture, selectedFile), [lecture, selectedFile]);

  const handleConfirmEndSession = useCallback(async () => {
    setEnding(true);
    setConfirmOpen(false);
    try {
      await onEnd();
    } finally {
      setEnding(false);
    }
  }, [onEnd]);

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 🆕 TÍCH HỢP SCORM & ACTIVEPRESENTER BRIDGE ĐỂ LẤY TIẾN ĐỘ THẬT
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const scormDataRef = useRef<Record<string, string>>({});

  // Hàm gửi tiến độ lên Backend
  const sendRealProgress = useCallback(
    async (slideIndex: number, slideTotal: number, percent: number) => {
      try {
        await http(`/api/lectures/schedules/${session.schedule_id}/progress`, {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            current_page: slideIndex,
            slide_index: slideIndex,
            slide_total: slideTotal,
            scorm_progress: percent,
          }),
          silent: true,
        });
      } catch (_) {
        /* nuốt lỗi — không chặn trình chiếu */
      }
    },
    [session.schedule_id]
  );

  // 🔄 ĐỒNG BỘ HEADER KHI NGƯỜI DÙNG CLICK LIÊN KẾT TRONG MENU TỔNG HỢP (index.html)
  const syncHeaderWithIframe = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const iframe = iframeRef.current;
      if (!iframe || !iframe.contentWindow) return;
      const win = iframe.contentWindow;
      const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(win.location?.search || '');
      const queryFile = searchParams.get('file');
      const pathname = win.location?.pathname || '';
      const pathFile = pathname.split('/').pop() || '';
      const currentFile = queryFile || pathFile;
      if (!currentFile || currentFile === 'launch') return;

      const matchedMode = modes.find((m) => {
        const mFile = (m.file || '').split('/').pop()?.toLowerCase();
        return mFile === currentFile.toLowerCase();
      });

      if (matchedMode && matchedMode.file !== selectedFile) {
        setSelectedFile(matchedMode.file);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Bỏ qua lỗi cross-origin nếu có
    }
  }, [modes, selectedFile]);

  // 🎯 QUÉT TIẾN ĐỘ SLIDE ACTIVEPRESENTER / SCORM THẬT TỪ IFRAME
  const inspectIframeProgress = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const iframe = iframeRef.current;
      if (!iframe) return;

      let cur = 0;
      let tot = 0;

      // 1. Quét phần tử DOM của ActivePresenter Player
      const doc = iframe.contentDocument;
      if (doc) {
        const indexEl = doc.querySelector('.ap-tool-slide-index');
        const countEl = doc.querySelector('.ap-tool-slide-count');
        if (indexEl) cur = parseInt(indexEl.textContent || '0', 10);
        if (countEl) tot = parseInt(countEl.textContent || '0', 10);

        // Quét mục lục TOC nếu bottom bar chưa nạp xong
        if (!cur) {
          const selectedToc = doc.querySelector('.ap-toc-entry.selected, .ap-toc-entry-content-text.selected');
          if (selectedToc) {
            const numEl = selectedToc.closest('.ap-toc-entry')?.querySelector('.ap-toc-entry-numbering');
            const n = parseInt(numEl?.textContent || '0', 10);
            if (n > 0) cur = n;
          }
        }
      }

      // 2. Quét biến Runtime ActivePresenter nếu DOM bị ẩn
      if (!cur && (iframe.contentWindow as any)?.AtomiAP?.presentations?.length) {
        const prez = (iframe.contentWindow as any).AtomiAP.presentations[0];
        if (prez) {
          if (typeof prez.slideIndex === 'function') cur = prez.slideIndex() + 1;
          if (typeof prez.slideCount === 'function') tot = prez.slideCount();
        }
      }

      if (cur > 0) {
        const safeTotal = tot > 0 ? tot : Math.max(cur, 66);
        const percent = Math.min(1, +(cur / safeTotal).toFixed(4));

        if (!lastSentProgress.current || lastSentProgress.current.index !== cur || lastSentProgress.current.total !== safeTotal) {
          lastSentProgress.current = { index: cur, total: safeTotal };
          sendRealProgress(cur, safeTotal, percent);
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Nuốt lỗi an toàn
    }
  }, [sendRealProgress]);

  // Handler khi iframe tải xong
  const handleIframeLoad = useCallback(() => {
    setIframeLoaded(true);
    syncHeaderWithIframe();
    inspectIframeProgress();

    try {
      const iframe = iframeRef.current;
      const win = iframe?.contentWindow;
      if (win) {
        const onNav = () => {
          syncHeaderWithIframe();
          setTimeout(inspectIframeProgress, 200);
          setTimeout(syncHeaderWithIframe, 300);
        };

        win.addEventListener('click', () => {
          setTimeout(onNav, 150);
          setTimeout(onNav, 450);
        });
        win.addEventListener('hashchange', onNav);
        win.addEventListener('popstate', onNav);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }, [syncHeaderWithIframe, inspectIframeProgress]);

  // Polling liên tục kiểm tra slide & điều hướng iframe mỗi 2 giây
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      syncHeaderWithIframe();
      inspectIframeProgress();
    }, 2000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [open, syncHeaderWithIframe, inspectIframeProgress]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !lecture) return;

    // Reset buffer khi đổi bài giảng để tránh lẫn dữ liệu phiên cũ
    scormDataRef.current = {};

    // ── 3. Hàm bóc tách số liệu từ chuỗi SCORM trả về
    //    (Khai báo TRƯỚC 2 object API để tránh TDZ)
    const parseScormProgress = (value: string) => {
      try {
        let current = 0;
        let total = 0;

        if (value.startsWith('{')) {
          const data = JSON.parse(value);
          current = parseInt(
            data.slideIndex || data.slide || data.currentSlide || 0,
            10
          );
          total = parseInt(
            data.slideTotal || data.totalSlides || data.total || 0,
            10
          );
        } else {
          const match = value.match(/\d+/);
          if (match) current = parseInt(match[0], 10);
        }

        if (current > 0) {
          const safeTotal = total > 0 ? total : Math.max(current, 100);
          const percent = current / safeTotal;
          sendRealProgress(current, safeTotal, percent);
        }
      } catch {
        /* dữ liệu không đúng định dạng → bỏ qua */
      }
    };

    // ── 1. SCORM 1.2 API
    (window as any).API = {
      LMSInitialize: () => 'true',
      LMSFinish: () => 'true',
      LMSGetValue: (key: string) => scormDataRef.current[key] || '',
      LMSSetValue: (key: string, value: string) => {
        scormDataRef.current[key] = value;
        if (key === 'cmi.core.lesson_location' || key === 'cmi.suspend_data') {
          parseScormProgress(value);
        }
        return 'true';
      },
      LMSCommit: () => 'true',
      LMSGetLastError: () => '0',
      LMSGetErrorString: () => '',
      LMSGetDiagnostic: () => '',
    };

    // ── 2. SCORM 2004 API
    (window as any).API_1484_11 = {
      Initialize: () => 'true',
      Terminate: () => 'true',
      GetValue: (key: string) => scormDataRef.current[key] || '',
      SetValue: (key: string, value: string) => {
        scormDataRef.current[key] = value;
        if (key === 'cmi.location' || key === 'cmi.suspend_data') {
          parseScormProgress(value);
        }
        return 'true';
      },
      Commit: () => 'true',
      GetLastError: () => '0',
      GetErrorString: () => '',
      GetDiagnostic: () => '',
    };

    // ── 4. Lắng nghe postMessage cho gói HTML5 thuần & ActivePresenter mode switcher
    const handleMessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (event.data && typeof event.data === 'object') {
        // 🔄 Bắt sự kiện chuyển chế độ khi click nút trong file HTML (index.html: openPrez)
        if (event.data.type === 'AP_CHANGE_MODE' && event.data.file) {
          const rawFile = String(event.data.file).replace(/\\/g, '/');
          const targetName = rawFile.split('/').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';
          const matched = modesRef.current.find((m) => {
            const mFile = (m.file || '').split('/').pop()?.toLowerCase();
            return mFile === targetName;
          });
          if (matched && matched.file !== selectedFile) {
            setSelectedFile(matched.file);
            setIframeLoaded(false);
          }
          return;
        }

        if (event.data.type === 'slideChange' || event.data.type === 'progress') {
          const current = event.data.slideIndex || 0;
          const total = event.data.slideTotal || 100;
          if (current > 0) sendRealProgress(current, total, current / total);
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
      delete (window as any).API;
      delete (window as any).API_1484_11;
    };
  }, [open, lecture, sendRealProgress]);

  // ── Hàm render nội dung dựa trên loại file ──
  const renderContent = () => {
    if (lecture.content_type === 'PDF') {
      if (!lecture.document_id) {
        return (
          <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 p-6 text-center">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-12 h-12 text-amber-500 animate-bounce" />
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Chưa tìm thấy tệp tài liệu PDF</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-md">
              Bài giảng này chưa được gắn mã tệp tài liệu số hóa (document_id). Vui lòng cập nhật tệp giáo án trong mục chỉnh sửa bài giảng.
            </p>
          </div>
        );
      }
      return (
        <div className="relative w-full h-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950">
          {!iframeLoaded && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-950/90 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 z-10 backdrop-blur-xs">
              <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500 animate-spin" />
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Đang nạp tài liệu giáo án PDF...</p>
            </div>
          )}
          <iframe
            key={`pdf-${reloadKey}`}
            src={`/api/files/${lecture.document_id}/view`}
            onLoad={() => setIframeLoaded(true)}
            className="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900"
            title="PDF Viewer"
          />
        </div>
      );
    }

    // SCORM hoặc HTML5
    return (
      <div className="relative w-full h-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950">
        {!iframeLoaded && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-950/90 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 z-10 backdrop-blur-xs">
            <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500 animate-spin" />
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Đang nạp không gian bài giảng số hóa ({lecture.content_type})...</p>
          </div>
        )}
        <iframe
          ref={iframeRef}
          key={`${lecture.lecture_id}-${selectedFile || 'default'}-${reloadKey}`}
          src={launchUrl}
          onLoad={handleIframeLoad}
          className="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white"
          title={`${lecture.content_type} Player`}
          allow="autoplay; fullscreen; microphone; camera; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"
          sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-forms allow-modals allow-downloads"
          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
        />
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (!open || !lecture) return null;

  const isNearLimit = elapsed >= MAX_MINUTES - 20;
  const isOverLimit = elapsed >= MAX_MINUTES;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 flex flex-col text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-sans select-none transition-colors duration-200">
      {/* ── HEADER PHÒNG HỌC THÔNG MINH (Chuẩn UX/UI Đa giao diện Sáng / Tối) ── */}
      <div className="min-h-16 py-2 bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#0b121e]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6 shrink-0 shadow-xs dark:shadow-lg gap-3 transition-colors duration-200">
        {/* Khối bên trái: Bố cục Đang trình chiếu, Tên bài giảng & Thông số phân hệ */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/25 dark:border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex flex-col justify-center">
            {/* Dòng 1: Badge Trạng thái + Tên bài giảng nổi bật */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
                Đang Trình Chiếu
              </span>
              <h1
                className="font-extrabold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-xs md:max-w-sm lg:max-w-md xl:max-w-lg leading-tight"
                title={lecture.title}
              >
                {lecture.title}
              </h1>
            </div>

            {/* Dòng 2: Thông tin chi tiết chuẩn mực (in đậm rõ ràng, tự co giãn thông minh) */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 flex-wrap">
              {/* Sĩ số */}
              <span className="hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                <span>Sĩ số:</span>
                <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {session.student_count ?? 0} Học viên
                </strong>
              </span>

              {session.class_name && (
                <>
                  <span className="hidden md:inline text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700 select-none">•</span>
                  <span className="hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span>Lớp:</span>
                    <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[130px]" title={session.class_name}>
                      {session.class_name}
                    </strong>
                  </span>
                </>
              )}

              {/* Giảng đường: luôn hiển thị */}
              {session.venue_name && (
                <>
                  <span className="hidden md:inline text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700 select-none">•</span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span>Giảng đường:</span>
                    <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[120px]" title={session.venue_name}>
                      {session.venue_name.replace(/^giảng đường\s*:?\s*/i, '')}
                    </strong>
                  </span>
                </>
              )}

              {/* Môn học: luôn hiển thị */}
              {(lecture.subject_name || session.subject_name) && (
                <>
                  <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700 select-none">•</span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span>Môn:</span>
                    <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[160px] sm:max-w-[200px]" title={lecture.subject_name || session.subject_name}>
                      {lecture.subject_name || session.subject_name}
                    </strong>
                  </span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Cụm chuyển đổi chế độ bài giảng đa tương tác (ActivePresenter: Demo / Hướng dẫn / Luyện tập / Kiểm tra) */}
        {modes.length > 1 && (
          <div className="hidden xl:flex items-center bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/90 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 gap-1 shadow-inner shrink-0">
            {modes.map((m) => {
              const isActive = (selectedFile || (modes[0] && modes[0].file)) === m.file;
              return (
                <button
                  key={m.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedFile(m.file);
                    setIframeLoaded(false);
                  }}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md font-bold'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  {m.title}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Cụm điều khiển thời lượng & kết thúc */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono font-bold transition-colors ${
              isOverLimit
                ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/20 dark:border-rose-500 dark:text-rose-300 animate-pulse'
                : isNearLimit
                ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:border-amber-500 dark:text-amber-300'
                : 'bg-slate-100 border-slate-200 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:border-white/[0.08] dark:text-emerald-400'
            }`}
            title={isOverLimit ? 'Đã vượt quá thời lượng tối đa' : undefined}
          >
            {isNearLimit ? (
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
            ) : (
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            )}
            <span>{elapsed} phút</span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIframeLoaded(false);
              setReloadKey(k => k + 1);
            }}
            title="Tải lại nội dung bài giảng"
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Tải lại</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}
            disabled={ending}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-red-600 hover:from-rose-500 hover:to-red-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition disabled:opacity-50 shadow-md shadow-rose-950/20 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
          >
            {ending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>Đang kết thúc...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Square className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" />
                <span>Kết thúc ca dạy</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── BODY: Trình chiếu nội dung SCORM / HTML5 / PDF ── */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 relative">
        {renderContent()}
      </div>

      {/* ── MODAL CHIẾN THUẬT: XÁC NHẬN KẾT THÚC CA GIẢNG DẠY (Dignified Military UX/UI) ── */}
      {confirmOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[10000] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="w-full max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.1] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
            {/* Modal Header với logo Học viện / Sư phạm Quân sự */}
            <div className="p-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-inner">
                <GraduationCap className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-tight">
                  Xác nhận kết thúc ca giảng dạy
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                  Đồng chí xác nhận hoàn tất nội dung giảng dạy và bàn giao giảng đường số hóa
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Body: Thẻ tóm tắt thông tin ca dạy */}
            <div className="p-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.06] p-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider block">Bài học</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white block truncate">{lecture.title}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/[0.04]">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block">Giảng đường</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block">{session.venue_name}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500 shrink-0" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block">Lớp học</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block">{session.class_name || 'Lớp học'}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/[0.04]">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-500 shrink-0" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block">Thời lượng giảng</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono truncate block">{elapsed} phút</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <User className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-500 shrink-0" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block">Sĩ số học viên</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono truncate block">{session.student_count} đồng chí</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50/80 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-200/60 dark:border-emerald-800/40 text-xs text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>Thời gian giảng dạy và tiến độ ca dạy sẽ được tự động lưu trữ vào Lịch sử đào tạo của Nhà trường.</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Footer Actions */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              >
                Tiếp tục giảng bài
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmEndSession}
                disabled={ending}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white text-xs font-bold transition shadow-md shadow-emerald-950/20 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {ending ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Đang lưu & kết thúc...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                    <span>Xác nhận kết thúc ca</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default LiveSessionRoom;
