import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { XCircle, AlertTriangle, X, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Lecture } from '../../types/lecture';

export interface RejectReasonModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  lecture: Lecture | null;
  onConfirm: (reason: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const QUICK_REASONS = [
  'Nội dung cần bổ sung tài liệu tham khảo theo quy chuẩn giáo trình',
  'Chưa cập nhật đúng mẫu giáo án điện tử và quy định giảng dạy của Nhà trường',
  'Cấp độ bảo mật chưa tương xứng với nội dung bài học',
  'Đề nghị rà soát lại số liệu kỹ thuật, sơ đồ tác chiến và câu hỏi Quiz',
];

export const RejectReasonModal: React.FC<RejectReasonModalProps> = ({
  open,
  lecture,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setReason('');
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [open]);

  if (!open || !lecture) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reason.trim()) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onConfirm(reason.trim());
      onClose();
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-sm">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 12, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 26, mass: 0.75 }}
          className="w-full max-w-lg bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#0c1420]/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-2xl relative text-left"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border bg-rose-500/15 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0">
                <XCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Từ Chối Phê Duyệt Bài Giảng
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                  Ý kiến chỉ đạo sẽ được gửi trực tiếp tới giảng viên tác giả
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={submitting}
              className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Thông tin bài giảng tóm tắt */}
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] mb-4 text-xs space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                {lecture.lecture_code}
              </span>
              <span className="text-slate-400">•</span>
              <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold truncate">
                {lecture.title}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Tác giả: <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{lecture.author_name || 'Giảng viên'}</strong></span>
              <span>•</span>
              <span>Khoa: {lecture.faculty_name || 'Bộ môn'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">
                Lý Do Từ Chối / Yêu Cầu Chỉnh Sửa <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <textarea
                value={reason}
                onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                required
                rows={3}
                placeholder="Nhập chi tiết các nội dung cần sửa đổi, bổ sung..."
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-rose-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-600 transition"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Gợi ý lý do nhanh */}
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1.5">
                Gợi ý lý do nhận xét nhanh:
              </span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {QUICK_REASONS.map((r, i) => (
                  <button
                    key={i}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setReason(r)}
                    className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-700 hover:border-rose-300 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 dark:hover:text-rose-300 dark:hover:border-rose-500/30 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 transition text-left"
                  >
                    + {r}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Footer Buttons */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={submitting}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition"
              >
                Hủy bỏ
              </button>

                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting || !reason.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#b91c1c] to-[#dc2626] hover:from-[#dc2626] hover:to-[#ef4444] text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs transition shadow-md shadow-rose-950/20 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{submitting ? 'Đang gửi...' : 'Xác nhận từ chối'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, Play, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { lectureService } from '../../services/lectureService';
import { toast } from '../common/Toast';
import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { Lecture, TrainingClass, SessionType, TeachingSchedule } from '../../types/lecture';

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  lecture: Lecture | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onStarted: (session: TeachingSchedule, lecture: Lecture) => void;
}

export const StartSessionModal: React.FC<Props> = ({ open, lecture, onClose, onStarted }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [classes, setClasses] = useState<TrainingClass[]>([]);
  const [venues, setVenues] = useState<{ venue_name: string; usage_count: number }[]>([]);
  const [classId, setClassId] = useState('');
  const [venue, setVenue] = useState('');
  const [studentCount, setStudentCount] = useState<string>('');
  const [sessionType, setSessionType] = useState<SessionType>('TEACHER_LED');
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    Promise.all([lectureService.getClasses(), lectureService.getVenues()])
      .then(([cls, vns]) => {
        setClasses(Array.isArray(cls) ? cls : []);
        setVenues(Array.isArray(vns) ? vns : []);
      })
      .catch((err: any) => {
        console.error('[StartSessionModal catalogs]', err);
        toast.error('Không thể tải danh sách lớp / giảng đường');
        setClasses([]);
        setVenues([]);
      });
    setClassId('');
    setVenue('');
    setStudentCount('');
    setSessionType('TEACHER_LED');
    setNote('');
    setError('');
  }, [open]);

  if (!open || !lecture) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    if (!classId) return setError('Vui lòng chọn lớp học');
    if (!venue.trim()) return setError('Vui lòng nhập giảng đường');

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const parsedCount = parseInt(studentCount, 10);
      const count = Number.isFinite(parsedCount) && parsedCount >= 0 ? parsedCount : 0;

      const { schedule_id } = await lectureService.startSchedule({
        lecture_id: lecture.lecture_id,
        class_id: classId,
        venue_name: venue.trim(),
        student_count: count,
        session_type: sessionType,
        note: note.trim() || undefined,
      });

      const selectedClass = classes.find(c => c.class_id === classId);

      // Construct đầy đủ TeachingSchedule để LiveSessionRoom render được ngay
      const session: TeachingSchedule = {
  schedule_id,
  lecture_id:         lecture.lecture_id,
  lecture_title:      lecture.title,
  subject_name:       lecture.subject_name,

  presenter_id:       user?.user_id ?? lecture.author_id,
  presenter_name:     user?.full_name ?? lecture.author_name,
  presenter_rank:     user?.rank_name ?? lecture.author_rank,
  presenter_position: user?.position,

  class_id:           classId,
  class_name:         selectedClass?.class_name,
  venue_name:         venue.trim(),
  student_count:      count,
  session_type:       sessionType,
  note:               note.trim() || undefined,
  start_time:         new Date().toISOString(),
  status:             'ONGOING',
  is_hanging:         false,
  quiz_activated_count: 0,
  quiz_total_count:     0,
};

      toast.success(`Đã mở ca giảng dạy cho "${lecture.title}"`);
      onStarted(session, lecture);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Mở ca thất bại');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <Play className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 fill-emerald-600/30" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Mở ca giảng dạy</h3>
              <p
                className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[260px]"
                title={lecture.title}
              >
                {lecture.title}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={submitting}
            className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-3.5 text-xs">
          {error && (
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30 rounded-lg text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Lớp học <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <select
              value={classId}
              onChange={e => setClassId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg cursor-pointer text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-600"
            >
              <option value="">Chọn lớp</option>
              {classes.map(c => (
                <option key={c.class_id} value={c.class_id}>{c.class_name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Giảng đường <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              list="venues-list"
              value={venue}
              onChange={e => setVenue(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="VD: Giảng đường A1"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-600 [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:hidden [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:opacity-0"
            />
            <datalist id="venues-list">
              {venues.map(v => (
                <option key={v.venue_name} value={v.venue_name} />
              ))}
            </datalist>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Sĩ số học viên</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={studentCount}
                onChange={e => setStudentCount(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="VD: 100"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-mono tabular-nums focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-600 [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Loại ca</label>
              <select
                value={sessionType}
                onChange={e => setSessionType(e.target.value as SessionType)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg cursor-pointer text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-600"
              >
                <option value="TEACHER_LED">GV giảng dạy</option>
                <option value="SELF_STUDY">Tự học</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Ghi chú</label>
            <textarea
              value={note}
              onChange={e => setNote(e.target.value)}
              rows={2}
              placeholder="VD: Ôn tập kiến thức"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg resize-none text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-600 placeholder:text-slate-400 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={submitting}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg font-semibold disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              Hủy
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#166534] via-[#15803d] to-[#16a34a] hover:from-[#15803d] hover:to-[#22c55e] border border-emerald-400/30 text-white rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-40 shadow-sm transition active:scale-[0.98]"
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Đang mở...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-white/20" />
                  <span>Mở ca dạy</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Clock, RefreshCw, Calendar, User, Building2, Users, TrendingUp, History, GraduationCap
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { lectureService } from '../../services/lectureService';
import { TeachingSchedule, HistoryKpi } from '../../types/lecture';
import { RollingNumber } from '../common/RollingNumber';
import { TacticalEmptyState } from '../common/TacticalEmptyState';
import { DateRangePicker } from '../common/DateRangePicker';

const HistoryKpiCard: React.FC<{
  label: string;
  value: number;
  suffix?: string;
  icon: any;
  tone: 'emerald' | 'amber' | 'blue' | 'purple';
  delay?: number;
  refreshKey?: number | string;
}> = ({ label, value, suffix, icon: Icon, tone, delay = 0, refreshKey }) => {
  const toneCfg = {
    emerald: {
      border: 'border-l-emerald-600 dark:border-l-emerald-500',
      bgIcon: 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
      text: 'text-slate-900 dark:text-white',
    },
    amber: {
      border: 'border-l-amber-500',
      bgIcon: 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
      text: 'text-slate-900 dark:text-white',
    },
    blue: {
      border: 'border-l-blue-500',
      bgIcon: 'bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400',
      text: 'text-slate-900 dark:text-white',
    },
    purple: {
      border: 'border-l-purple-500',
      bgIcon: 'bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400',
      text: 'text-slate-900 dark:text-white',
    },
  }[tone];

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12, scale: 0.98 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 360, damping: 26, delay }}
      className={`bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] border-l-4 ${toneCfg.border} shadow-2xs hover:shadow-xs relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-white/20 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
          {label}
        </span>
        <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${toneCfg.bgIcon} group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform`}>
          <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 mt-2.5">
        <div className={`text-2xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums tracking-tight ${toneCfg.text}`}>
          <RollingNumber value={value} refreshKey={refreshKey} />
        </div>
        {suffix && (
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {suffix}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export const TeachingHistoryPanel: React.FC = () => {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<TeachingSchedule[]>([]);
  const [kpi, setKpi] = useState<HistoryKpi | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState('');
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState('');
  const [historyRefreshKey, setHistoryRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await lectureService.getHistory({
        from: fromDate || undefined,
        to: toDate || undefined,
      });
      setItems(res.items || []);
      setKpi(res.kpi || null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Load history failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(load, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [fromDate, toDate]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Bộ lọc khoảng thời gian chuẩn Kho dữ liệu chung (DateRangePicker) */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-stretch lg:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <History className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              Nhật Ký & Lịch Sử Giảng Dạy Quân Sự
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Tra cứu ca học đã hoàn thành và tổng hợp chỉ số sư phạm toàn học viện
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Cụm DateRangePicker tái sử dụng từ Kho dữ liệu chung */}
        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-2.5">
          <DateRangePicker
            startDate={fromDate}
            endDate={toDate}
            onChange={(start, end) => {
              setFromDate(start);
              setToDate(end);
              setHistoryRefreshKey((prev) => prev + 1);
            }}
            onClear={() => {
              setFromDate('');
              setToDate('');
              setHistoryRefreshKey((prev) => prev + 1);
            }}
            compact={true}
            placeholder="Khoảng thời gian giảng dạy (Từ - Đến)"
          />

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setHistoryRefreshKey((prev) => prev + 1);
              load();
            }}
            disabled={loading}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 min-h-[38px]"
            title="Làm mới dữ liệu"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>Làm mới</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Thống kê sư phạm cuộn số RollingNumber */}
      {kpi && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <HistoryKpiCard
            label="Tổng số ca đã dạy"
            value={kpi.total_sessions || 0}
            suffix="ca"
            icon={Calendar}
            tone="blue"
            delay={0}
            refreshKey={historyRefreshKey}
          />
          <HistoryKpiCard
            label="Tổng giờ giảng bài"
            value={kpi.total_hours || 0}
            suffix="giờ"
            icon={Clock}
            tone="emerald"
            delay={0.05}
            refreshKey={historyRefreshKey}
          />
          <HistoryKpiCard
            label="Tổng lượt học viên"
            value={kpi.total_students || 0}
            suffix="lượt"
            icon={Users}
            tone="amber"
            delay={0.1}
            refreshKey={historyRefreshKey}
          />
          <HistoryKpiCard
            label="Ca giảng viên trực tiếp"
            value={kpi.teacher_led_sessions || 0}
            suffix="ca"
            icon={TrendingUp}
            tone="purple"
            delay={0.15}
            refreshKey={historyRefreshKey}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bảng danh sách lịch sử */}
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] shadow-xs">
          <TacticalEmptyState
            title="Chưa có dữ liệu lịch sử trong khoảng thời gian này"
            description="Các ca giảng dạy sau khi kết thúc sẽ được lưu trữ tự động vào nhật ký hệ thống để phục vụ công tác thanh tra đào tạo và thống kê giờ giảng."
            icon={<Clock className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500" />}
            onRefresh={load}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {items.map((s) => {
            const presenterFull = [s.presenter_rank, s.presenter_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || s.presenter_name || 'Chưa xác định';
            const venueLabel = s.venue_name || '1';
            const classLabel = s.class_name || 'Học viên';
            const studentCountLabel = s.student_count ?? 0;

            const startDate = s.start_time ? new Date(s.start_time) : null;
            const startTimeStr = startDate ? startDate.toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '--:--';
            const endDate = s.end_time
              ? new Date(s.end_time)
              : (startDate && s.duration_minutes
                  ? new Date(startDate.getTime() + s.duration_minutes * 60000)
                  : null);
            const endTimeStr = endDate ? endDate.toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '--:--';
            const dateStr = startDate ? startDate.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' }) : '';

            return (
              <div
                key={s.schedule_id}
                className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:border-emerald-500/40 hover:shadow-xs transition-all"
              >
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-1" title={s.lecture_title}>
                      {s.lecture_title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30 shrink-0">
                      Hoàn thành
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1.5">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span>Giảng viên: <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{presenterFull}</strong></span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span>Giảng đường: <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{venueLabel}</strong></span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <GraduationCap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span>Lớp: <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{classLabel}</strong></span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span>Sĩ số học viên tham gia: <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{studentCountLabel}</strong></span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0 text-xs">
                  <div className="text-right flex flex-col items-end justify-center">
                    <div className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {startTimeStr} - {endTimeStr}
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                      {dateStr}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30 text-xs shadow-2xs">
                    {s.duration_minutes || 0} phút
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TeachingHistoryPanel;

import React from 'react';
import { FileText, Eye, Download, Lock, Calendar, Building, HardDrive } from 'lucide-react';
import { DocumentItem } from '../../types';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/dateUtils';
import { formatFileSize } from '../../utils/formatFileSize';
import { CompactDownloadButton } from '../common/CompactDownloadButton';

export interface DocumentCardProps {
  document: DocumentItem;
  userClearanceLevel: number;
  onPreview: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
  onDownload: (doc: DocumentItem, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<(() => void) | void> | (() => void) | void;
  onCancelDownload?: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
}

export const DocumentCard: React.FC<DocumentCardProps> = ({
  document,
  userClearanceLevel,
  onPreview,
  onDownload,
  onCancelDownload,
}) => {
  const isRestricted = (document.security_level_id || 1) > userClearanceLevel;

  const getLevelBadgeClass = (lv: number) => {
    switch (lv) {
      case 5:
        return 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border-red-500/30';
      case 4:
        return 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30';
      case 3:
        return 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30';
      case 2:
        return 'bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-500/30';
      default:
        return 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30';
    }
  };

  const docLevel = document.security_level_id || 1;
  // Cấp 1, 2: được tải về nếu clearance >= docLevel. Từ cấp 3 trở đi (Cấp 3, 4, 5): CHỈ ĐƯỢC XEM, KHÔNG ĐƯỢC TẢI VỀ
  const canDownload = docLevel <= 2 && docLevel <= userClearanceLevel;
  const isSecretLevel = docLevel >= 3;

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-emerald-600/40 dark:hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition-colors duration-150 group">
      <div>
        {/* Top Badges */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2.5">
          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-amber-800 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-600/25 dark:text-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:border-amber-500/25 tracking-wide truncate">
            {document.document_code}
          </span>
          <span
            className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border shrink-0 ${getLevelBadgeClass(
              document.security_level_id || 1
            )}`}
          >
            {document.security_name || document.security_level_name || `Cấp ${document.security_level_id}`}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Title */}
        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white group-hover:text-emerald-700 dark:group-hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors line-clamp-2 mb-2">
          {document.title}
        </h4>

        {/* Summary */}
        {document.summary && (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 line-clamp-2 mb-3">
            {document.summary}
          </p>
        )}

        {/* Metadata Details */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Thể loại:</span>
            <span
              className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right flex-1 break-normal leading-snug"
              title={document.doc_type_name || document.type_name}
            >
              {document.doc_type_name || document.type_name || '—'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Đơn vị:</span>
            <span
              className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right flex-1 break-normal leading-snug"
              title={document.unit_name}
            >
              {document.unit_name || '—'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Ngày BH:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right">
              {formatDate(document.issued_date || document.issue_date)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Dung lượng:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right">
              {formatFileSize(document.file_size ?? document.file_size_bytes)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Action Footer */}
      <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
        {isRestricted ? (
          <div className="w-full min-h-[40px] py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
            <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Giới hạn quyền truy cập</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                try {
                  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !window.document.fullscreenElement) {
                    window.document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
                  }
                } catch (_) {}
                onPreview(document);
              }}
              className="flex-1 min-h-[40px] py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Xem văn bản PDF</span>
            </button>
            <CompactDownloadButton
              onDownload={(signal) => onDownload(document, signal)}
              onCancel={() => onCancelDownload?.(document)}
              disabled={!canDownload}
              disabledTitle={
                isSecretLevel
                  ? 'Tài liệu từ Cấp 3 trở lên chỉ duy nhất cho phép xem trực tiếp, không được phép tải về máy'
                  : `Cấp độ bảo mật (Cấp ${userClearanceLevel}) không đủ để tải văn bản Cấp ${docLevel}`
              }
              fileSize={formatFileSize(document.file_size ?? document.file_size_bytes)}
              size="normal"
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Skeleton } from 'antd';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { DocumentItem } from '../../types';
import { DocumentCard } from './DocumentCard';
import { TacticalEmptyState } from '../common/TacticalEmptyState';

export interface PortalDocumentListProps {
  documents: DocumentItem[];
  userClearanceLevel: number;
  loading?: boolean;
  currentPage: number;
  totalPages: number;
  totalItems: number;
  searchQuery?: string;
  onClearFilters?: () => void;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPreview: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
  onDownload: (doc: DocumentItem, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<(() => void) | void> | (() => void) | void;
  onCancelDownload?: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
}

export const PortalDocumentList: React.FC<PortalDocumentListProps> = ({
  documents,
  userClearanceLevel,
  loading = false,
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  totalItems,
  searchQuery,
  onClearFilters,
  onPageChange,
  onPreview,
  onDownload,
  onCancelDownload,
}) => {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, idx) => (
          <div
            key={`portal-doc-skeleton-${idx}`}
            className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#111827] rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4"
          >
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center gap-2">
                <Skeleton.Button active size="small" style={{ width: 85, height: 22, borderRadius: 6 }} />
                <Skeleton.Button active size="small" style={{ width: 70, height: 22, borderRadius: 6 }} />
              </div>
              <Skeleton active paragraph={{ rows: 2, width: ['100%', '75%'] }} title={{ width: '85%' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between">
              <Skeleton.Input active size="small" style={{ width: 110, height: 18, borderRadius: 4 }} />
              <Skeleton.Button active size="small" style={{ width: 75, height: 28, borderRadius: 8 }} />
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (documents.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-md overflow-hidden">
        <TacticalEmptyState
          title="Không tìm thấy văn bản phù hợp"
          description="Không có tài liệu nào khớp với từ khóa tìm kiếm hoặc bộ lọc hiện tại. Đồng chí vui lòng kiểm tra lại từ khóa hoặc xóa bộ lọc."
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          onClearFilters={onClearFilters}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {documents.map((doc, idx) => (
          <div
            key={doc.file_id}
            id={idx === 0 ? 'tour-document-card' : undefined}
            data-tour={idx === 0 ? 'document-card' : undefined}
            className="h-full"
          >
            <DocumentCard
              document={doc}
              userClearanceLevel={userClearanceLevel}
              onPreview={onPreview}
              onDownload={onDownload}
              onCancelDownload={onCancelDownload}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 shadow-sm">
          <div>
            Hiển thị trang{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{currentPage}</span> /{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{totalPages}</span> (Tổng{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{totalItems}</span> tài liệu)
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
            <button
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
              disabled={currentPage <= 1}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            {Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1)
              .filter((p) => p === 1 || p === totalPages || Math.abs(p - currentPage) <= 1)
              .map((p, idx, arr) => {
                const prev = arr[idx - 1];
                const showEllipsis = prev && p - prev > 1;
                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={p}>
                    {showEllipsis && <span className="px-1 text-slate-400">...</span>}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onPageChange(p)}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition text-xs ${
                        currentPage === p
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {p}
                    </button>
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            <button
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
              disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
