import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Modal, Input, Spin, Empty, Alert, Tooltip } from 'antd';
import {
  Shield, Search, CheckCircle2, ChevronDown, ChevronRight,
  X, Save, AlertTriangle,
  FileText, Users, KeyRound, ShieldAlert, BookOpen, Fingerprint,
  Activity, Bot, Settings, Monitor, MonitorPlay,
} from 'lucide-react';

import { permissionService } from '../../services/permissionService';
import { Role, Permission, SubGroupInfo, SubGroupTone } from '../../types/user';
import {
  SUBGROUP_TONE_STYLE,
  TONE_PRIORITY,
  getSubGroupFromPermission,
} from '../../constants/permissionSubGroups';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// GROUP CONFIG — đồng bộ với GrantPermissionModal
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const GROUP_CONFIG: Record<string, {
  label: string;
  icon: React.ElementType;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
  border: string;
}> = {
  DOCUMENT:    { label: 'Văn bản',    icon: FileText,    color: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400', bg: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10', border: 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30' },
  LECTURE:     { label: 'Bài giảng',  icon: MonitorPlay, color: 'text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400',       bg: 'bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-500/10',       border: 'border-cyan-200 dark:border-cyan-500/30' },
  USER:        { label: 'Người dùng', icon: Users,       color: 'text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400',         bg: 'bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-500/10',         border: 'border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-500/30' },
  ROLE:        { label: 'Vai trò',    icon: KeyRound,    color: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',     bg: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10',     border: 'border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30' },
  PERMISSION:  { label: 'Quyền',      icon: ShieldAlert, color: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400',       bg: 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10',       border: 'border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/30' },
  CATALOG:     { label: 'Danh mục',   icon: BookOpen,    color: 'text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400',   bg: 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-500/10',   border: 'border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/30' },
  FINGERPRINT: { label: 'Sinh trắc',  icon: Fingerprint, color: 'text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400',       bg: 'bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-500/10',       border: 'border-cyan-200 dark:border-cyan-500/30' },
  AUDIT:       { label: 'Kiểm toán',  icon: Activity,    color: 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400',   bg: 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10',   border: 'border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-500/30' },
  AI:          { label: 'Trợ lý AI',  icon: Bot,         color: 'text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-400',       bg: 'bg-teal-50 dark:bg-teal-500/10',       border: 'border-teal-200 dark:border-teal-500/30' },
  SYSTEM:      { label: 'Hệ thống',   icon: Settings,    color: 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400',     bg: 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700/40',    border: 'border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600/40' },
  SESSION:     { label: 'Phiên',      icon: Monitor,     color: 'text-lime-700 dark:text-lime-400',       bg: 'bg-lime-50 dark:bg-lime-500/10',       border: 'border-lime-200 dark:border-lime-500/30' },
};

const DANGEROUS_CODES = new Set(['DOC_PURGE', 'PERMISSION_DELETE', 'ROLE_DELETE', 'USER_DELETE', 'SESSION_KILL']);

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TYPES
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
type RolePermUIState = 'assigned' | 'unassigned' | 'pending_grant' | 'pending_revoke';

interface RolePermissionRow extends Permission {
  ui_state: RolePermUIState;
  subgroup: SubGroupInfo;
}

export interface RolePermissionModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  role: Role | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
  onToast: (msg: string, type?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info') => void;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN COMPONENT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export const RolePermissionModal: React.FC<RolePermissionModalProps> = ({
  open, role, onClose, onSaved, onToast,
}) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<RolePermissionRow[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'all' | 'assigned' | 'unassigned' | 'changed'>('all');
  const [expandedGroups, setExpandedGroups] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const groupRefs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLDivElement | null>>({});
  const isAdminRole = role?.role_id === 'ROL-01';

  // ─── Load catalog + role permissions ───
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !role) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setSearch('');
    setTab('all');

    Promise.all([
      permissionService.getPermissions(),
      permissionService.getRolePermissions(role.role_id),
    ])
      .then(([catalog, rolePerms]) => {
        const assignedIds = new Set((rolePerms.items || []).map((p) => p.permission_id));
        const merged: RolePermissionRow[] = (catalog.items || []).map((p: Permission) => ({
          ...p,
          ui_state: assignedIds.has(p.permission_id) ? 'assigned' : 'unassigned',
          subgroup: getSubGroupFromPermission(p),
        }));
        merged.sort((a, b) => (a.sort_order ?? 0) - (b.sort_order ?? 0));
        setRows(merged);
        setExpandedGroups(new Set(merged.map((r) => r.group_code || 'SYSTEM')));
      })
      .catch((err) => onToast('Lỗi tải quyền: ' + err.message, 'error'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [open, role, onToast]);

  // ─── Stats ───
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    let assigned = 0, pendingGrants = 0, pendingRevokes = 0;
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (r.ui_state === 'assigned') assigned++;
      if (r.ui_state === 'pending_grant') pendingGrants++;
      if (r.ui_state === 'pending_revoke') pendingRevokes++;
    }
    return {
      total: rows.length,
      assigned,
      unassigned: rows.length - assigned,
      pendingGrants,
      pendingRevokes,
      totalChanges: pendingGrants + pendingRevokes,
    };
  }, [rows]);

  // ─── Filter ───
  const filteredRows = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return rows.filter((r) => {
      if (tab === 'assigned' && r.ui_state !== 'assigned' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_revoke') return false;
      if (tab === 'unassigned' && r.ui_state !== 'unassigned' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_grant') return false;
      if (tab === 'changed' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_grant' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_revoke') return false;
      if (q) {
        const hay = `${r.code || ''} ${r.description || ''} ${r.permission_id}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [rows, tab, search]);

  // ─── Group 2 tầng ───
  const groupedData = useMemo(() => {
    const byGroup = new Map<string, RolePermissionRow[]>();
    for (const r of filteredRows) {
      const g = r.group_code || 'SYSTEM';
      if (!byGroup.has(g)) byGroup.set(g, []);
      byGroup.get(g)!.push(r);
    }

    return Object.keys(GROUP_CONFIG)
      .filter((g) => byGroup.has(g))
      .map((group_code) => {
        const rowsInGroup = byGroup.get(group_code)!;
        const bySub = new Map<string, RolePermissionRow[]>();
        for (const r of rowsInGroup) {
          if (!bySub.has(r.subgroup.key)) bySub.set(r.subgroup.key, []);
          bySub.get(r.subgroup.key)!.push(r);
        }
        const subgroups = Array.from(bySub.entries())
          .map(([key, subRows]) => {
            const tones = new Set<SubGroupTone>(subRows.map((r) => r.subgroup.tone));
            const tonesArr = Array.from(tones);
            const maxTone = tonesArr.reduce<SubGroupTone>(
              (acc, t) => (TONE_PRIORITY[t] > TONE_PRIORITY[acc] ? t : acc),
              'read'
            );
            return {
              key,
              info: { ...subRows[0].subgroup, tone: maxTone, mixedTone: tones.size > 1 } as SubGroupInfo,
              rows: subRows.sort((a, b) => (a.code || '').localeCompare(b.code || '')),
            };
          })
          .sort((a, b) => a.info.order - b.info.order);

        return { group_code, subgroups, total: rowsInGroup.length };
      });
  }, [filteredRows]);

  // ─── Handlers ───
  const toggleExpand = (groupCode: string) => {
    setExpandedGroups((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(groupCode)) next.delete(groupCode);
      else next.add(groupCode);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const togglePermission = (row: RolePermissionRow) => {
    if (isAdminRole) {
      onToast('Role Admin (ROL-01) đã bypass toàn quyền — không cần gán quyền cụ thể.', 'info');
      return;
    }
    setRows((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) => {
        if (r.permission_id !== row.permission_id) return r;
        if (r.ui_state === 'assigned') return { ...r, ui_state: 'pending_revoke' };
        if (r.ui_state === 'pending_revoke') return { ...r, ui_state: 'assigned' };
        if (r.ui_state === 'unassigned') return { ...r, ui_state: 'pending_grant' };
        if (r.ui_state === 'pending_grant') return { ...r, ui_state: 'unassigned' };
        return r;
      })
    );
  };

  const handleSelectAllSubGroup = (subRows: RolePermissionRow[]) => {
    if (isAdminRole) return;
    const unassigned = subRows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'unassigned');
    if (unassigned.length === 0) return;
    setRows((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) =>
        unassigned.some((a) => a.permission_id === r.permission_id)
          ? { ...r, ui_state: 'pending_grant' }
          : r
      )
    );
  };

  const handleUnselectAllSubGroup = (subRows: RolePermissionRow[]) => {
    if (isAdminRole) return;
    const assigned = subRows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'assigned');
    if (assigned.length === 0) return;
    setRows((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) =>
        assigned.some((a) => a.permission_id === r.permission_id)
          ? { ...r, ui_state: 'pending_revoke' }
          : r
      )
    );
  };

  const handleScrollToGroup = (groupCode: string) => {
    setExpandedGroups((prev) => new Set(prev).add(groupCode));
    setTimeout(() => {
      groupRefs.current[groupCode]?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 50);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!role || isAdminRole) return;
    const grants = rows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'pending_grant');
    const revokes = rows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'pending_revoke');

    if (grants.length === 0 && revokes.length === 0) {
      onToast('Không có thay đổi nào', 'info');
      onClose();
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      for (const g of grants) {
        await permissionService.assignPermissionToRole(role.role_id, g.permission_id);
      }
      for (const r of revokes) {
        await permissionService.revokePermissionFromRole(role.role_id, r.permission_id);
      }
      onToast(`Đã cập nhật role ${role.name}: +${grants.length} thêm, -${revokes.length} gỡ`, 'success');
      onSaved();
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      onToast('Lỗi lưu: ' + err.message, 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (!open || !role) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={onClose}
      width={1080}
      centered
      footer={null}
      destroyOnHidden
      title={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
            <KeyRound className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              Phân Quyền Cho Vai Trò
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              {role.name} ({role.role_id})
              {isAdminRole && (
                <span className="ml-2 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                  • Quyền Admin (bypass toàn bộ)
                </span>
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    >
      {loading ? (
        <div className="py-16 flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
          <Spin size="large" />
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Đang tải danh mục quyền...</span>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3 pt-3">
          {isAdminRole && (
            <Alert
              type="warning"
              showIcon
              icon={<AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />}
              message={<span className="text-xs font-semibold">Vai trò Admin (ROL-01) — bypass toàn quyền</span>}
              description={<span className="text-[11px]">Role này tự động pass mọi kiểm tra quyền qua hàm <code>isAdminBypass</code>. Không cần và không nên gán quyền cụ thể. Nhấn Đóng để thoát.</span>}
            />
          )}

          {/* KPI */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
            <StatBox icon={<Shield className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Tổng quyền" value={stats.total} color="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400" bg="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600/40" />
            <StatBox icon={<CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Đã gán" value={stats.assigned} color="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" bg="bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30" />
            <StatBox icon={<X className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Chưa gán" value={stats.unassigned} color="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400" bg="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600/40" />
            <StatBox icon={<Save className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Thay đổi chờ lưu" value={stats.totalChanges} color={stats.totalChanges > 0 ? 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400' : 'text-slate-400'} bg={stats.totalChanges > 0 ? 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-500/10 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/30' : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600/40'} />
          </div>

          {/* Toolbar */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-0.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
              {([
                { k: 'all',        l: `Tất cả (${stats.total})` },
                { k: 'assigned',   l: `Đã gán (${stats.assigned})` },
                { k: 'unassigned', l: `Chưa gán (${stats.unassigned})` },
                { k: 'changed',    l: `Thay đổi (${stats.totalChanges})` },
              ] as const).map(({ k, l }) => (
                <button
                  key={k}
                  onClick={() => setTab(k)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition ${
                    tab === k
                      ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  {l}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <Input
              placeholder="Tìm mã quyền / mô tả..."
              prefix={<Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />}
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              allowClear
              className="flex-1 min-w-[220px]"
            />

            <button
              onClick={() => setExpandedGroups(new Set(groupedData.map((g) => g.group_code)))}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
            >
              Mở rộng
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setExpandedGroups(new Set())}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
            >
              Thu gọn
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Group pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1">
            {groupedData.map(({ group_code, total }) => {
              const cfg = GROUP_CONFIG[group_code] || GROUP_CONFIG.SYSTEM;
              const Icon = cfg.icon;
              return (
                <button
                  key={group_code}
                  onClick={() => handleScrollToGroup(group_code)}
                  className={`shrink-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold border transition ${cfg.bg} ${cfg.border} ${cfg.color} hover:shadow-sm`}
                >
                  <Icon className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>{cfg.label}</span>
                  <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/20 text-[10px] font-mono">{total}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Content — 2 tầng */}
          <div className="max-h-[48vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1 space-y-2">
            {groupedData.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-12 text-center">
                <Empty description="Không có quyền nào khớp bộ lọc" />
              </div>
            ) : (
              groupedData.map(({ group_code, subgroups }) => {
                const cfg = GROUP_CONFIG[group_code] || GROUP_CONFIG.SYSTEM;
                const Icon = cfg.icon;
                const isExpanded = expandedGroups.has(group_code);

                return (
                  <div
                    key={group_code}
                    ref={(el) => { groupRefs.current[group_code] = el; }}
                    className="border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/40"
                  >
                    <button
                      onClick={() => toggleExpand(group_code)}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 ${cfg.bg} hover:brightness-95 transition`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        {isExpanded ? (
                          <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 ${cfg.color}`} />
                        ) : (
                          <ChevronRight className={`w-4 h-4 ${cfg.color}`} />
                        )}
                        <div className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-lg ${cfg.bg} ${cfg.border} border flex items-center justify-center ${cfg.color}`}>
                          <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-left">
                          <div className={`font-bold text-xs ${cfg.color}`}>
                            {cfg.label}{' '}
                            <span className="font-normal opacity-70">
                              ({subgroups.reduce((s, sg) => s + sg.rows.length, 0)} quyền / {subgroups.length} phân loại)
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </button>

                    {isExpanded && (
                      <div className="p-2 space-y-2">
                        {subgroups.map(({ key, info, rows: subRows }) => {
                          const tone = SUBGROUP_TONE_STYLE[info.tone];
                          const assignedCount = subRows.filter(
                            (r) => r.ui_state === 'assigned' || r.ui_state === 'pending_grant'
                          ).length;
                          const unassignedCount = subRows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'unassigned').length;

                          return (
                            <div key={key} className={`rounded-lg border ${tone.border} ${tone.bg} overflow-hidden`}>
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${tone.dot}`} />
                                  <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${tone.text}`}>{info.label}</span>
                                  {info.mixedTone && (
                                    <Tooltip title="Phân loại này chứa cả quyền 'xem' và 'chỉnh sửa'">
                                      <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                        2 mức
                                      </span>
                                    </Tooltip>
                                  )}
                                  <span className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono border ${tone.badge}`}>
                                    {assignedCount}/{subRows.length}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                {!isAdminRole && (
                                  <div className="flex gap-1">
                                    {unassignedCount > 0 && (
                                      <button
                                        onClick={() => handleSelectAllSubGroup(subRows)}
                                        className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${tone.text} hover:underline px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/50 dark:hover:bg-black/20`}
                                        title={`Gán tất cả ${unassignedCount} quyền còn lại`}
                                      >
                                        + Chọn {unassignedCount}
                                      </button>
                                    )}
                                    {assignedCount > 0 && (
                                      <button
                                        onClick={() => handleUnselectAllSubGroup(subRows)}
                                        className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 hover:underline px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/50 dark:hover:bg-black/20"
                                        title={`Gỡ tất cả ${assignedCount} quyền đã gán`}
                                      >
                                        - Gỡ {assignedCount}
                                      </button>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/40">
                                {subRows.map((row) => (
                                  <RolePermissionItem
                                    key={row.permission_id}
                                    row={row}
                                    disabled={isAdminRole}
                                    onToggle={() => togglePermission(row)}
                                  />
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Footer */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div className="text-xs flex items-center gap-3">
              {stats.pendingGrants > 0 && (
                <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                  +{stats.pendingGrants} sẽ thêm
                </span>
              )}
              {stats.pendingRevokes > 0 && (
                <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-semibold">
                  -{stats.pendingRevokes} sẽ gỡ
                </span>
              )}
              {stats.totalChanges === 0 && (
                <span className="text-slate-400">Không có thay đổi</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
              >
                {isAdminRole ? 'Đóng' : 'Hủy'}
              </button>
              {!isAdminRole && (
                <button
                  onClick={handleSave}
                  disabled={saving || stats.totalChanges === 0}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {saving ? 'Đang lưu...' : `Lưu ${stats.totalChanges} thay đổi`}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SUB-COMPONENTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const StatBox: React.FC<{
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
}> = ({ icon, label, value, color, bg }) => (
  <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border ${bg}`}>
    <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${color} text-[11px] font-semibold`}>
      {icon}
      <span>{label}</span>
    </div>
    <div className={`text-xl font-bold mt-1 ${color}`}>{value}</div>
  </div>
);

const RolePermissionItem: React.FC<{
  row: RolePermissionRow;
  disabled: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
}> = ({ row, disabled, onToggle }) => {
  const isDangerous = DANGEROUS_CODES.has(row.code || '');
  const isPendingGrant = row.ui_state === 'pending_grant';
  const isPendingRevoke = row.ui_state === 'pending_revoke';
  const isAssigned = row.ui_state === 'assigned';
  const isUnassigned = row.ui_state === 'unassigned';
  const checked = isAssigned || isPendingGrant;

  return (
    <div
      className={`px-3 py-2 flex items-start gap-2.5 transition ${
        isPendingGrant ? 'bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-500/5'
        : isPendingRevoke ? 'bg-rose-50/60 dark:bg-rose-500/5'
        : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40'
      }`}
    >
      <button
        onClick={onToggle}
        disabled={disabled}
        className={`mt-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded border-2 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center transition ${
          disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : 'cursor-pointer'
        } ${
          isPendingRevoke ? 'bg-rose-500 border-rose-500 text-white'
          : checked ? 'bg-amber-600 border-amber-600 text-white'
          : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600'
        }`}
        title={disabled ? 'Role Admin bypass — không cần gán' : 'Bấm để thay đổi'}
      >
        {isPendingRevoke ? (
          <X className="w-3 h-3" />
        ) : checked ? (
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
        ) : null}
      </button>

      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          <span
            className={`font-mono text-[11px] font-bold ${
              isDangerous ? 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-900 dark:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {row.code}
          </span>

          {isAssigned && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> Đã gán
            </span>
          )}
          {isUnassigned && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600">
              Chưa gán
            </span>
          )}
          {isPendingGrant && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30">
              + Sẽ thêm
            </span>
          )}
          {isPendingRevoke && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30">
              - Sẽ gỡ
            </span>
          )}

          {Boolean(row.is_system) && (
            <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600">
              🏷️ Hệ thống
            </span>
          )}

          {isDangerous && (
            <Tooltip title="Quyền nguy hiểm — cấp cho role này sẽ áp cho mọi user có role">
              <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30">
                ⚠️ Nguy hiểm
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 line-clamp-2">
          {row.description || '—'}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RolePermissionModal;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, KeyRound, Copy, Check, Dices } from 'lucide-react';
import { usersApi } from '../../services/usersApi';

export interface UserCredentialsModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  userId: string;
  defaultUsername?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => Promise<void> | void;
  onToast: (msg: string, type?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info') => void;
}

export const UserCredentialsModal: React.FC<UserCredentialsModalProps> = ({
  open,
  userId,
  defaultUsername,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  onToast,
}) => {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setUsername(defaultUsername || (userId ? userId.toLowerCase() : ''));
      setPassword('');
      setCopied(false);
    }
  }, [open, userId, defaultUsername]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const generateRandomPassword = () => {
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789!@#$%';
    let res = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      res += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    setPassword(res);
  };

  const copyPassword = () => {
    if (!password) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(password);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!username.trim()) {
      onToast('Tên đăng nhập không được để trống!', 'error');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await usersApi.updateCredentials(userId, {
        username: username.trim(),
        ...(password.trim() ? { password: password.trim() } : {}),
      });
      onToast(`Cập nhật thông tin đăng nhập cho ${userId} thành công!`, 'success');
      onSuccess();
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      onToast(err.message || 'Lỗi cập nhật tài khoản!', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-colors duration-200"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-500">
                <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Cập Nhật Tài Khoản Đăng Nhập
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Quân nhân: {userId}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4 text-xs">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1">
                Tên đăng nhập (Username) *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={username}
                onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Nhập username..."
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500 font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">
                  Mật khẩu mới (Để trống nếu giữ nguyên)
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={generateRandomPassword}
                  className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-500 dark:hover:text-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Dices className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Sinh ngẫu nhiên</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Tối thiểu 8 ký tự..."
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500 font-mono"
                />
                {password && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={copyPassword}
                    className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-amber-500 transition"
                    title="Sao chép mật khẩu"
                  >
                    {copied ? (
                      <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
                    ) : (
                      <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-1">
                Gợi ý: Mật khẩu nên gồm chữ hoa, chữ thường, chữ số và ký tự đặc biệt.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-end space-x-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Hủy bỏ
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-amber-600/30"
              >
                {submitting ? 'Đang lưu...' : 'Cập nhật tài khoản'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  X,
  Save,
  User as UserIcon,
  KeyRound,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Plus,
  Minus,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { TreeSelect } from 'antd';
import { User, MilitaryRank, MilitaryPosition } from '../../types/user';
import { Unit, SecurityLevel, Role } from '../../types';
import { usersApi } from '../../services/usersApi';
import { dashboardApi } from '../../services/dashboardApi';
import { buildUnitTree, filterSchoolUnits } from '../../utils/unitTree';

export interface UserFormModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  user?: User | null;
  units: Unit[];
  securityLevels: SecurityLevel[];
  currentUserClearance?: number;
  isAdminUser?: boolean;
  roles?: Role[];
  ranks?: MilitaryRank[];
  positions?: MilitaryPosition[];
  existingUsers?: User[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (userData: Partial<User> & { username?: string; password?: string; role_id?: string }) => Promise<void>;
  onToast?: (msg: string, type?: 'success' | 'error') => void;
}

/**
 * Tự động tính toán mã quân nhân kế tiếp theo thứ tự tăng dần, lấp đầy khoảng trống
 */
export const getNextUserId = (users: Array<{ user_id?: string }>): string => {
  const existingNums = new Set<number>();
  for (const u of users) {
    if (!u.user_id) continue;
    const match = u.user_id.match(/USR-(\d+)/i);
    if (match) {
      const num = parseInt(match[1], 10);
      if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) {
        existingNums.add(num);
      }
    }
  }
  let candidate = 1;
  while (existingNums.has(candidate)) {
    candidate++;
  }
  return `USR-${String(candidate).padStart(3, '0')}`;
};

export const DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD = '123456789';

export const UserFormModal: React.FC<UserFormModalProps> = ({
  open,
  user,
  units,
  securityLevels,
  roles,
  ranks,
  positions,
  existingUsers,
  onClose,
  onSave,
  onToast,
  currentUserClearance = 1,
  isAdminUser = false,
}) => {
  const isEdit = Boolean(user);

  // ── Ranks & Positions ──
  const [availableRanks, setAvailableRanks] = useState<MilitaryRank[]>(ranks || []);
  const [availablePositions, setAvailablePositions] = useState<MilitaryPosition[]>(positions || []);

  // ── Roles ──
  const [availableRoles, setAvailableRoles] = useState<Role[]>(roles || []);

  // [FIX] State riêng cho kết quả API — KHÔNG trùng tên với prop `isAdminUser`
  const [isAdminFromApi, setIsAdminFromApi] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  // Giá trị hợp nhất: ưu tiên kết quả API, fallback về prop
  const resolvedIsAdmin = isAdminFromApi ?? isAdminUser;

  // [SECURITY FIX v4.3.1] Lọc levels theo quyền người đang thao tác
  const availableLevels = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (resolvedIsAdmin) return securityLevels;
    return securityLevels.filter((lvl) => lvl.level_id <= currentUserClearance);
  }, [securityLevels, resolvedIsAdmin, currentUserClearance]);

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // [NEW] Load danh sách role ĐƯỢC PHÉP TẠO theo quyền user hiện tại
  // Admin → tất cả | IT → chỉ Trợ lý + Chỉ huy
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    dashboardApi
      .getCreatableRoles?.()
      .then((res: any) => {
        setAvailableRoles(res.items || []);
        setIsAdminFromApi(Boolean(res.is_admin));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (roles && roles.length > 0) {
          setAvailableRoles(roles);
        }
        setIsAdminFromApi(null);
      });
  }, [open, roles]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ranks && ranks.length > 0) {
      setAvailableRanks(ranks);
    }
    if (positions && positions.length > 0) {
      setAvailablePositions(positions);
    }
    if (open && (!ranks || ranks.length === 0 || !positions || positions.length === 0)) {
      dashboardApi
        .getMeta()
        .then((meta: any) => {
          if (!ranks || ranks.length === 0) setAvailableRanks(meta.ranks || []);
          if (!positions || positions.length === 0) setAvailablePositions(meta.positions || []);
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [ranks, positions, open]);

  // ── Đơn vị công tác ──
  const [availableUnits, setAvailableUnits] = useState<Unit[]>(units || []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (units && units.length > 0) {
      setAvailableUnits(units);
    } else if (open) {
      dashboardApi
        .getUnits()
        .then((res: any) => setAvailableUnits(res.items || res || []))
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [units, open]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<User> & { username?: string; password?: string; role_id?: string }>({
    user_id: '',
    username: '',
    password: DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD,
    full_name: '',
    rank_name: '',
    position: '',
    unit_id: '',
    clearance_level_id: undefined,
    status: 'active',
    role_id: '',
  });

  const filteredUnits = React.useMemo(
    () => filterSchoolUnits(availableUnits, formData.unit_id),
    [availableUnits, formData.unit_id]
  );
  const unitTree = React.useMemo(() => buildUnitTree(filteredUnits), [filteredUnits]);

  const defaultExpandedKeys = React.useMemo(() => {
    const keys: string[] = [];
    const collectParentKeys = (nodes: any[]) => {
      for (const n of nodes) {
        if (n.children && n.children.length > 0) {
          keys.push(String(n.key));
          collectParentKeys(n.children);
        }
      }
    };
    collectParentKeys(unitTree);
    return keys;
  }, [unitTree]);

  const [treeExpandedKeys, setTreeExpandedKeys] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (defaultExpandedKeys.length > 0) {
      setTreeExpandedKeys(defaultExpandedKeys);
    }
  }, [defaultExpandedKeys]);

  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const copyPassword = () => {
    if (!formData.password) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(formData.password);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      setFormData({
        user_id: user.user_id,
        username: user.username || user.user_id.toLowerCase(),
        password: '',
        full_name: user.full_name,
        rank_name: user.rank_name || '',
        position: user.position || '',
        unit_id: user.unit_id || '',
        clearance_level_id: user.clearance_level_id,
        status: user.status || 'active',
        role_id: user.roles && user.roles.length > 0 ? user.roles[0] : '',
      });
    } else if (open) {
      const calculateAndSet = (list: User[]) => {
        const nextId = getNextUserId(list);
        setFormData({
          user_id: nextId,
          username: nextId.toLowerCase(),
          password: DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD,
          full_name: '',
          rank_name: '',
          position: '',
          unit_id: '',
          clearance_level_id: undefined,
          status: 'active',
          role_id: '',
        });
      };

      if (existingUsers && existingUsers.length > 0) {
        calculateAndSet(existingUsers);
      }
      usersApi
        .getUsers()
        .then((res) => calculateAndSet(res.items || []))
        .catch(() => {
          if (!existingUsers || existingUsers.length === 0) calculateAndSet([]);
        });
    }
    setError('');
    setCopied(false);
    setShowPassword(false);
  }, [user, open, units, existingUsers]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    if (!formData.user_id || !formData.full_name?.trim()) {
      setError('Mã quân nhân và Họ tên là các trường bắt buộc!');
      return;
    }

    if (!formData.clearance_level_id) {
      setError('Vui lòng chọn độ bảo mật!');
      return;
    }

    // [SECURITY FIX v4.3.1] Chặn chọn cấp bảo mật cao hơn cấp của caller
    // (đồng bộ với check phía backend `CLEARANCE_ESCALATION_DENIED`)
    const requestedClearance = Number(formData.clearance_level_id);
    if (!resolvedIsAdmin && requestedClearance > currentUserClearance) {
      setError(
        `Không thể chọn cấp bảo mật (Cấp ${requestedClearance}) cao hơn cấp của bạn (Cấp ${currentUserClearance})!`
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!isEdit) {
      if (!formData.username || !formData.username.trim()) {
        setError('Tên đăng nhập (Username) không được để trống!');
        return;
      }
      if (!formData.password || formData.password.length < 8) {
        setError('Mật khẩu cần ít nhất 8 ký tự!');
        return;
      }
      // [SECURITY FIX v4.3.1] Non-admin phải chọn role (Trợ lý / Chỉ huy)
      if (!resolvedIsAdmin && !formData.role_id) {
        setError('Vui lòng chọn vai trò cho tài khoản mới (Trợ lý hoặc Chỉ huy).');
        return;
      }
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload: Partial<User> & { username?: string; password?: string; role_id?: string } = {
        ...formData,
        user_id: formData.user_id?.trim(),
        full_name: formData.full_name?.trim(),
        username: formData.username?.trim().toLowerCase(),
        password: formData.password ? formData.password : undefined,
        clearance_level_id: Number(formData.clearance_level_id),
        role_id: formData.role_id || undefined,
      };

      await onSave(payload);
      if (onToast) {
        onToast(
          isEdit
            ? `Cập nhật quân nhân ${formData.user_id} thành công!`
            : `Thêm mới quân nhân ${formData.user_id} thành công!`,
          'success'
        );
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Thao tác không thành công, vui lòng kiểm tra lại!');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] transition-colors duration-200"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <UserIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {isEdit ? 'Chỉnh Sửa Thông Tin Quân Nhân' : 'Thêm Người Dùng Mới'}
              </h3>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-xs">
            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 rounded-xl text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-medium">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 items-start">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1.5 text-xs whitespace-nowrap">
                  Mã Quân Nhân / ID (Tự động) *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  readOnly
                  disabled
                  value={formData.user_id || ''}
                  placeholder="Ví dụ: USR-005"
                  required
                  className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono cursor-not-allowed opacity-80 text-sm"
                  title="Mã định danh quân nhân được hệ thống tự động khởi tạo theo thứ tự"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1.5 text-xs whitespace-nowrap">
                  Họ và Tên *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.full_name || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, full_name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Nguyễn Văn A"
                  required
                  className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 text-sm"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Tài khoản xác thực cho user mới */}
            {!isEdit && (
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/40 rounded-xl space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-bold text-xs">
                  <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Thông Tin Đăng Nhập Hệ Thống</span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 items-start">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1.5 text-xs whitespace-nowrap">
                      Tên đăng nhập*
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={formData.username || ''}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, username: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="Ví dụ: usr-005"
                      required
                      className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 font-mono text-sm"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1.5 text-xs whitespace-nowrap">
                      Mật khẩu *
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <input
                        type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                        value={formData.password || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, password: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="Mặc định: 123456789"
                        required
                        minLength={8}
                        className="w-full h-9.5 pl-3 pr-14 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 font-mono text-sm"
                      />
                      <div className="absolute right-1.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center space-x-0.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                          className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400 transition cursor-pointer"
                          title={showPassword ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Xem mật khẩu'}
                        >
                          {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                        </button>
                        {formData.password && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={copyPassword}
                            className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400 transition cursor-pointer"
                            title="Sao chép mật khẩu"
                          >
                            {copied ? (
                              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                            ) : (
                              <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1">Cấp bậc</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.rank_name || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, rank_name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 cursor-pointer text-sm"
                >
                  <option value=""> Chọn cấp bậc </option>
                  {formData.rank_name && !availableRanks.some((r) => r.name === formData.rank_name) && (
                    <option value={formData.rank_name}>{formData.rank_name}</option>
                  )}
                  {availableRanks.map((r) => (
                    <option key={r.rank_id} value={r.name}>
                      {r.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1">Chức vụ</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.position || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, position: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 cursor-pointer text-sm"
                >
                  <option value=""> Chọn chức vụ </option>
                  {formData.position && !availablePositions.some((p) => p.name === formData.position) && (
                    <option value={formData.position}>{formData.position}</option>
                  )}
                  {availablePositions.map((p) => (
                    <option key={p.position_id} value={p.name}>
                      {p.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1">
                  Đơn vị công tác
                </label>
                <div className="unit-treeselect-wrapper" style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%' }}>
                  <TreeSelect
                    value={formData.unit_id || undefined}
                    onChange={(val) => setFormData({ ...formData, unit_id: val || '' })}
                    treeData={unitTree}
                    placeholder="Chọn đơn vị công tác"
                    allowClear={{
                      clearIcon: (
                        <span
                          className="flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700/70 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          title="Xóa lựa chọn đơn vị"
                        >
                          <X className="w-2.5 h-2.5 stroke-[2]" />
                        </span>
                      ),
                    }}
                    treeExpandedKeys={treeExpandedKeys}
                    onTreeExpand={(keys) => setTreeExpandedKeys(keys as string[])}
                    onOpenChange={(visible) => {
                      if (visible && defaultExpandedKeys.length > 0) {
                        setTreeExpandedKeys(defaultExpandedKeys);
                      }
                    }}
                    treeLine={{ showLeafIcon: false }}
                    switcherIcon={(nodeProps: any) => {
                      if (nodeProps.isLeaf) return null;
                      const isExpanded = Boolean(nodeProps.expanded);
                      return (
                        <span
                          className={`qk7-tree-switcher-btn ${isExpanded ? 'is-expanded' : 'is-collapsed'}`}
                          title={isExpanded ? 'Thu gọn' : 'Mở rộng'}
                        >
                          {isExpanded ? (
                            <Minus className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[2.5]" />
                          ) : (
                            <Plus className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[2.5]" />
                          )}
                        </span>
                      );
                    }}
                    treeNodeLabelProp="name"
                    treeNodeFilterProp="name"
                    filterTreeNode={(input: string, node: any) =>
                      String(node.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(input.toLowerCase().trim())
                    }
                    getPopupContainer={(trigger) => (trigger.parentElement as HTMLElement) || window.document.body}
                    className="qk7-treeselect w-full"
                    classNames={{ popup: { root: 'qk7-unit-treeselect-popup' } }}
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: 38 }}
                    popupMatchSelectWidth={false}
                    styles={{
                      popup: {
                        root: {
                          minWidth: 280,
                          maxWidth: 'min(520px, 90vw)',
                          maxHeight: 380,
                          overflowX: 'hidden',
                          overflowY: 'auto',
                        },
                      },
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1">
                  Độ bảo mật *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={formData.clearance_level_id || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setFormData({
                      ...formData,
                      clearance_level_id: e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : undefined,
                    })
                  }
                  required
                  className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 cursor-pointer text-sm"
                >
                  <option value=""> Chọn độ bảo mật </option>
                  {/* [FIX] Bỏ block `<option>` lặp lại gây lỗi syntax. */}
                  {availableLevels.map((lvl) => (
                    <option key={lvl.level_id} value={lvl.level_id}>
                      {lvl.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1">Vai trò hệ thống</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.role_id || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, role_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 cursor-pointer text-sm"
                >
                  <option value=""> Chọn vai trò</option>
                  {availableRoles.map((r) => (
                    <option key={r.role_id} value={r.role_id}>
                      {r.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold mb-1">Trạng thái tài khoản</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.status === 'locked' ? 'locked' : 'active'}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, status: e.target.value as any })}
                  className="w-full h-9.5 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-700/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/20 text-sm"
                >
                  <option value="active">Hoạt động</option>
                  <option value="locked">Khóa</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-end space-x-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Hủy bỏ
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#14532d] via-[#166534] to-[#15803d] hover:from-[#166534] hover:to-[#15803d] text-white font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-emerald-950/20 border border-amber-500/25"
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {submitting ? 'Đang lưu...' : 'Lưu thông tin'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};
